First, we treat US-dollar cost per engagement as a measured, first-class evaluation metric and show that a 7B-parameter local model, kept off the critical path by a deterministic backbone, sustains end-to-end operation at zero measured paid-API cost. Second, we analyse the attack surface that an MCP-exposed offensive engine introduces, grounding a four-position threat model in the 2025 MCP incident record (the CVE-2025-6514 remote-code-execution flaw in mcp-remote, the postmark-mcp supply-chain backdoor, and the tool-poisoning-rug-pull-line-jumping class), and contribute four mitigations. Third, we specify a reproducible, containerised evalua-tion protocol aligned with the standardised testbeds now expected at top-tier venues-AutoPenBench, a Cybench subset, and the PentestGPT 182-sub-task benchmark-with multi-trial statistics (more than 10 trials per configuration, pass-at-k, non-parametric significance tests and effect sizes) and direct, same testbed reproduction of the PentestGPT and PentestAgent baselines rather than citation of their published numbers. On the legacy targets measured to date, the framework detected 26 services, enriched 34 CVEs, produced

</details>


### [199] ["Your Robot Was Trained on a Lie": Collision Mesh Poisoning Attacks on Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18122)
*Gengyang Xu,Dongwei Xiao,Yiteng Peng,Yanbo Dai,Ruochen Zhou,Shing-Chi Cheung,Xiaoyu Ji,Wenyuan Xu,Shuai Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出"视觉-碰撞间隙"(V-C Gap)这一仿真器固有特性构成的新型攻击面,并设计首个针对机器人操作、通过3D资产供应链实施的投毒攻击——碰撞网格投毒(CMP)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作策略日益依赖仿真器进行训练与评估,而仿真器中的3D资产包含视觉网格(渲染)与碰撞网格(物理交互)两套独立几何。为计算效率,碰撞网格通常被刻意粗化,无需与视觉网格几何一致,这种合理且普遍存在的差异即V-C Gap。现有资产审查只覆盖恶意软件、版权与格式合规,不检查视觉-碰撞一致性,因此该间隙构成被忽视的实用攻击面。

Method: 提出碰撞网格投毒(CMP):攻击者仅修改3D资产的碰撞网格,保持视觉网格及其他所有组件不变,使投毒资产可通过合法供应链渠道分发。被投毒资产训练与评估的策略在仿真中表现正常,但在真实世界部署后性能退化、失效或产生物理安全风险。

Result: 被投毒资产在仿真环境中行为表现正常,难以在仿真阶段被发现;部署到真实世界后策略出现退化、失败或物理安全风险。作者评估了若干现有防御方法,结果表明它们均不足以抵御CMP。

Conclusion: V-C Gap是仿真到现实流程中一个此前被忽视的实用攻击面,CMP证明了仅修改碰撞网格即可绕过现有供应链审查。现有防御不充分,亟需针对视觉-碰撞一致性的新型防御机制。

Abstract: Learning-enabled robotic manipulation increasingly relies on robot simulators for policy training and evaluation before real-world deployment. Inside a simulator, a 3D asset contains two separate geometries: a visual mesh used for rendering and a collision mesh used for physical interaction. For computational efficiency, the collision mesh is deliberately a coarse approximation that need not have the same geometry as the visual mesh, a legitimate and pervasive discrepancy we call the Visual--Collision Gap (V--C Gap). We show that the V--C Gap opens a new and practical attack surface, and propose Collision Mesh Poisoning (CMP), the first poisoning attack against robotic manipulation delivered through the 3D asset supply chain. An attacker modifies only the collision mesh of a 3D asset, leaving the visual mesh and all other components unchanged. A policy trained and evaluated with the poisoned asset behaves normally throughout simulation, yet degrades, fails, or creates physical safety risks once deployed in the real world. Since current asset review practices cover malware, copyright, and format compliance, but not visual--collision consistency, poisoned assets can be distributed through legitimate supply chain channels. We evaluate several defenses and our results show that they are insufficient to defend against CMP, highlighting the need for new defenses.

</details>


### [200] [Bridging the Opacity: Evidence-Backed Cross-Chain Transaction Correspondence Reconstruction Across Heterogeneous Blockchains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18158)
*Dan Lin,Huan Xiao,Ziwei Li,Xiapu Luo,Jiachi Chen,Jiajing Wu,Zibin Zheng*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出 XSplicer：无需桥接后端特权映射，通过公开文档与交易样例提取统一语义规范，用硬证据优先、软线索补充的方式重建跨链交易对应关系（xTCR），实现 92.5% 全局恢复率，并在 Multichain 停运与 Bybit 洗钱事件中验证实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨链桥虽实现互操作性，却破坏了追踪非法资金的交易痕迹。第三方调查者通常无法访问桥后端维护的源-目的映射；对 131 个桥的调查显示仅 16.79% 提供完整公开追踪。现有方法依赖官方 API、EVM 特定假设或脆弱的时间启发式，难以跨异构账本追踪。

Method: XSplicer 是证据驱动的跨链交易对应关系重建系统：(1) 从公开协议文档与交易样例中导出统一语义规范；(2) 将其翻译为轻量解析器与验证器；(3) 以硬证据优先为原则，仅在必要时使用软线索，完成源交易与目的交易的链接。

Result: 在覆盖 EVM、Bitcoin、Solana 的 7 个桥协议上评估：全局恢复率 92.5%，单协议最高 98.61%。对抗噪声下，硬证据验证器在全部测试用例中保留正确匹配（100%），软线索匹配随歧义增加而退化。两个真实案例：Multichain 停运后恢复逾 1,900 组历史交易对；Bybit 洗钱事件中识别 754 笔非法跨链转移，价值 1.056 亿美元。

Conclusion: 公开协议不变量足以支撑实用的跨链取证，无需桥的特权映射，为异构账本下的资金追踪提供了可推广的替代路径。

Abstract: Cross-chain bridges enable interoperability, but they also break the transaction trails needed to trace illicit funds. Third-party investigators typically cannot access the source-to-destination mappings maintained by bridge backends, and our survey of 131 bridges finds that only 16.79% provide complete public tracking. Existing approaches depend on official APIs, EVM-specific assumptions, or fragile temporal heuristics, limiting their ability to trace transfers across heterogeneous ledgers. We present XSplicer, an evidence-driven system for reconstructing cross-chain transaction correspondence (xTCR) without privileged access to bridge backends. XSplicer derives unified semantic specifications from public protocol documentation and transaction examples, translates them into lightweight parsers and verifiers, and links source and destination transactions by prioritizing hard evidence and using soft clues only when necessary. We evaluate XSplicer on seven bridge protocols spanning EVM, Bitcoin, and Solana. XSplicer achieves 92.5% global recovery rate and up to 98.61% on individual protocols. Under adversarial noise, its hard-evidence verifier retains the correct match in 100% of tested cases, while soft-clue matching degrades as ambiguity increases. In two real-world case studies, XSplicer recovers more than 1,900 historical transaction pairs after Multichain ceased operations and identifies 754 illicit cross-chain transfers worth 105.6 million USD in the Bybit laundering incident. These results show that public protocol invariants can support practical cross-chain forensics without privileged bridge mappings.

</details>


### [201] [ISIA-AF: Orchestrating Reproducible Attacks and Multi-Source Data Collection for OT Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18196)
*Stefan Manfred Haratzmüller,Thomas Rosenstatter,Olaf Saßnick,Dalibor Sain,Stefan Huber*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出ISIA-AF——面向工业系统的模块化攻击编排框架，用于可复现攻击执行与多源OT安全数据集自动化生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OT环境需要真实、可复现的安全数据集，但现有方法普遍缺乏自动化、多源数据采集以及支持复用所需的充分文档说明。

Method: 基于前期工作与利益相关者讨论提炼功能性与非功能性需求，采用设计科学研究方法实现框架；框架协调分布式攻击客户端，记录网络流量与运营数据，形成多源数据集；并在包含真实工业系统与仿真过程的ISIA测试床上开展案例研究。

Result: 案例研究表明该框架支持集中控制、低通信开销，并可跨网段灵活部署。

Conclusion: 该框架为入侵检测研究提供了可扩展、多源OT安全数据集生成的实用基础。

Abstract: Operational Technology (OT) environments require realistic, reproducible security datasets, yet existing approaches often lack automation, multi-source data capture, and sufficient documentation for reuse. This paper presents ISIA-AF, a modular attack framework for orchestrating reproducible attack execution and automated dataset generation on industrial systems. The framework coordinates distributed attack clients, records network traffic and operational data, ultimately leading to a multi-source dataset. We derive functional and non-functional requirements from prior work and stakeholder discussions, and realise the framework following a design science research approach. A case study on the ISIA testbed, comprising a real industrial system and a simulated process, demonstrates how the framework supports centralised control, low communication overhead, and flexible deployment across network segments. The result is a practical basis for generating extensible, multi-source OT security datasets for intrusion detection research.

</details>


### [202] [Measuring and Exploiting Implicit Trust in LLM Tool-Calling Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18217)
*Murali Ediga,Sudipta Chattopadhyay*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文提出跨通道分片攻击（cross-channel fragmentation）：在MCP中把恶意载荷拆散到工具描述、工具结果、采样消息等多个通道，单个通道看似无害，但LLM会把碎片拼接成凭据窃取行为。对12个前沿模型、3个生产客户端、6种载荷共1.5万余次试验显示，单通道注入完全免疫（0%合规）的模型在两通道分片下最高可达100%数据外泄；现有7款第三方MCP安全工具与3类提示防御均未能有效检测或通用防御。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MCP使LLM可调用外部工具，但所有工具交互的输入通道（工具描述、工具结果、采样消息）共享同一上下文窗口且无权限隔离，均可被攻击者控制文本污染。既有研究主要关注单通道提示注入，未系统刻画模型的信任画像，也未探索跨通道组合带来的新攻击面。

Method: 1）构建评估框架，通过多通道、多载荷框架（payload framings）测量任意LLM的"信任画像"；2）基于画像设计跨通道分片攻击，将看似无害的载荷分散到两或三个通道，任一通道均不含完整注入；3）研究价值对齐利用（value-aligned exploitation，即工具声明用途恰好需要攻击者所觊觎的数据）以及通过VS Code MCP实现的采样系统提示覆盖，注入持久指令；4）在12个前沿模型、3个生产客户端、6种载荷上开展超过15,000次试验；5）评测7款第三方MCP安全工具与3类基于提示的防御。

Result: 跨通道攻击是被忽视的攻击面：完全抵抗单通道注入（0%合规）的模型在两通道分片下敏感数据外泄率最高达100%（如GPT-4o、Llama 70B、Composer 2、Haiku 4.5）。同时验证了价值对齐利用与VS Code MCP采样系统提示覆盖导致的持久指令注入。7款第三方MCP安全工具全部无法检测分片载荷；3类提示防御仅对特定模型有效，缺乏通用性。

Conclusion: MCP共享上下文且缺乏通道权限隔离，使跨通道分片成为严峻且未被探索的威胁，单通道防御的"0%合规"并不能代表真实安全水平。现有MCP安全工具和提示级防御不足，亟需通道隔离、来源感知与跨通道一致性检测等机制。

Abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) enables LLMs to invoke external tools, but every tool interaction exposes the model to attacker-controlled text through multiple input channels (tool descriptions, tool results, sampling messages) that share a single context window without privilege separation. In this paper, we present a framework to measure the trust profile of an arbitrary LLM based on a variety of payload framings sent through different channels. Following this assessment, we devise cross-channel fragmentation attacks that distribute seemingly benign payloads across two or three channels; no individual channel carries a complete injection, yet the LLM compiles the fragments into credential exfiltration. We evaluated our attacks across 12 frontier models, three production clients, and six payloads, totalling over 15,000 trials. Our evaluation reveals that cross-channel attacks are an unexplored attack surface: models that fully resist single-channel injection (0% compliance) exfiltrate sensitive data at up to 100% under two-channel fragmentation (e.g., GPT-4o, Llama 70B, Composer 2, Haiku 4.5). We further demonstrate value-aligned exploitation, where a tool's stated purpose requires the data the attacker targets, and a sampling system prompt override that injects persistent instructions via VS Code's MCP implementation. Finally, we evaluated our attacks against seven third-party MCP security tools and three prompt-based defenses. All tools failed to detect fragmented payloads, and prompt defenses proved model-specific rather than universal.

</details>


### [203] [Witness Encryption via Prime-Order Generic Groups](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18275)
*Isaac M Hair,Amit Sahai*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文在经典通用群模型中无条件构造了基于普通素数阶循环群的NP见证加密方案，并在此过程中首次证明了齐次MinRank的近似NP困难性（对数间隙）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统NP见证加密通常依赖强假设（如不可区分混淆或多线性映射），缺乏无条件构造；本文旨在通用群模型下用最普通的群结构实现无条件安全性。

Method: 在经典通用群模型（generic-group model）中使用素数阶循环群；对SAT实例构造加密算法，正确解密需多项式时间；安全性归约到通用敌手查询复杂度，并借助齐次MinRank近似困难性作为核心工具。

Result: 对规模为n的SAT实例，加密算法运行时间为poly(n)，满足性赋值可在poly(n)时间解密，正确性误差为2^{-n^{Ω(1)}}；任何最多进行n^{Θ(log n)}次群查询的通用敌手，其区分优势至多为n^{-Θ(log n)}。同时首次给出齐次MinRank在随机多项式时间归约下的超常数因子近似NP困难性，实现对数间隙。

Conclusion: 本文实现了通用群模型下NP见证加密的无条件构造，并确立了齐次MinRank的对数间隙近似困难性，为相关密码学构造提供了新工具。

Abstract: We unconditionally construct witness encryption for NP in the classical generic-group model, using an ordinary cyclic group of prime order. For SAT instances of size $n$, the encryption algorithm runs in time poly$(n)$, and any satisfying assignment can be used to decrypt in poly$(n)$ time with correctness error $2^{-n^{Ω(1)}}$. If no satisfying assignment exists, then every generic adversary making at most $n^{Θ(\log n)}$ group queries has distinguishing advantage at most $n^{-Θ(\log n)}$.
  Along the way, we prove the first superconstant-factor NP-hardness of approximation result for homogeneous MinRank under randomized polynomial-time reductions, achieving a logarithmic gap even when the rank-one witness has a Boolean right factor.

</details>


### [204] [Autonomy in Check: Governor-Mediated Adaptive Security at the Edge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18338)
*Ijaz Ahmad,Ijaz Ahmad,Flavio Esposito,Erkki Harjula*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文将"规划器输出—内核执行输入"的边界本身视为首要安全对象，提出分离控制架构：不可信规划器只产生带类型的"安全意图"，由确定性 governor 依据安全、资源、时序稳定性和比例性不变式进行准入判定，被准入的意图与签名回执绑定并编译为预置 eBPF map 更新。形式化了信任边界问题，定义三类威胁，给出准入谓词，并在 Raspberry Pi 5 与校园 5G 测试网上对规则型与 LLM 辅助规划器完成端到端原型验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络边缘的自适应安全日益依赖自动规划器（规则控制器、学习策略、LLM 辅助智能体）把观测转化为执行动作。一旦规划器能影响实时策略状态，语法合法就不够：由不完整或被操纵观测产生的"语义错误但语法正确"的动作，会被无法判断任务上下文的执行基座忠实执行，从而造成危害。

Method: 1) 将规划器输出与内核执行输入之间的边界确立为主要安全对象；2) 提出分离控制架构：不可信规划器发出类型化安全意图（typed security intents），确定性 governor 逐条对照安全、资源、时序稳定性与比例性四类不变式进行准入检查；3) 仅被准入的动作绑定签名回执（signed receipts）并编译为预安装的 eBPF map 更新；4) 形式化信任边界问题、定义三类威胁、推导 governor 准入谓词；5) 构建端到端原型验证。

Result: 在 Raspberry Pi 5 与高校 5G 试验网连接的测试床上，对规则型与 LLM 辅助规划器进行评测：governor 以微秒级开销完成意图的准入、拒绝与边界约束，且不破坏受保护流的规律性（protected-flow regularity）。

Conclusion: 贡献兼具概念性与实证性：自适应安全无需信任动作的作者，而需要一个中介边界来判定该动作是否可被准入。该工作为边缘自适应安全提供了一种以"可准入性判定"为核心的信任模型。

Abstract: Adaptive security at the network edge increasingly relies on automated planners, including rule-based controllers, learned policies, and LLM-assisted agents, that translate observations into enforcement actions. Once such a planner can influence live policy state, syntactic validity is not enough. A semantically wrong action, produced from incomplete or manipulated observations, can be faithfully executed by an enforcement substrate that cannot judge mission context. We address this problem by treating the boundary between planner output and kernel enforcement input as the primary security object. We propose a split-control architecture in which an untrusted planner emits typed security intents, a deterministic governor checks each intent against safety, resource, temporal-stability, and proportionality invariants, and only admitted actions are bound to signed receipts and compiled into pre-installed eBPF map updates. The paper formalizes this trust-boundary problem, defines three threat classes, develops the governor admission predicate, and reports an end-to-end prototype. Across rule-based and LLM-assisted planners on a Raspberry Pi 5 testbed connected to the university 5G Test Network, the governor admits, rejects, and bounds intents at microsecond cost without disrupting protected-flow regularity. The contribution is conceptual as much as empirical: adaptive security does not need to trust the author of an action. It needs a mediation boundary that decides whether the action is admissible.

</details>


### [205] [Analog Pin Directionality as an Exfiltration Attack Surface in Mixed-Signal ICs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19111)
*Ramana Ranganatham,Chirag Adiga,Michael Zuzak,Tejasvi Das*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出并实证了一类基于"引脚方向性"的模拟/混合信号(AMS)数据外泄攻击:利用数据相关的电路失调调制,将名义上仅输入的模拟引脚转变为出站信息信道。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合信号SoC通常依赖名义仅输入的模拟引脚采集片外信号,但其方向性一般仅被视为功能属性,而未被作为安全属性进行显式验证,由此存在测试可观测性缺口。

Method: 解析建模该攻击机制,识别三个使能条件(闭环放大器、暴露的放大器输入、该引脚足够高的阻抗);并在商用55nm CMOS工艺制造的光电容积脉搏波(PPG)模拟前端(AFE)上进行硅实证案例研究。

Result: 载荷面积开销<0.001%;激活后滤波PPG输出SNR仅下降0.03 dB;硬件木马引起的最大扰动为PPG幅度的5.9%,处于传感器输入引脚在工艺与温度下34.3%的良性变化范围内;原始外泄SINR低于-20 dB,定向滤波后可提升至14 dB以上实现信号恢复;硅测量实现最高10 kbps的比特率及PRBS消息无差错恢复。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了传统测试可观测性缺口,确立模拟引脚方向性为一项需显式验证、测试覆盖与防御的AMS安全属性,而非可由名义信号流推断。

Abstract: Mixed-signal SoCs rely on nominally input-only analog pins to acquire off-chip signals, but the directionality of these interfaces is generally treated as a functional property rather than explicitly verified as a security property. This work identifies and experimentally demonstrates a directionality-based class of analog and mixed-signal (AMS) exfiltration attacks in which data-dependent circuit-offset modulation converts a nominally input-only pin into an outbound information channel. We analytically model the attack mechanism and identify three enabling host conditions: a closed-loop amplifier, an exposed amplifier input, and sufficiently high impedance at that pin. This attack class is validated through a representative silicon case study using a photoplethysmography (PPG) analog front-end (AFE) fabricated in a commercial 55-nm CMOS process. The payload incurs $<$0.001\% area overhead relative to typical biosensing AFEs. Under the evaluated conditions, payload activation reduces the filtered PPG-output SNR by only 0.03~dB, while the maximum HT-induced perturbation of 5.9\% of the PPG amplitude remains within the 34.3\% benign variation at the exposed sensor-input pin across process and temperature. The raw exfiltration SINR remains below -20~dB, while targeted filtering increases it above 14~dB and enables signal recovery. Silicon measurements demonstrate data exfiltration through the input pin at bit rates up to 10~kbps and error-free recovery of a PRBS message. These results expose a conventional test-observability gap and establish analog pin directionality as an AMS security property requiring explicit verification, test coverage, and defense rather than being inferred from nominal signal flow.

</details>


### [206] [Detecting Logic Vulnerabilities Across the Contract and Device Layers of Blockchain-Enabled IoT With Multi-Agent Heterogeneous Graph Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18344)
*Minfeng Qi,Jialin Li,Tianqing Zhu,Lefeng Zhang,Zhe Sun*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出MA-HGAT跨层多智能体异构图注意力框架，统一建模合约与固件两类工件，实现区块链IoT逻辑漏洞的多任务检测与边缘部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 区块链IoT系统的安全同时依赖链上合约逻辑与链下设备固件，任一层的逻辑缺陷都可能破坏同一系统不变量（越权访问、非法状态变更、特权操作失守）。现有方法多为单层/单工件分析，依赖预定义漏洞模式、仿真保真度或同质化表示，模糊了安全相关的组件角色，且缺乏可部署于资源受限网关的统一架构。

Method: 将MA-HGAT扩展为跨层多智能体异构图注意力框架：以统一的“四角色、九关系”模式建模合约、固件工件、设备群与交易流；角色对齐的智能体通过交叉注意力交换异构证据；图级、链接级、节点级多头支持多种检测任务；基于角色的网关—云分区实现轻量边缘推理。

Result: 构建出可同时覆盖合约层与设备层的统一漏洞检测框架，支持多任务检测并在资源受限网关上完成轻量化推理（摘要未给出定量实验结果）。

Conclusion: MA-HGAT为区块链IoT提供统一且可部署的跨层逻辑漏洞检测框架，弥补单层分析、模式依赖与表示同质化的不足。

Abstract: Blockchain-enabled Internet of Things (IoT) systems integrate smart contracts with embedded devices to support decentralized device management and access control. Their security therefore depends jointly on the logic of on-chain contracts and off-chain device firmware. Logic flaws in either layer can violate the same system invariants, such as unauthorized access, improper state changes, or unguarded privileged operations. Existing approaches rely on contract analysis, firmware analysis, and graph-based vulnerability detection. However, these methods typically focus on a single layer or artifact and often depend on predefined vulnerability patterns, emulation fidelity, or homogeneous representations that obscure security-relevant component roles. They also lack a unified architecture that supports different security tasks while remaining deployable on resource-constrained gateways. To address these limitations, we extend MA-HGAT into a cross-layer multi-agent heterogeneous graph attention framework that models contracts, firmware artifacts, device fleets, and transaction streams with a unified four-role, nine-relation schema. Role-aligned agents exchange heterogeneous evidence through cross-attention, while graph-, link-, and node-level heads support multiple detection tasks and a role-based gateway--cloud partition enables lightweight edge inference. MA-HGAT thus provides a unified and deployable framework for detecting logic vulnerabilities across the contract and device layers of blockchain-enabled IoT systems.

</details>


### [207] [The Verifiable Action Card: Trustworthy Human-in-the-Loop Control for Secure Autonomous Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18411)
*Hasnain Irshad,Anam Mughees,Neelam Mughees,Abdullah Mughees,Imtiaz Ali Soomro*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出"可验证操作卡片"（VAC），通过从真实待执行浏览器操作与可信意图来源重建审批信息、在受信任浏览器界面中带外渲染，并将批准与调度时重新验证的确切操作绑定，从而抵御间接提示注入与欺骗性确认界面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体浏览器可在用户已认证会话下执行安全敏感操作，使间接提示注入和欺骗性确认界面直接威胁操作完整性。现有人机回环（HITL）防护在审批提示本身可能被不可信页面内容或模型生成文本影响时失效。

Method: VAC集成了五种机制：来源隔离（provenance fencing）、真实操作描述符、默认拒绝确认、来源感知风险门控，以及执行绑定；并在完整智能体浏览器中实现，在覆盖混淆代理攻击、环路谎言对话伪造、间接提示注入、自适应操作替换、来源规避及合法任务的24场景基准上评估。

Result: 在评估的各LLM上，无VAC时攻击成功率为68%至100%；VAC将每个模型的攻击成功率降至0%，合法任务完成率78%，误拦截率0%。

Conclusion: 将批准锚定于实际将要执行的操作，可提供架构级防护，抵御提示级防御与常规HITL确认无法可靠阻止的安全失效。

Abstract: Agentic browsers can execute security-sensitive actions under a user's authenticated session, making indirect prompt injection and deceptive confirmation interfaces a direct threat to action integrity. Existing human-in-the-loop (HITL) safeguards are insufficient when the approval prompt itself can be influenced by untrusted page content or model-generated text. We present the \emph{Verifiable Action Card} (VAC), an architectural defence that reconstructs approval information from the ground-truth pending browser action and trusted intent provenance, renders it out-of-band in the trusted browser chrome, and binds approval to the exact action re-verified at dispatch. VAC combines provenance fencing, a ground-truth action descriptor, default-deny confirmation, provenance-aware risk gating, and execution binding. We implement VAC in a complete agentic browser and evaluate it on a 24-scenario benchmark covering confused-deputy attacks, Lies-in-the-Loop dialog forging, indirect prompt injection, adaptive action substitution, provenance evasion, and legitimate tasks. Across the evaluated LLMs, attack success without VAC ranges from $68\%$ to $100\%$, whereas VAC reduces attack success to $0\%$ on every model, with $78\%$ legitimate-task completion and a $0\%$ false-block rate. These results show that grounding approval in the action that will actually execute provides architectural protection against security failures that prompt-level defences and conventional HITL confirmation cannot reliably prevent.

</details>


### [208] [AIJon: Automated Generation of Annotations for Fuzzing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18457)
*Jayakrishna Menon Vadayath,Hulin Wang,Moritz Schloegel,Jie Hu,Wil Gibbs,Tiffany Bao,Adam Doupé,Ruoyu "Fish" Wang,Yan Shoshitaishvili*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文复现并扩展IJON实验，提出用LLM自动生成IJON式注解以突破人工标注的可扩展性瓶颈，设计系统AIJON并在Magma基准评测，发现基于注解的模糊测试未必优于AFL++，但LLM注解效果可与人工注解相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代模糊测试器以代码覆盖率为反馈引导探索，但该策略会忽略那些未覆盖新代码路径、却对目标程序有意义的输入。已有研究表明，人类领域专家生成的注解可提供额外反馈，引导模糊测试器关注程序中更有趣的部分。然而人工注解依赖领域专家，难以规模化，因此需要一种可扩展的注解生成方式。

Method: 作者先复现IJON实验，并将其扩展到大规模真实漏洞检测场景；为缓解人工领域知识带来的可扩展性挑战，提出利用LLM自动生成注解，验证其适用性；在此基础上设计系统AIJON，利用LLM自动生成IJON风格注解，并在Magma基准上进行评测；随后通过多项实验分析注解对模糊测试过程的影响，包括对模糊测试器能量分配的影响。

Result: 在Magma基准上的评测显示，基于注解的模糊测试并未严格优于AFL++。同时观察到LLM生成的注解能达到与人工生成注解相当的效果，说明LLM可胜任注解生成任务。

Conclusion: 基于注解的模糊测试并非必然优于AFL++，其效果受注解对能量分配等因素影响，需进一步研究注解的作用机制。LLM能够生成与人工注解效果相当的注解，这为未来在大规模场景下研究注解影响打开了空间。

Abstract: Modern fuzzers use code coverage as feedback to guide their exploration which has proven to be an effective strategy for driving exploration. However, this strategy overlooks inputs that may be interesting to the target program even without uncovering new code paths. Fortunately, prior research has shown that annotations generated by human domain experts can provide additional feedback, guiding the fuzzer towards interesting parts of the program.
  In this paper, we replicate experiments presented in IJON and extend them to real-world vulnerability detection at scale. To mitigate the scalability challenge, imposed by the need for human domain expertise, we propose utilizing LLMs to automatically generate annotations. We demonstrate the applicability of LLMs for this purpose and observe that LLMs can generate annotations that perform comparably to human-generated annotations.
  Motivated by this finding, we design AIJON, a system that leverages LLMs to automatically generate IJON-style annotations. We evaluate AIJON on the Magma benchmark and surprisingly observe that annotation-based fuzzing does not perform strictly better than AFL++. We conduct several experiments to identify the cause of our results and identify key insights regarding the impact of annotations on fuzzing campaigns, including their effect on the energy distribution of the fuzzer. Notably, we observe that LLMs can generate annotations that achieve comparable results to human generated ones, thus opening the door for future research to perform further studies on the impact of annotations at scale.

</details>


### [209] [SEEK: Secure and Efficient Encrypted Keyword Search For Privacy-Preserving Messaging Protocols](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18459)
*Soumyadyuti Ghosh,Michail Maniatakos*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出SEEK，一种面向隐私保护消息传递的高效加密关键词搜索协议，结合同态加密与安全两方计算，实现密文片段化匹配并仅泄露关键词存在性比特。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加密通信保护用户敏感数据，但也可能被用于有害或非法交换，因而在检测危险消息与保护终端用户隐私之间存在权衡，需要兼顾检测能力与隐私的加密关键词搜索方案。

Method: SEEK先将消息划分为具有最小充分重叠的密文片段，再用加密关键词陷门进行同态关联；对长消息降低发送端加密与上传开销。支持ASCII大小写不敏感匹配，每个片段仅需一个固定大小加密陷门与一次同态乘法。随后调用基于2PC的选择性解码、盲化零测试与安全聚合。

Result: 发送端加密与上传开销较最强基线最多降低两个数量级；关联计算较最强片段化基线最多快5.47倍；在大小写变化导致精确匹配失败的情形下达到100%准确率，且无需额外陷门或在线通信。端到端Web与跨平台移动应用原型在周消息历史上每次搜索在线计算时间为1.92秒。

Conclusion: SEEK在仅泄露关键词存在或不存在这一比特的前提下，隐藏关键词、其长度、消息内容、匹配次数与位置，兼具实用性与高效性，验证了隐私保护加密关键词搜索的可行性与效率。

Abstract: Encrypted communication protects sensitive user data but can facilitate harmful or unlawful exchanges, creating a trade-off between detecting dangerous messages and preserving end-user privacy. To address this, we propose SEEK, a practical and efficient encrypted keyword-search protocol for privacy-preserving messaging that combines homomorphic encryption with secure two-party computation (2PC). SEEK first partitions messages into ciphertext fragments with the minimum sufficient overlap, then homomorphically correlates them using encrypted keyword trapdoors. For long messages, this design can reduce sender-side encryption and upload overhead by up to two orders of magnitude over state-of-the-art baselines. It supports ASCII case-insensitive matching with one fixed-size encrypted trapdoor and one homomorphic multiplication per fragment, yielding up to 5.47x faster correlation computation than the strongest fragmentation-based baselines. SEEK then invokes 2PC-based selected decoding, blinded zero testing, and secure aggregation, revealing only the keyword presence-or-absence bit while hiding the keyword, its length, message contents, match counts, and locations. SEEK achieves 100% accuracy under case variations that result in exact-matching failures, without requiring additional trapdoors or online communication. We further realize SEEK as an end-to-end web and cross-platform mobile application. Prototype evaluation on a weekly messaging history yields an online computation time of 1.92 s per search, demonstrating the practical feasibility and efficiency of SEEK.

</details>


### [210] [A Global Readiness and Sovereignty Capability Model for Post-Quantum Cryptography Migration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18477)
*Mohamed Aly Bouke*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出"就绪—主权能力模型"(RSCM),将后量子密码(PQC)就绪度与密码主权纳入统一的国家测量框架,分解主权为本土密码能力、本土后量子控制与外部依赖三个构念,并以"制造者门槛"认证后量子自主能力。对57个密码主体的证据编码与多法检验显示:20国通过门槛(15个全栈制造者、5个研究型制造者),11国具强一般能力但无后量子控制,1国为就绪采纳者,25国为依赖型;门槛加权一致度κ=0.71,就绪度与独立网络指数秩相关最高达0.70,而后量子创造与承诺指数无显著相关(ρ=0.22),表明"控制"与"就绪"是可分离的概念。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密码依赖问题先于量子时代存在,但向后量子密码迁移是重塑依赖格局的罕见窗口期:当下选定的算法、实现、硬件与标准将锁定未来数十年的依赖或主权。现有成熟度模型只把主权当作就绪度来打分,而主权文献虽有定义却缺乏可操作测量,因此需要一个同时测量PQC就绪度与密码主权的国家测量模型,以支撑自主量子安全能力的政策方向。

Method: 提出RSCM模型:把密码主权分解为本土密码能力、本土后量子控制、外部依赖三个独立构念;设置"制造者门槛",要求至少在一个核心层次(设计、实现或验证)具备经证实且由机构持续支撑的创造能力,方可认定为后量子制造者。实证上对57个有据可查的密码主体依据公开引证证据进行编码,并用独立第二编码者、合理状态自举(plausible-state bootstrap)以及收敛效度检验来验证编码可靠性。

Result: 57个主体中,20国通过门槛:15个全栈制造者、5个研究型制造者;11国具强一般能力但无后量子控制;1国为就绪采纳者;25国为依赖型。门槛单元格加权一致度较高,二次加权kappa=0.71,制造者分类在核心部分稳定、在阈值附近存在不确定性。就绪度与独立网络指数秩相关最高达0.70;后量子创造与承诺指数无显著相关,秩相关仅0.22,从而将"控制"与"就绪"区分开来。

Conclusion: 论文贡献包括:一个同时测量PQC就绪度与密码主权的分析框架、一套按证据分级的评估结果,以及构建本土量子安全能力的政策方向。核心结论是密码控制与就绪度可分离,仅凭就绪度指标会误判主权状态;制造者门槛提供了可操作的主权认证标准,但其阈值判定仍具不确定性,需进一步细化。

Abstract: Cryptographic dependence predates the quantum era, but the migration to post-quantum cryptography (PQC) opens a rare window to reshape it, because the algorithms, implementations, hardware, and standards adopted now can lock in dependence or sovereignty for decades. This paper introduces the Readiness-Sovereignty Capability Model (RSCM), a national measurement model that operationalizes PQC readiness together with cryptographic sovereignty, which current maturity models score only as readiness and the sovereignty literature defines without measuring. RSCM decomposes sovereignty into three distinct constructs, indigenous cryptographic capacity, indigenous post-quantum control, and external dependency, and certifies a post-quantum maker only through a gate requiring demonstrated, institutionally sustained creation in at least one core layer, whether design, implementation, or validation. Applying it to fifty-seven documented cryptographic actors coded from cited public evidence, and testing that coding with an independent second coder, a plausible-state bootstrap, and convergent-validity checks, we find that twenty countries clear the gate, fifteen as full-stack makers and five as research makers, eleven hold strong general capacity without post-quantum control, one is a ready adopter, and twenty-five are dependent. The gate cells show substantial weighted agreement, a quadratic-weighted kappa of 0.71, and the maker classification is stable in its core though uncertain at the threshold. Readiness tracks independent cyber indices at rank correlations up to 0.70, while post-quantum creation shows no significant correlation with the commitment index, a rank correlation of only 0.22 that separates control from readiness. The paper contributes the framework, the evidence-graded assessment, and policy directions for building indigenous quantum-safe capacity.

</details>


### [211] [MiST: Mid-Training LLMs for Cybersecurity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18496)
*Oded Ovadia,Elad Ben Zaken,Elad Guttman,Orly Moreno Kadosh*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文提出MiST（Mid-trained Security Transformer），通过"中间训练"阶段在通用预训练与网络安全训练之间进行适配，利用精选种子语料生成高质量合成数据，使8B和32B模型在网络安全基准上平均准确率分别提升13.1和8.6个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络安全领域兼具高风险分析与复杂技术语言的特点，对LLM而言既是高影响力也是高难度的应用场景。传统做法是使用大量原始领域文本进行持续预训练，但这种方式数据量大、质量参差，效率存疑，因此需要一种更高效的领域适配方法。

Method: 提出MiST系列模型（8B与32B）。核心方法是将"中间训练（mid-training）"作为通用预训练与网络安全训练之间的中间适配阶段：不采用大规模原始领域文本的持续预训练，而是精心筛选一个紧凑、经专家审核的种子语料库，并将其转化为高质量的领域专用合成训练数据。此外通过消融实验分析各训练阶段与合成数据生成流程的作用。

Result: 最终MiST检查点在公开网络安全基准上相比对应的Qwen基线，8B和32B模型的平均准确率分别提升+13.1和+8.6个绝对百分点，相对提升分别为+27.0%和+15.8%。消融结果显示，这些提升来自中间训练与监督微调阶段中多种合成数据生成流程的组合。此外，MiST为下游任务特定的微调适配与强化学习提供了更强的初始化。

Conclusion: 以"中间训练"取代大规模原始文本持续预训练，配合专家审核的种子语料与合成数据生成，是一种高效且有效的领域适配策略，能显著提升LLM在网络安全任务上的表现，并作为下游微调与强化学习的更优起点。

Abstract: Cybersecurity combines high-stakes analysis with complex technical language, making it an impactful and challenging domain for LLMs. We present MiST (Mid-trained Security Transformer), a suite of 8B and 32B models that achieve strong performance on public cybersecurity benchmarks. We use mid-training as an intermediate adaptation stage between general pre-training and cybersecurity training. Rather than performing continual pre-training over large volumes of raw domain text, we curate a compact, expert-vetted seed corpus, and transform it into high-quality domain-specific synthetic training data. The final MiST checkpoints improve mean cybersecurity accuracy by +13.1 and +8.6 absolute percentage points over the corresponding Qwen baselines for 8B and 32B, respectively, corresponding to relative gains of +27.0% and +15.8%. Ablation results further show that these cybersecurity gains arise in the mid-training and supervised fine-tuning stages through a combination of the synthetic data generation flows. Furthermore, we show that MiST provides a stronger initialization for downstream task-specific fine-tuning adaptation and reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [212] [Robot Visions: Breaking reCAPTCHA at Zero Cost and Zero Shot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18518)
*Suphannee Sivakorn,Samantha Gottlieb*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文证明免费本地开源模型（CLIP、OWLv2）可零样本破解Google reCAPTCHA，端到端会话成功率92.6%，且非技术攻击者仅用自然语言指令调用通用AI助手即可绕过，视觉挑战型CAPTCHA或已走到生命周期终点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Google reCAPTCHA长期是防御自动化攻击（撞库、批量注册、表单滥用）的关键防线。已有工作显示商业云端视觉语言模型能破解视觉挑战，但每次尝试成本不低，攻击门槛受经济约束。本文动机在于验证：免费、本地运行的模型是否同样能破解，从而将攻击成本与技能门槛同时降至近乎为零，改变基于挑战的CAPTCHA威胁模型。

Method: 1) 对reCAPTCHA进行系统研究，提出挑战类型分类法：Type A（独立图像块，含静态与动态子变体）与Type B（单图分割为4x4网格），二者需不同求解策略。2) 设计零样本、零成本的求解器，完全基于开源本地模型：CLIP用于Type A（单挑战准确率58%），OWLv2用于Type B（43.5%），无需模型训练、无需API访问。3) 构建端到端自动化求解流程，在500个真实reCAPTCHA会话上评测。4) 额外演示非技术攻击者仅用自然语言指令操作通用AI助手即可完成破解。

Result: 单挑战准确率：CLIP在Type A达58%，OWLv2在Type B达43.5%。端到端自动化求解器在500个真实reCAPTCHA会话上取得92.6%的会话级成功率。同时，非技术攻击者仅凭自然语言指令调用通用AI助手即可突破reCAPTCHA。

Conclusion: 免费本地模型已足以破解Google reCAPTCHA，攻击者技能门槛被压缩至近零，成本几乎为零，从根本上改变了基于挑战的CAPTCHA威胁模型。尽管reCAPTCHA日益倾向基于信誉的验证，但视觉挑战回退机制仍作为安全网存在，反而成为防御链中最薄弱环节，说明基于挑战的视觉CAPTCHA可能已到达其生命周期终点。

Abstract: Google reCAPTCHA is the most widely deployed visual CAPTCHA service, protecting hundreds of thousands of websites from automated bots. It serves as a critical line of defense against automated attacks, including credential stuffing, bulk account creation, and automated form abuse. It has proven largely effective since its introduction in 2007. However, the rise of accessible AI now threatens its efficacy. Prior work has demonstrated that commercial cloud-based vision-language models (VLMs) can solve visual CAPTCHA challenges, but at non-trivial monetary cost per attempt. In this paper, we show that free and locally-run models can break Google reCAPTCHA. We conduct a comprehensive study of reCAPTCHA and present a taxonomy of its challenge types: Type A (independent image tiles, with static and dynamic sub-variants) and Type B (a single image partitioned into a 4x4 grid), each demanding a distinct solving strategy.
  We design zero-shot, no-cost solvers built entirely on open-source local models, specifically CLIP (58% per-challenge accuracy on Type A) and OWLv2 (43.5% on Type B), requiring no model training and no API access. Our end-to-end automated solver achieves a 92.6% per-session success rate across 500 real-world reCAPTCHA sessions. We further demonstrate that reCAPTCHA can be defeated by a non-technical adversary, using only natural-language instructions to a commodity AI assistant. This collapses the practical attacker skill floor to near zero and fundamentally changes the threat model for challenge-based CAPTCHAs. Although reCAPTCHA increasingly favors reputation-based verification, visual challenge-based fallback persists as a safety net that, paradoxically, has become the weakest link in the defense chain, suggesting that challenge-based visual CAPTCHAs may have reached the end of their useful life.

</details>


### [213] [The Illusion of Local Privacy: Confidentiality Boundary Failures in Consumer LLM Serving Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18526)
*Youssef Hamdi Zafan Ibrahim,Muhammad Ikram,Mohammed Khalaf Salama*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文质疑"本地推理即隐私"的假设，提出边界分析框架 LLAnalyzer，在消费级本地 LLM 服务中识别出模型加载、运行时内存、封装层持久化、服务接口四类提示泄露边界，并发现内存明文残留、封装层明文落盘、llama.cpp 越权恢复会话（200/200 成功）及共享前缀缓存的远程计时侧信道等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 业界普遍认为本地部署 LLM 比云端推理更隐私，因为提示不出设备。作者要检验"本地保持机密"是否仅靠本地推理即可实现，指出提示机密性还取决于服务软件在推理前、中、后如何处理提示数据，并主张当前系统缺乏对提示生命周期的显式保证。

Method: 构建 LLAnalyzer 测量框架，将提示机密性失效划分为四个边界（模型加载、运行时内存、封装层持久化、服务接口）并分别测试，且把观测到的失效追溯到具体软件组件。在四个开放权重模型族和两个消费级部署平台上应用该框架：对加载边界开展 24 小时 AFL++ 模糊测试（超 1200 万次执行）；对内存边界检测分配器管理内存中的明文残留并评估净化效果；对封装层分析明文持久化；对服务接口开展受控越权会话恢复实验与 WAN 下的缓存计时侧信道测量。

Result: 加载边界在探索状态空间内未发现解析器崩溃或成功加载畸形 GGUF；运行时内存中多种明文表示在分配器管理内存里存活，推理后可恢复提示，净化只能减少而不能消除残留；消费级封装层通过明文持久化延长提示生命周期；服务边界发现 llama.cpp 一个此前未记录的授权缺陷，已认证客户端可恢复其他租户保存的会话状态，200/200 受控试验全部成功；共享提示前缀缓存构成远程计时预言机，在广域网条件下仍可区分。

Conclusion: 本地推理本身不足以保证提示机密性，机密性取决于服务栈对提示数据的处理方式。本地 LLM 系统需要针对提示生命周期、持久化存储和租户隔离提供显式保证（如内存净化机制、加密或策略化落盘、严格的租户授权校验与缓存隔离），而非默认"本地即安全"。

Abstract: Running large language models (LLMs) locally is often considered more private than cloud-hosted inference because user prompts remain on the device. We ask whether keeping inference local is, by itself, sufficient to keep those prompts confidential. Our results show that it is not: prompt confidentiality also depends on how the surrounding serving software handles prompt data before, during, and after inference. We examine four boundaries at which prompt confidentiality can fail in consumer local-LLM serving systems: model loading, runtime memory, wrapper-level persistence, and the serving interface. To study these boundaries, we develop LLAnalyzer, a measurement framework that tests each boundary separately and traces observed failures to the responsible software component. Applying LLAnalyzer to four open-weight model families and two consumer deployment platforms, we find markedly different behaviour across boundaries. In a 24-hour AFL++ campaign with more than 12 million executions, we observe no parser crashes or successful malformed GGUF loads within the explored state space. Runtime memory tells a different story: we recover prompts after inference because multiple plaintext representations survive in allocator-managed memory, and sanitisation reduces this residue without eliminating it. We also find that consumer wrappers can extend prompt lifetime through plaintext persistence. At the serving boundary, we uncover a previously undocumented authorization flaw in llama.cpp that allows one authenticated client to restore another tenant's saved conversation state; the attack succeeds in 200/200 controlled trials. Separately, shared prompt-prefix caching exposes a remote timing oracle that remains distinguishable under WAN conditions. We argue that local LLM systems need explicit guarantees for prompt lifetime, persistent storage, and tenant isolation.

</details>


### [214] [A Security Risk Assessment Framework for AI-Powered Development Tools](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18658)
*Salem AlJanah*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文提出安全风险评估框架（SRF），结合威胁建模、安全分析与基于漏洞严重性的定量风险评估，评估AI生成代码的安全风险。对多个AI开发工具在安全相关编程任务中生成的代码，使用Bandit和Semgrep分析，结果显示所有工具均会引入漏洞，风险水平随任务类型变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关于AI生成代码安全性的研究多聚焦于漏洞检测，而非风险评估，难以量化其安全影响，存在研究空白。

Method: 提出SRF框架，融合威胁建模、安全分析和基于漏洞严重性的定量风险评价；选取一组安全相关编程任务，对多个AI开发工具生成的代码用Bandit与Semgrep进行静态分析。

Result: 所有被评估工具生成的代码均可能引入安全漏洞；风险等级因任务类型而异，输入处理与文件处理类任务风险较高，简单任务保持低风险；工具间差异存在，但小于任务类别间差异。

Conclusion: SRF支持对AI生成代码的可复现评估，为评估其安全影响提供了实用框架。

Abstract: AI-powered development tools are now widely used to generate code and assist developers with routine programming tasks. Although existing work has identified vulnerabilities in AI-generated code, security-oriented work is often focused on vulnerability detection rather than risk assessment. To address this gap, this paper presents a Security Risk Assessment Framework (SRF) to evaluate the security risks of AI-generated code. SRF combines threat modeling, security analysis, and a quantitative risk evaluation approach based on vulnerability criticality. The framework is applied to a set of security-relevant programming tasks, where code generated by multiple AI-powered development tools is analyzed using Bandit and Semgrep. The results show that AI-generated code can introduce security vulnerabilities across all evaluated tools. They also show that risk levels vary by task type, as input processing and file handling tasks showed higher risk, while simpler tasks remained low-risk. Differences between tools exist but are smaller than differences across task categories. Overall, SRF enables reproducible evaluation of AI-generated code and provides a practical framework for assessing its security implications.

</details>


### [215] [CaMeLoT: CaMeL orchestrated with Temporal logic for static verification and liveness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18674)
*Elia Nikolaou,Magnus Wiik Eckhoff,Robert Flood,Gudmund Grov,Vasileios Mavroeidis,David Aspinall*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出CaMeLoT，在工具调用型LLM智能体执行生成计划前，将其转为带标签的有限状态迁移系统并用nuXmv对CTL时序策略静态验证，失败则返回反例供智能体修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的智能体会生成并执行多步计划并调用外部工具，可能访问私有数据或执行命令。此场景下安全性是计划整体执行的属性而非单步属性，计划本身是捕获工具调用、控制流与数据依赖的关键产物，因此需要执行前的整体性检查。

Method: CaMeLoT作为现有防御CaMeL的补充，在其基础上增加静态验证层：在任何工具被调用前，将生成的计划翻译为有限状态迁移系统，标注工具调用、来源（provenance）与污点（taint）信息，并用nuXmv模型检查器对以CTL表达的时序策略进行验证。

Result: 在来自AgentDojo基准、SOC工作流及提示提取实验的策略上进行评估，表明CaMeLoT能在执行前验证一大类时序性质，同时保持CaMeL可运行时检查的覆盖范围。

Conclusion: 由于验证发生在执行前，不安全计划无需LLM调用或工具调用即可被拒绝，节省运行时token开销，并避免回滚变更或拆除临时沙箱；验证失败时模型检查器返回反例，可反馈给智能体用于修复计划。

Abstract: LLM-based agents generate and execute multi-step plans that invoke external tools which can access private data or execute commands. In this setting, security is a property of the entire execution that a plan creates, not just any single step. The plan itself is a critical artefact that captures the tool calls, control flow, and data dependencies. We present CaMeLoT, a complement to CaMeL, an existing defence against prompt injection in tool-using LLM agents. CaMeLoT extends CaMeL by adding a static verification layer that checks an agent's plan before any tool is invoked. CaMeLoT translates a generated plan into a finite-state transition system, labels it with tool calls, provenance and taint information, and checks it against temporal policies expressed in CTL using the nuXmv model checker. Because verification happens before execution, unsafe plans are rejected without using LLM calls or tool calls, saving tokens that runtime could have cost, as well as the need to unwind changes or teardown temporary sandboxes. When a verification fails, the model checker returns a counterexample to give feedback to the agent to repair the plan. We evaluate CaMeLoT on policies derived from the AgentDojo benchmark, SOC workflows, and prompt-extraction experiments, showing that it verifies a broad class of temporal properties before execution while preserving CaMeL's runtime-checkable coverage.

</details>


### [216] [Echo: Learning-based Matching Decompilation using Trusted Back Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18706)
*Jun Bi,Xiangxin Fang,Aarsh Chaube,José Wesley De Souza Magalhães,Rodrigo C. O. Rocha,Michael O'Boyle*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: Echo：基于可信反向翻译的匹配式反编译系统，用编译既做验证又做反馈指导迭代搜索，显著提升优化二进制在未知编译配置下的精确匹配率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经反编译虽能恢复可读、可重编译的源代码，但预测结果难以信任。匹配式反编译通过搜索"重编译汇编与目标完全一致"的源码来提供更强的正确性证据，但在未知编译配置下的优化二进制上实现精确匹配仍很困难。

Method: 提出 Echo 系统，核心思路是把编译不仅用于验证，还作为可信反馈来引导迭代搜索：(1) 用领域专用模型生成候选程序与编译配置；(2) 重新编译候选，度量汇编级相似度，并合成有前景的"代码-配置"对；(3) 对残余不匹配依次用基于规则的改写、神经精化、基于推理的精化逐步修复。

Result: 在函数级基准和 Mirai 恶意软件二进制上评测：相比最强基线，精确匹配平均多 2.43 倍，且与真实源码的结构相似度最高；在 Mirai 上，匹配函数数量分别为 GPT-5.6 和 Codex 的 2.75 倍与 7.4 倍。

Conclusion: 将编译作为可信反馈融入迭代搜索的匹配式反编译框架，能有效应对未知编译配置下的优化二进制，在精确匹配数量和结构相似度上全面超越现有基线，验证了该范式的有效性。

Abstract: Neural decompilers can recover readable and recompilable source code from binaries, but their predictions remain difficult to trust. Matching decompilation addresses this problem by searching for source code whose recompiled assembly exactly matches the target, providing stronger evidence of correctness. However, exact matching remains challenging for optimized binaries under unknown compilation configurations.
  We present Echo, a matching decompilation system based on trusted back-translation. Our key insight is to use compilation not only for verification, but also as trusted feedback to guide iterative search. Echo first uses a domain-specific model to generate candidate programs and compilation configurations. It recompiles these candidates, measures assembly-level similarity, and synthesizes promising code-configuration pairs. Remaining mismatches are then progressively repaired using rule-based rewriting, neural refinement, and reasoning-based refinement.
  We evaluate Echo on function-level benchmarks and the Mirai malware binary. Compared with the strongest baseline, Echo produces 2.43x more exact matches on average and achieves the highest structural similarity to ground-truth source code. On Mirai, Echo matches 2.75x and 7.4x as many functions as GPT-5.6 and Codex, respectively.

</details>


### [217] [Normal Alignment: Improved Cryptanalytic Sign Recovery on Hard-Label Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18751)
*Shi Tang,Zirui Chen,Yongjia Su,Zhengchao Gao,Lingyue Qin,Xiaoyang Dong*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 Normal Alignment，一种针对 S1 硬标签 DNN 的统计符号恢复方法，并进一步构造 eSOE + Alignment，实现精确多项式时间的全符号恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Carlini 等人在 EUROCRYPT 2025 实现了硬标签 DNN 的多项式时间签名与符号恢复，但其 Future Toggle 符号恢复方法仅略优于随机猜测，在深层会产生高置信度错误符号预测，从而引发指数级枚举开销。

Method: 利用决策面在 dual points 处的投影法向量之间的期望长度差异，通过 normal-signature alignment 推断神经元符号；并将 Normal Alignment 与硬标签 SOE 扩展结合，形成 eSOE + Alignment 组合方法。

Result: 该方法提高了投票准确率，并把错误预测推至低置信度排名；组合方法消除了大量枚举开销。对 CIFAR-10（192-64×8-10）与 MNIST（64-96×3-32-10）模型可在多项式时间内完整恢复符号，而 Carlini 等人的方法分别需约 2^52 或 2^82 次符号猜测的指数时间枚举。

Conclusion: Normal Alignment 在深层网络中尤为有效，eSOE + Alignment 实现了无重枚举开销的精确多项式时间全符号恢复。

Abstract: At EUROCRYPT 2025, Carlini et al. proposed a breakthrough in the cryptanalytic extraction on hard-label (S1) deep neural networks (DNNs), demonstrating polynomial-time signature and sign recovery. However, Carlini et al.'s sign-recovery method (which we call Future Toggle) suffers only a marginal advantage over random guessing, producing high-confidence wrong sign predictions in deeper layers. Such errors trigger expensive exponential-time enumeration.
  This work presents Normal Alignment, a novel statistical sign-recovery approach for S1 DNNs. Drawing on the expected length difference between projected normals of adjacent decision facets at dual points, our method infers neuron signs via normal-signature alignment. It delivers higher voting accuracy and pushes erroneous predictions to low-confidence ranks, which further enables a more efficient combined method, eSOE + Alignment, by combining Normal Alignment with the hard-label SOE extension. This combined strategy removes heavy enumeration overhead and realizes exact polynomial-time full sign recovery.
  Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, especially for deep layers. For example, with our method, the signs for CIFAR-10 (architecture 192-64$\times$8-10) and MNIST (architecture 64-96$\times$3-32-10) models can be fully recovered in polynomial time; in contrast, Carlini et al.'s sign-recovery method would require exponential-time enumerations involving $2^{52}$ or $2^{82}$ guesses of the signs, respectively.

</details>


### [218] [s-MDM: Generative Virtualization of Multi-Device Hardware Variations for Portable DL-SCA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18783)
*Niloufar Sayadi,Marten van Dijk,Chenglu Jin*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出零目标迹生成框架s-MDM，通过结构化cVAE、Walsh-Hadamard泄漏锚、连续风格调制及解耦的泄漏-风格-域判别器，离线合成虚拟源设备画像，以提升深度学习侧信道分析的跨设备可移植性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DL-SCA在未见硬件上常因PCB布线差异、硅工艺波动与测量噪声漂移而出现灾难性性能退化，跨设备可移植性不足。

Method: s-MDM为生成式框架，包含四个组件：结构化条件变分自编码器（cVAE）生成器、Walsh-Hadamard泄漏锚、连续风格调制，以及解耦的泄漏-风格-域判别器，在无目标设备迹数据的条件下离线合成虚拟源设备画像。

Result: 在32位侧信道迹数据集AES_PTv2上评测：在完全相同电气条件的克隆设备D4上，物理MDM仍占优；而在布局/采集偏移的Pinata目标上，物理基线不稳定或失配，s-MDM则保持稳定低密钥秩。

Conclusion: s-MDM刻画了明确的操作边界：物理MDM适用于同构电气克隆，s-MDM在存在布局与采集偏移的异构设备上更具鲁棒性，为跨设备DL-SCA提供零目标迹的可行路径。

Abstract: Deep Learning-based Side-Channel Analysis (DL-SCA) frequently suffers from catastrophic performance degradation across unseen hardware due to printed circuit board routing differences, silicon process variations, and measurement noise shifts. This poster presents the Synthetic Multiple Device Model (s-MDM), a zero-target-trace generative framework designed to improve cross-device portability. s-MDM combines a structured cVAE generator, a Walsh-Hadamard leakage anchor, continuous style modulation, and decoupled leakage-style--domain critics to synthesize virtual source-device profiles offline. Benchmarked on 32-bit side-channel traces (AES_PTv2), s-MDM maps a precise operational boundary: while physical MDM remains superior on identical electrical clones (D4), s-MDM achieves consistently low key rank on the layout/acquisition-shifted Pinata target, where physical baselines are unstable or misaligned.

</details>


### [219] [Differential Trust: Dynamic Multi-Authority Anonymous Credentials with Epoch-Weighted Updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18811)
*Chen Li,Jianting Ning,Xiulong Liu,Yulin Liu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出首个考虑权威权重分布的多权威匿名凭证模型 MA-ACEW，其核心为历元绑定 Pointcheval-Sanders 签名（EB-PS），支持按权重签发凭证及跨历元高效非交互更新，并给出安全性证明与性能评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有最先进匿名凭证（AC）虽通过 Shamir 秘密共享或聚合签名将凭证签发分散到多个权威以提升鲁棒性、消除单点故障，但在签发阶段对所有权威等同对待，忽略了各权威可信度或权益份额的差异。这一局限在权益证明（PoS）等去中心化系统中尤为突出，因为节点间固有的信任差异无法在凭证签发中加以利用。

Method: 提出 MA-ACEW（基于历元权重的多权威匿名凭证）模型；核心构造为新型历元绑定 Pointcheval-Sanders 签名（EB-PS），将签名绑定到特定时间历元，从而支持历元内基于权重的凭证签发与跨历元的非交互式凭证更新；形式化 EB-PS 的 EUF-eCMA 不可伪造性要求，并在新的 STB-GPS 假设下证明构造满足该要求；进一步证明 MA-ACEW 满足不可伪造性、匿名性与盲性。

Result: 在 STB-GPS 假设下证明了 EB-PS 满足 EUF-eCMA 不可伪造性，并证明 MA-ACEW 构造具备不可伪造性、匿名性和盲性；基准测试表明方案高效，将 128 个部分凭证聚合后的凭证出示平均仅需 10.68 ms。

Conclusion: MA-ACEW 首次在凭证签发中引入权威权重分布，并借助 EB-PS 的时间绑定特性实现权重化签发与跨历元高效更新，兼顾安全性与效率，适用于 PoS 等具有信任差异的去中心化场景。

Abstract: Anonymous credentials (ACs) are fundamental to privacy-preserving authentication, allowing users to prove possession of attributes without revealing their identities. State-of-the-art ACs distribute credential issuance across multiple authorities, typically employing techniques such as Shamir's secret sharing or aggregate signatures. While this approach enhances system robustness and eliminates a single point of failure, it treats all authorities equally in the credential issuance phase. This uniform treatment disregards the varying levels of trustworthiness or stake held by different authorities. Such a limitation has become particularly problematic in modern decentralized systems like Proof-of-Stake networks, where the inherent trust differentiation among nodes cannot be leveraged in the credential issuance process.
  To address this limitation, we propose the notion of Multi-Authority Anonymous Credentials with Epoch-Based Weights (MA-ACEW), the first Multi-Authority Anonymous Credential (MA-AC) model that considers authorities' weight distribution in credential issuance. Crucially, MA-ACEW enables efficient credential updates when authority weight distributions change across epochs. The core of MA-ACEW is our novel Epoch-Bound Pointcheval-Sanders Signature (EB-PS) primitive, which binds signatures to specific time epochs. This temporal binding enables both weight-based credential issuance within epochs and efficient non-interactive credential updates across epochs. We formalize the EUF-eCMA unforgeability requirement for EB-PS and prove our construction satisfies it under a novel STB-GPS assumption. We then prove that our MA-ACEW construction achieves unforgeability, anonymity, and blindness. Finally, we present benchmarks demonstrating the efficiency of EB-PS and MA-ACEW. Remarkably, presenting a credential aggregated from 128 partial ones takes only 10.68 ms on average.

</details>


### [220] [CASHEWS: Source Preprocessor for LLM-based Malicious Package Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18862)
*Jean-Charles Noirot Ferrand,David Adei,Anders Møller,Alexandros Kapravelos*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 CASHEWS——一种 JavaScript 预处理器，通过重写源码去除与分析无关或易误导模型的内容以压缩文件体积，从而突破 LLM 上下文窗口限制，提升 npm 恶意包检测的覆盖率和准确性并降低成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的恶意 npm 包检测依赖源码语义理解，但攻击者利用代码混淆（造成高 token 密度）以及将恶意代码与良性代码捆绑等方式，触发 LLM 有限的上下文窗口限制，导致检测器跳过大文件或漏检恶意行为，形成规避检测的攻击面。

Method: CASHEWS 对给定包源文件进行预处理：通过迭代解码实现反混淆；提取被捆绑的模块与动态执行代码；识别恶意 sink 并计算到达这些 sink 的后向切片；缩写长字面量与标识符，生成紧凑的表示形式供检测器使用。

Result: 在 512 个大型包文件、两类扫描器和三种 LLM 上，CASHEWS 将分析覆盖率从 69.1–85.7% 提升至 98.8–100%，将假阴性率最多降低 18.6 个百分点；中位预处理时间为 30 秒，净分析成本下降 34.6%。

Conclusion: 通过在分析前预处理源代码，CASHEWS 使研究者和工业界能够以与较弱模型相同或更低的成本使用更强的模型进行恶意包检测，推动全注册表规模的 LLM 分析更具可行性。

Abstract: Malicious npm package detection tools now leverage LLMs' semantic understanding of source code to detect malicious intent at scale. This capability has proven invaluable in identifying packages involved in recent supply-chain attacks such as Shai-Hulud. However, threat actors exploit the limited context windows of LLMs through JavaScript techniques such as code obfuscation that yields high token density and bundling malicious code with benign packages, causing detectors to skip large files or miss malicious behavior. This creates an attack surface for evading detection. In this paper, we present CASHEWS, a JavaScript preprocessor that reduces file size by rewriting source code to remove code that is irrelevant to analysis or likely to mislead the model. Given a package source file, CASHEWS deobfuscates it through iterative decoding, extracts bundled modules and dynamically executed code, identifies malicious sinks and computes backward slices that reach them, and abbreviates long literals and identifiers to produce a compact representation for the detector. Across 512 large package files, two scanner types, and three LLMs, CASHEWS increases analysis coverage from 69.1--85.7% to 98.8--100% and reduces the false-negative rate by up to 18.6 percentage points. CASHEWS also has a median preprocessing time of 30 seconds while reducing net analysis cost by 34.6%, making registry-wide LLM-based analysis more practical. By preprocessing source code before analysis, CASHEWS enables researchers and industry practitioners to use more powerful models for malicious package detection at the same or lower analysis cost as less powerful models.

</details>


### [221] [ASLEval: Measuring Privacy Exposure Displacement in LLM Agent Sessions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18864)
*Guosen Wu,Huizhen Huang,Guoxiong Long,Tao Huang,Chen Hou*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出"隐私暴露位移"概念与ASLEval授权感知评估框架，通过预注册隐藏目标集、测量全部声明可见出口，揭示局部评估代理与目标锚定会话暴露之间的系统性错配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具调用型LLM智能体的隐私评估多依赖指定动作、最终响应或攻击者报告等局部代理指标。这些代理在多步会话中会遗漏其他位置的未授权暴露，且在不同评估口径、报告与工具路径之间缺乏共同的真值基准。

Method: 提出ASLEval授权感知框架：预注册隐藏目标集，测量所有声明的可见出口，并将内部轨迹保留用于诊断；在多种企业风格环境与独立实现的运行时中进行验证，并以独立人工复核支持裁决流程。

Result: 呈现三个重复出现的模式：(1) 仅看预期出口会遗漏46.9%的暴露，这些暴露由可见出口并集才能召回；(2) 攻击者自报同时包含遗漏与高误报；(3) 与模式对齐的内部证据通常在请求/探测层面先于可见暴露出现。减少模型可见返回会改变该路径，但可能消除正常任务成功率。

Conclusion: 呼吁建立声明完整可见边界、将断言锚定于预指定目标与授权、并同时报告隐私与任务效用的评测基准；人工复核支持裁决流水线，同时识别出更难处理的控制台与候选案例。

Abstract: Privacy evaluations of tool-using LLM agents often inspect a designated action, final response, or attacker report. These local proxies can miss unauthorized exposure elsewhere in a multi-step session and lack common ground truth across outlets, reports, and tool paths. We introduce privacy exposure displacement, the mismatch between a local evaluation proxy and target-grounded session exposure, and ASLEval, an authorization-aware framework that pre-registers a hidden target set, measures all declared visible exits, and reserves internal traces for diagnosis. Across multiple enterprise-style environments and independently implemented runtimes, we observe three recurring patterns. An expected-outlet-only view misses 46.9% of exposure recovered by the visible-exit union; attacker self-reports combine omissions with high false discovery; and schema-aligned internal evidence usually precedes visible exposure at the request/probe level. Reducing model-visible returns changes this path but can eliminate normal-task success. Independent human review supports the adjudication pipeline while identifying harder console and candidate cases. These findings motivate benchmarks that declare the complete visible boundary, ground claims in pre-specified targets and authorization, and report privacy together with task utility.

</details>


### [222] [Hamming Ideals and Grobner Bases for ISD-like Syndrome Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18866)
*Roberto La Scala,Marco Marchesin,Sharwan K. Tiwari*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合代数方法与信息集译码（ISD）范式的综合征译码问题求解策略，通过Hamming簇的代数建模与GBDecode、MultiSolve算法实现组合搜索与代数求解的可调平衡，并在Classic McEliece NIST安全类别1参数下进行实验评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 综合征译码问题（SDP）是编码密码学中的核心困难问题。传统ISD方法依赖组合搜索，而代数方法（如Gröbner基）在求解此类问题时面临高次方程与计算复杂度的挑战。作者希望探索代数建模与ISD范式结合的可能性，通过降低组合搜索空间并引入可调代数求解策略，评估该混合方法的可行性。

Method: 1）对Hamming簇进行系统分析，用初等对称函数给出其定义方程；2）利用初等对称函数的卷积恒等式和基于Lucas恒等式的因式分解，引入辅助变量导出有界次的等价方程组；3）推广ISD范式，提出ISD-like译码策略，由GBDecode算法实现，仅固定信息集的一个子集；4）采用MultiSolve算法处理代数部分，将单个Gröbner基计算替换为对更简单系统的多次计算，通过对有限域上不定元进行穷举赋值实现组合搜索与代数求解的可调平衡。

Result: 在随机二元线性码的SDP实例上进行了实验，参数对应于Classic McEliece密码系统NIST安全类别1参数集。实验评估了组合-代数方法的可行性，并揭示了Gröbner基技术在ISD-like译码框架下的实际行为特征。

Conclusion: 该组合-代数混合方法在理论上提供了组合搜索与代数求解之间可调的权衡机制，实验结果表明其在Classic McEliece相关参数下具有一定的可行性，同时为Gröbner基方法在ISD类译码中的应用提供了实践洞察。

Abstract: We investigate an algebraic approach to the Syndrome Decoding Problem, based on a reformulation of the Hamming weight constraint and its integration with the Information Set Decoding paradigm. We begin with a systematic analysis of the Hamming variety, deriving its defining equations in terms of elementary symmetric functions. Since these equations may have high degree, we exploit convolution identities for elementary symmetric functions, together with factorizations based on Lucas' identity, to derive an equivalent formulation with auxiliary variables and equations of bounded degree.
  Building on this modeling, we generalize the ISD paradigm through an ISD-like decoding strategy, implemented by the GBDecode algorithm, in which only a subset of an information set is fixed. This approach reduces the size of the combinatorial search space at the cost of solving the associated multivariate nonlinear systems. To handle this algebraic component, we employ the MultiSolve algorithm, which replaces a single Grobner basis computation with a collection of computations on simpler systems, obtained by exhaustively assigning a varying number of indeterminates over the finite field. This provides a tunable balance between combinatorial search and algebraic solving.
  We evaluate the resulting approach experimentally on instances of the Syndrome Decoding Problem for random binary linear codes, using parameters corresponding to the NIST Security Category 1 parameter set of the Classic McEliece cryptosystem. The experiments assess the feasibility of this combinatorial-algebraic approach and provide insights into the practical behavior of Grobner basis techniques within an ISD-like decoding framework.

</details>


### [223] [BadQubits: An LLM-Based Framework for Static Pre-Execution Detection of Structurally Harmful Quantum Circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18965)
*Justin Woodring,Lamine Noureddine,Aisha Ali-Gombe*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出 BadQubits——基于 LLM 的 OpenQASM 2.0 量子电路静态预执行有害检测框架，在 1500 条电路数据集上，微调 Qwen Coder 2.5 7B 达 92.67% 准确率与 96.1% 有害召回，并通过消融与对抗实验验证其依赖门序列结构而非生成器伪影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子电路在物理执行层存在威胁，但运行时动态检测受限于测量不可逆性与量子态经典模拟的指数级开销，因此需要在提交后、执行前进行静态检测。同时作者希望厘清检测器究竟学到了威胁本质特征还是数据生成器伪影。

Method: 构建 1500 条电路数据集（1000 条 MQTBench 良性程序 + 500 条基于三类已记录物理层威胁原语合成的攻击电路）；在四种代码理解 LLM 架构上进行 LoRA 约束微调并评估；与 bag-of-gates CNN 基线在渐进混淆消融与对抗性语法扰动下对比；辅以相关性分析考察决策依据特征（SWAP 密度、测量时序）与生成器伪影（寄存器命名）。

Result: 微调 Qwen Coder 2.5 7B 达 92.67% 分类准确率、96.1% 有害电路召回；四种基座模型中有两种在约束 LoRA 微调下无法泛化。对抗语法扰动下，CNN 有害召回从 100% 降至 17%，微调 LLM 仅从 96.1% 降至 91.2%。相关性分析表明模型决策跟踪 SWAP 密度与测量时序等威胁定义特征，而非寄存器命名等生成器伪影。

Conclusion: LLM 输入的 token 级序列结构是其鲁棒性优于直方图式基线的关键；架构感知的模型选择是必要设计考量而非次要调参；所提框架可有效实现量子电路预执行静态威胁检测，且决策依据与威胁本质特征一致。

Abstract: This paper presents BadQubits, an LLM-based framework for static pre-execution detection of structurally harmful OpenQASM 2.0 circuits. The framework targets physical-execution-layer threats by analyzing submitted circuits prior to runtime, where dynamic inspection is constrained by measurement irreversibility and the exponential cost of classical quantum-state simulation. We evaluate four code-understanding LLM architectures on a dataset of 1,500 circuits consisting of 1,000 benign programs from MQTBench[33] and 500 synthetic attack circuits derived from three documented physical-layer threat primitives. Our fine-tuned Qwen Coder 2.5 7B model achieves 92.67% classification accuracy and 96.1% harmful-circuit recall. Two of the four evaluated base models fail to generalize under constrained LoRA fine-tuning, indicating that architecture-aware model selection is a necessary design consideration rather than a minor tuning choice. To characterize what the detector has learned, we compare it against a bag-of-gates CNN under progressive confound removal and adversarial syntactic perturbation. The CNN's harmful-circuit recall drops from 100% to 17%, while the fine-tuned LLM decreases only from 96.1% to 91.2%. We attribute this gap to the sequential structure retained in token-level LLM inputs but discarded by histogram-based baselines. A correlation analysis further shows that model decisions track threat-defining features, specifically SWAP density and measurement timing, rather than generator-specific artifacts such as register naming.

</details>


### [224] [Context-Aware Operational Security for Autonomous Drones](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19021)
*Burak Tufekci,Cihan Tunc*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出基于LSTM的DUDE-IDS，部署于无人机任务计算机上，对传感器数据与操作指令进行实时异常检测，针对GPS欺骗、MITM、重放和DoS攻击达到98%准确率，并验证了资源与功耗的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机自主服务因移动性、灵活性、低成本及多传感器集成能力而广泛应用，但运行故障或网络攻击会造成严重经济损失与安全风险。传统安全措施受限于无人机计算资源与电量有限，且其运行具有时序与顺序特性，难以适用，因此需要适配的安全与可靠性保障方案。

Method: 利用具有时序与顺序分析能力的循环神经网络，重点采用LSTM网络，构建面向自主无人机传感器数据与操作指令的异常检测方法DUDE-IDS；将该IDS直接集成到无人机任务计算机（而非边缘节点或地面站）上，实时监控数据流并检测潜在威胁。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法能有效识别与GPS欺骗、中间人（MITM）、重放和拒绝服务（DoS）攻击相关的异常，准确率达98%；同时在不同配置下评估了资源占用与功耗，证明其可支持无人机实时在线运行。

Conclusion: 基于LSTM的DUDE-IDS可在资源受限的无人机上实现实时、可部署的安全与可靠性监控，为无人机自主服务的安全部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Autonomous drone-based services have been gaining significant interest across various application domains due to their mobility, flexibility, cost-effectiveness, and capability to integrate various sensors and actuators. However, operational failures or cyberattacks targeting drone systems can lead to severe economic impacts and safety concerns. Hence, ensuring secure and reliable autonomous drone operations is essential for the safe deployment of drone-enabled services. Nevertheless, the traditional security measures fall short due to drones' limited computational resources and power budget (battery), as well as the temporal and sequential behavior of drone operations due to drones' mobile nature. In this paper, we address this gap by utilizing Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), specifically focusing on Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, for autonomous drone operation security and reliability due to their temporal and sequential analysis capabilities. We leverage these capabilities for anomaly detection in autonomous drone sensor data and operation commands, which we refer to as Denial of Usage Detection Engine IDS (DUDE-IDS). We integrated the proposed DUDE-IDS into the drone mission computer (i.e., operating directly on drones rather than an edge node or ground control stations) to monitor data flows and to detect potential threats in real-time. Extensive experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach in identifying anomalies associated with GPS spoofing, Man-in-the-Middle (MITM), replay, and Denial-of-Service (DoS) attacks with 98% accuracy. We also evaluate our resource utilization and power consumption under different configurations, demonstrating the applicability of our approach in active drone operations in real-time.

</details>


### [225] [Structural Decomposability of Encrypted Traffic Side-Channel Leakage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19036)
*Guangjie Liu,Guang Cheng,Weiwei Liu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文将加密流量侧信道泄漏从整体量I(X;Y)细化为按包大小、方向、时序三维度的结构化可分解增量，并给出可计算的泄漏核算与防御效能度量方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有侧信道理论把泄漏视为整体量I(X;Y)，未刻画其内部结构，导致无法辨别泄漏由哪个维度主导、防御能否切断下游泄漏，也难以指导多维联合防御设计。

Method: 构建结构因果模型 X→Y_size→Y_dir→Y_time，借助互信息链式法则将总泄漏分解为包大小、方向、时序三项序列增量；将防御形式化为策略变量D的机制替换；用耦合信息 C_size,dir=I(Y_size;Y_dir|X) 度量维度间依赖，以马尔可夫残差给出单维防御可切断下游泄漏的可检验条件；提出因果效能 η_d 量化单位成本抑制率，并在小扰动下给出 Fisher 几何近似 I(X;Y)≈(1/2ln2)Tr(GΣ_θ)。

Result: 在Wang数据集（95个网站）上，无防御时 Y_dir 主导泄漏（0.637 bits），Tor固定512字节信元使 Y_size 退化；FRONT将方向项抑制63%，但马尔可夫残差为0.021 bits（95% CI [0.016,0.027]），表明其无法切断时序泄漏；η_dir=0.97 而 η_time≈0，印证FRONT的设计意图。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了可计算、结构化的泄漏核算方法，能够定位主导泄漏维度、检验防御的可切断性并评估单位成本效能，从而支撑多维度联合防御设计。

Abstract: Existing side-channel theories treat leakage as a holistic quantity $I(X;Y)$, without characterizing its internal structure. This paper studies the \emph{structural decomposability} of encrypted-traffic side-channel leakage. Via the structural causal model $X\!\to\!Y_{\mathrm{size}}\!\to\!Y_{\mathrm{dir}}\!\to\!Y_{\mathrm{time}}$ and the mutual-information chain rule, total leakage is decomposed into three sequential increments for packet size, direction, and timing. Defenses are formalized as mechanism replacement by a strategy variable~$D$; coupling information $C_{\mathrm{size,dir}}=I(Y_{\mathrm{size}};Y_{\mathrm{dir}}\!\mid\!X)$ measures inter-dimensional dependence, and the Markov residual gives a testable condition for a single-dimension defense to sever downstream leakage. Causal efficacy~$η_d$ quantifies per-unit-cost suppression, and a Fisher-geometric approximation $I(X;Y)\approx\frac{1}{2\ln 2}\mathrm{Tr}(GΣ_θ)$ holds under small perturbations. On the Wang dataset (95 websites), $Y_{\mathrm{dir}}$ dominates undefended leakage (0.637\,bits), while Tor's fixed 512-byte cells make $Y_{\mathrm{size}}$ degenerate; FRONT suppresses the direction term by 63\%, yet its Markov residual of 0.021\,bits (95\% CI $[0.016,0.027]$) shows it cannot sever timing leakage; $η_{\mathrm{dir}}=0.97$ vs. $η_{\mathrm{time}}\approx 0$ confirms FRONT's design intent. This yields a computable, structured leakage-accounting method for multi-dimensional joint defense design.

</details>


### [226] [When Agents Look Like Beacons: NIDS Evasion by Model Context Protocol Traffic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19091)
*Muhammad Abdullah Sohail*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该研究揭示Model Context Protocol（MCP）流量在企业网络中与C2信标行为高度相似，但标准IDS与RITA行为评分在测试床中均无法将其识别为异常（信标评分恒为0.0，ET Open规则集告警近乎为零），并提出Agent-Native ALPN与带外头部等原生网络指示标准以弥合可见性缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MCP通过Streamable HTTP标准化AI代理与远程工具的通信，使机器生成、已认证、高频的JSON-RPC流量直接进入企业网络。传统防御依赖"机器化节奏"作为妥协指标，但缺乏网络层显式标记的MCP流量在结构与时间上酷似Cobalt Strike等APT的轮询式C2信标，存在被误判或漏检的理论风险，亟需实证检验当前检测体系的实际可见性。

Method: 构建基于Docker的受控测试床，模拟11种经数学定义的流量剖面，覆盖三种TLS条件（不透明TLS、TLS检查、明文）；以Suricata进行签名匹配、RITA进行行为信标评分，针对MCP JSON-RPC模式评估检测效果，并考察时间抖动（jitter）与TLS检查可见性的影响。

Result: MCP流量在测试配置中无论时间抖动或TLS检查如何，均规避检测：RITA行为信标评分始终为0.0，Suricata在Emerging Threats（ET）Open规则集下内容告警近乎为零。不透明TLS虽隐藏HTTP内容，却暴露流级时序特征，但面向传统恶意软件调优的NIDS启发式规则未能标记生成式AI推理循环特有的对数正态到达间隔分布。

Conclusion: 现有企业IDS与行为信标评分框架无法将MCP远程工具使用识别为异常，形成实测可见性缺口。研究提出面向代理的"Agent-Native"网络指示标准，包括Agent-Native ALPN与标准化带外头部，以实现MCP流量的可标识与可检测。

Abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes communication between autonomous Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents and remote tools over Streamable HTTP. This shift introduces a class of machine-generated, authenticated, and high-frequency JSON-RPC traffic directly into enterprise networks. Enterprise network defenders have historically relied on machine-like cadence as an Indicator of Compromise (IoC). In this study, we show that without explicit network-layer indication, MCP traffic structurally and temporally resembles Command and Control (C2) beaconing behavior, specifically the polling architectures used by advanced persistent threats like Cobalt Strike. Counter to theoretical assumptions about machine-generated polling, our measurements reveal a visibility gap: standard enterprise Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) and behavioral beacon-scoring frameworks do not classify MCP remote tool usage as anomalous within our testbed scope. Through a controlled Docker-based testbed simulating eleven mathematically defined traffic profiles across three TLS conditions (Opaque, TLS-Inspected, and Cleartext), we evaluate Suricata signature matching and RITA behavioral scoring against MCP JSON-RPC patterns. Our results show that MCP traffic, regardless of temporal smearing (jitter) or TLS inspection visibility, evades detection within this configuration, yielding a consistent 0.0 behavioral beacon score and near-zero IDS content alerts under the Emerging Threats (ET) Open ruleset. While opaque TLS obscures HTTP content, it exposes agent traffic to flow-level temporal analysis; however, NIDS heuristics tuned to identify traditional malware do not flag the lognormal inter-arrival distributions characteristic of generative AI reasoning loops. To address this gap, we propose an agent-native network indication standard including Agent-Native ALPN and standardized out-of-band headers.

</details>


### [227] [Characterizing Network Centralization and Observability in the Remote MCP Ecosystem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19100)
*Muhammad Abdullah Sohail*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文提出三级可观测性框架（O_0 目录元数据、O_1 被动合规信号、O_2 实时漏洞分析），对179个远程MCP端点进行实证刻画，揭示基础设施高度集中（ASN分布的HHI=0.736）、认证机制由托管平台主导（95%商业PaaS强制网关级OAuth 2.1 + PKCE），并指出平台级认证与自动化漏洞扫描能力之间存在"安全—可观测性权衡"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MCP已成为自主智能体连接外部数据源与执行环境的主流接口，但其生态正从本地进程执行转向远程Streamable HTTP部署，这一转变在规模化场景下引入了尚未被测量的架构与安全约束，亟需对公共MCP服务器生态进行实证刻画。

Method: 构建三级可观测性框架：O_0（目录元数据）、O_1（被动合规信号）、O_2（实时漏洞分析）；从两个主要公共注册表抽取179个远程端点组成分层样本，并在ASN分布上计算赫芬达尔—赫希曼指数（HHI）以衡量基础设施集中度，同时分析认证机制与托管平台选择之间的关联。

Result: ASN分布的HHI为0.736，远高于0.25的高度集中市场阈值，表明基础设施显著整合；服务器认证与托管平台选择强相关，而非由单个运营者配置决定，95%的商业PaaS托管服务器强制实施网关级OAuth 2.1 + PKCE。

Conclusion: 当前MCP生态存在"安全—可观测性权衡"：保障多数服务器安全的平台级认证机制同时限制了自动化漏洞扫描能力，使AI网关运营者在未预先获取凭证的情况下难以评估工具投毒向量。

Abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has emerged as the dominant interface for connecting autonomous agents to external data sources and execution environments. The ecosystem's transition from local process execution to remote Streamable HTTP deployments introduces unmeasured architectural and security constraints at scale. This paper presents a three-tier observability framework comprising catalog metadata (O_0), passive compliance signals (O_1), and live vulnerability analysis (O_2), applied to empirically characterize the public MCP server ecosystem. Evaluation of a stratified sample of 179 remote endpoints across two primary public registries reveals significant infrastructural consolidation. The Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI) computed over the Autonomous System Number (ASN) distribution yields a value of 0.736, well above the 0.25 threshold for a highly concentrated market. Analysis further indicates that server authentication is strongly correlated with hosting platform choice rather than individual operator configuration, with 95\% of commercial PaaS-hosted servers enforcing gateway-level OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. The empirical results identify a Security-Observability Tradeoff observed in the current ecosystem: the platform-level authentication mechanisms that secure the majority of servers simultaneously limit automated vulnerability scanning capabilities, constraining the ability of AI gateway operators to assess tool-poisoning vectors without prior credential provisioning.

</details>


### [228] [AgentLSD: Evaluating AI Security Agents Under Adversarial Task Contamination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19140)
*Matteo Golinelli,Idilio Drago,Matteo Boffa,Francesco Bergadano,Bruno Crispo*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentLSD 框架，用于研究对抗性任务污染（adversarial task contamination）：即安全类 AI agent 环境中的欺骗性证据（如假 flag、误导性提示、诱饵端点）对 agent 行为的影响，而非仅限提示注入式的指令攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全领域的 AI agent 需要检查网页、源码、日志、配置等环境，这些环境可能包含影响 agent 行为的欺骗性内容。现有安全研究主要关注 prompt injection（依赖攻击者提供的指令），但忽略了非指令性的欺骗证据（如伪造结果、诱饵端点），即"任务污染"。作者希望系统性地隔离并量化这一威胁。

Method: 提出 AgentLSD 受控实验框架，以 CTF（Capture the Flag）挑战为实验环境。在保留原始解题路径的前提下注入陷阱工件（假 flag、误导性提示、诱饵端点、隐藏线索）。框架支持：
- 干净（clean）与陷阱增强（trap-augmented）的配对实验；
- 确定性陷阱生成（deterministic trap generation）；
- 运行时注入（runtime injection）；
- 遥测（telemetry）与投递验证（delivery verification）。
在 11 个 Web CTF 挑战上评估 6 个模型。

Result: 干净条件下，agent 攻破 41% 的 flag，且没有任何模型能解出全部挑战。注入陷阱后，即使 agent 最终仍找到 flag，其交互轮数（turns）增加约 20，推理 token 增加约 2k。解决率（solve-rate）影响异质性强：部分"模型-挑战"组合几乎不受影响，另一些则跟随诱饵或提交错误 flag。结果表明，干净条件下的 CTF 表现低估了 agent 对欺骗性任务证据的脆弱性。

Conclusion: AgentLSD 成功隔离并量化了对抗性任务污染的影响，提供了一个可复现的基准，并公开框架、配置、陷阱规范与原始 trace，供后续研究使用。

Abstract: AI agents for security inspect web pages, source code, logs, configuration files, and command outputs. These environments may contain deceptive artifacts that influence the agent's behavior. We call this adversarial task contamination. Whereas prompt injection relies on attacker-supplied instructions, task contamination also includes non-instructional evidence, such as fake results and decoy endpoints. We present AgentLSD, a controlled framework for studying adversarial task contamination. AgentLSD uses Capture the Flag (CTF) challenges as its experimental environment. We inject trap artifacts, such as fake flags, misleading hints, decoy endpoints, and hidden cues, while preserving the intended CTF solution. The framework supports paired clean and trap-augmented experiments with deterministic trap generation, runtime injection, telemetry, and delivery verification. We evaluate six models on 11 web CTF challenges. In the clean condition, agents capture 41% of the flags, and no model solves every challenge. We then measure the impact of task contamination. Even when the agent still recovers the flag, traps increase the number of turns (+20) and reasoning tokens (+2k). Solve-rate effects are more heterogeneous, as some model-challenge pairs are largely unaffected while others follow decoys or submit wrong flags. These results show that clean CTF performance understates vulnerability to deceptive task evidence. AgentLSD isolates this effect and provides a reproducible benchmark for studying it. We release the framework, configurations, trap specifications, and raw traces.

</details>

### [229] [Pay Only for Disagreement: Certified No-Regression Verdicts for Model Updates with Matching Label-Complexity Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17560)
*Vishnu Bindu Balachandran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将模型更新上线（promotion）形式化为"成对风险差认证审计"问题，利用"风险差只存在于两模型输出不一致的输入上"这一支撑集恒等式，提出零标签与审计标签两级序列协议DISCERN，实现有限样本有效性、最优标签复杂度，并在785组更新对上验证了高功效、低误覆盖与显著标签节省。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产环境中的模型会因重训练、微调、量化或供应商静默替换而不断更新，每次更新都可能劣于被替换的版本，因此需要在上线前/后对更新进行可靠的风险差异审计。然而传统审计需要标注数据，标签成本高，且模型长期持续更新要求在一个统一误差预算下可复用的认证机制。

Method: 核心是支撑集恒等式：两模型的风险差仅由二者预测不一致的输入决定，且该不一致可无标签观测。基于此构建DISCERN两级序列协议：零标签层仅用无标注流量，在不一致率低于容差时直接认证良性更新；审计层只对采样到的不一致样本打标签，并采用anytime-valid置信序列，使其在任何停止时间、任何标签路由规则（含对抗性判官）下均有效。理论上证明有限样本有效性，并给出速率层面rho^2/eps^2量级的标签复杂度匹配下界。

Result: 在785组更新对、14000+条重放审计流（含最大14亿参数语言模型的LoRA微调）上，误覆盖率仅0.0002（标称5%），功效0.986且零误报，56%的良性更新实现零标签认证。理论上，利用免费的不一致信息相比任何配对盲审计器可证明节省1/rho倍标签，且保证可在单一误差预算下跨无界更新序列复合。

Conclusion: 该工作将模型更新上线转化为可认证的成对风险差审计，通过免标签的不一致信息与anytime-valid序列方法同时获得有效性、标签效率与长期复合保证，每次审计还输出可机器校验的证据记录，适用于更新后市场监管。

Abstract: Every production model is updated, by retraining, fine-tuning, quantization, or a silent vendor swap, and each update risks being worse than what it replaced. We formalize update promotion as certified paired risk-difference auditing. Our starting point is a support identity: the risk difference between two models lives on the inputs where they disagree, observable without labels. We build DISCERN, a sequential two-tier protocol. A zero-label tier certifies benign updates whose disagreement rate is below tolerance from unlabeled traffic alone. An audited tier labels only sampled disagreements through an anytime-valid confidence sequence, valid at every stopping time and under any label-routing rule, even an adversarial judge. We prove finite-sample validity and matching label-complexity bounds of order rho^2/eps^2 at the rate level, so exploiting free disagreement provably saves a factor 1/rho over any pairing-blind auditor, and the guarantee composes across an unbounded sequence of promotions from one error budget. Across 14,000+ replayed audit streams over 785 update pairs, including LoRA fine-tunes of language models up to 1.4B parameters, miscoverage is 0.0002 (nominal 5%), power 0.986 with zero false alarms, and 56% of benign updates certify with zero labels. Each audit emits a machine-checkable evidence record for post-market monitoring.

</details>


### [230] [Beyond Static RAG: An Adaptive, Tri-Metric Routing Framework for Efficient Long-Context Inference on Commodity GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17564)
*Saipraveen Vabbilisetty,Ajay Kumar Boddepalli,Deep Narayan Mishra,Shashank Kapadia,Haoan Wang,Anupriya Sharma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在16GB显存的T4上部署RAG时存在"压缩悖论"：神经压缩带来的KV缓存争用与预处理延迟可能抵消其收益，但不压缩又会在长上下文下OOM。作者提出免训练、确定性的Tri-Metric Router，基于显存余量等硬件物理信号在Raw、LLMLingua-2与BM25三条管线间做调度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在T4等消费级GPU（16GB显存）上部署RAG存在实际失效问题：神经提示压缩会引入KV缓存争用和预处理延迟，其开销可能超过生成阶段的节省；而完全不压缩又会在长上下文时导致显存溢出（OOM）。现有工作多基于语义自适应，缺少面向硬件物理约束的调度方法。

Method: 指出vLLM服务的LLM与PyTorch压缩器在紧张显存预算下联合部署时的两种失效机制。提出Tri-Metric Router：一种确定性、免训练的策略，在Raw、Neural（LLMLingua-2）、Lexical（BM25）三种管线间选择。调度使用三个CPU侧信号：空间复杂度L、句法密度ρ_key、类符形符比TTR；判别信号为硬件物理量，基于显存余量与延迟交叉点。阈值通过在LongBench qasper上做profiling校准，T4上交叉点约为4,332词，强调贡献是校准方法论而非硬件特定常数。

Result: 在分布外留出集上，该方法实现0% OOM失败，88.5±4.4%的oracle对齐率，Combined F1为49.3%，较始终启用词法压缩提升5.2个百分点，且不增加额外显存或训练成本。

Conclusion: 面向消费级GPU的RAG部署，基于硬件物理信号的免训练路由可有效兼顾显存受限与质量：规避OOM的同时保持较高输出质量，且具备可迁移的阈值校准方法而非依赖特定硬件常数。

Abstract: Deploying retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) on commodity GPUs such as the NVIDIA T4 (16 GB VRAM) exposes a practical failure mode we call the Compression Paradox: neural prompt compression can add key-value (KV) cache contention and preprocessing latency that outweigh generation-time savings, while skipping compression can cause out-of-memory (OOM) failures on long contexts. We identify two distinct failure mechanisms when a vLLM-served LLM and a PyTorch-based compressor are co-deployed under tight memory budgets, and introduce the Tri-Metric Router, a deterministic, training-free policy that selects among Raw, Neural (LLMLingua-2), and Lexical (BM25) pipelines. The router uses three CPU-side signals: spatial complexity ($L$), syntactic density ($ρ_{key}$), and type-token ratio (TTR). Unlike prior semantic-only adaptation, our dispatch signal is hardware-physical, based on VRAM headroom and a latency crossover point. Thresholds are calibrated from profiling on LongBench qasper, yielding an operating crossover near 4,332 words on T4; our contribution is this calibration methodology rather than a hardware-specific constant. On out-of-distribution holdouts, the method achieves 0% OOM failures, 88.5 $\pm$ 4.4% oracle alignment, and 49.3% Combined F1, improving over always-on lexical compression by 5.2 points without additional VRAM or training cost.

</details>


### [231] [Where Grokking Happens: Distributed Utility and Fourier Recoding Without a Module Switch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17571)
*Dekun Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 Transition Games（行为对齐的精确激活博弈，含配对非泛化控制），研究发现从记忆到泛化的转变是既有分布式电路的谱重编码，而非模块切换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 回答"Transformer 中记忆到泛化的转变在功能上表达于何处"这一问题，并检验"MLP 记忆、注意力泛化"的流行预测。

Method: 引入 Transition Games：行为对齐的精确激活博弈，并设置配对的非泛化控制；结合替换博弈（replacement games）与不相交的精确路径研究（exact path study），考察 block-0 注意力偏置、二阶模（degree-two modes）、block-1 MLP 下游路径等。

Result: 发现分布式效用增益，并伴随一个前瞻性的 block-0 注意力偏置；所选二阶模在替换博弈中占其加法对比的 67–92%；不相交精确路径研究显示，block-1 MLP 在 12/12 对中比所有其他被测下游路径中介了更多效应。相反，"MLP 记忆、注意力泛化"的更锐利预测出现反转（记忆锚点处 -0.331 bits/example；预测方向 0/12）。路由起始、全局秩崩塌与素数不变架构脊（prime-invariant architecture ridge）也都不成立。
