Method: 作者设计并实现了一个名为 RLLBC-Lib 的代码库，包含三部分内容：一是全面的表格型 RL 方法库，用于强化对理论基础的清晰理解；二是遵循相同设计原则的深度 RL 库，以凸显简单表格型方法与最先进深度 RL 方法之间的对应关系；三是若干实现示例，用于阐释 RL 核心原理，并将 RL 与其他基于学习的控制方法进行对比。

Result: RLLBC-Lib 提供了一个统一、易用的教学代码库：（1）表格型 RL 方法库便于理解理论基础；（2）深度 RL 库与表格型方法在设计原则上保持一致，展示了两者的平行关系；（3）附带核心 RL 原理的实现示例及与其他基于学习的控制方法的对比；（4）可作为创建带自动评分的编程作业的理想基础。

Conclusion: RLLBC-Lib 通过精心设计的代码库，有效降低了学习基于学习的控制中强化学习的入门门槛，既服务于教学理解，也支持自动评分作业的构建，是 RL 教育与学习的有力工具。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is an exciting concept as well as a remarkable success story worth sharing. However, RL builds on rather complex interactions between different objects that play out over several cycles. Such dynamics are often best explained with an easily accessible implementation. We present RLLBC-Lib, a carefully crafted code library with the goal of lowering the entry barrier for students and other learners of RL in the context of learning-based control. At its heart, RLLBC-Lib comprises a comprehensive library of tabular RL approaches to enforce a clear understanding of the theoretical foundations. A deep RL library follows the same design principles, underscoring the parallels between simple tabular and state-of-the-art deep RL approaches. Additionally, RLLBC-Lib provides a collection of implementations illustrating core RL principles and contrasting RL to other learning-based control approaches. Finally, RLLBC-Lib provides an ideal basis for creating programming assignments with automated grading.

</details>


### [332] [Double descent is the principle of least action](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19076)
*Congzhou M Sha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用统计力学解释双下降现象：SGD训练轨迹被视为在训练损失能量景观上扩散的粒子，有限扩散时间产生有效权重衰减，使每个参数成为二次自由度；装备均分定理按T/2分配能量，固定损失下增加参数数d会降低温度、使玻尔兹曼分布趋向平稳路径，从而等效增强权重正则化，导致测试误差先降后升再降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双下降现象（测试误差随参数数d先下降、在恰能拟合训练数据处出现峰值、再下降）此前虽被广泛观测，但缺乏统一的机理解释。本文旨在用统计力学的框架为这一现象提供理论说明。

Method: 将随机梯度法的训练轨迹建模为在诱导温度T下、在训练损失能量景观上漫游的粒子；经平衡的轨迹遵循统计力学基本假设，即以玻尔兹曼分布的概率等频访问给定训练损失下的每个参数向量。因训练从初始点出发且扩散时间有限，产生等效权重衰减，使每个参数成为二次自由度；再用能量均分定理将能量以T/2份额分配给d个自由度。

Result: 在固定训练损失下，增加参数会降低温度，推动玻尔兹曼分布向平稳路径收敛；同时增加参数只会降低平稳路径的L²范数，因此固定损失下采样到的解随d增大更不易变大，等效于增强权重正则化。这两个效应共同刻画了双下降曲线。

Conclusion: 双下降现象可由统计力学自然导出：有限时间扩散带来的有效权重衰减、能量均分与平稳路径范数随d下降，共同构成统一解释，为理解过参数化模型的泛化行为提供了物理视角。

Abstract: The test error of a model plotted against its number of parameters $d$ falls, peaks when the model can just fit the training data, and falls again, exhibiting the double descent phenomenon. We explain the phenomenon with statistical mechanics. The training trajectory of a stochastic gradient-based method is a particle wandering over the energy landscape of the training loss at an induced temperature $T$, and a run that has equilibrated visits every parameter vector of a given training loss equally often, the fundamental postulate of statistical mechanics, with probability given by the Boltzmann distribution. Because training starts at an initial point and has only finite time to diffuse, it carries an effective weight decay, which makes every parameter a quadratic degree of freedom. The equipartition theorem then distributes the energy among the $d$ degrees of freedom in shares of $T/2$, so at a fixed training loss adding parameters lowers the temperature and drives the Boltzmann distribution toward the stationary path. Finally, adding parameters can only lower the $L^2$ norm of the stationary path, so a solution sampled at fixed loss is less likely to be large with increasing $d$, effectively increasing weight regularization.

</details>


### [333] [Probabilistic Linear Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19077)
*Frederic Koriche,Jean-Marie Lagniez,Chi Tran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于稀疏锚定线性模型的统一概率可解释性框架，适用于二分类与连续回归，兼具理论保证与实证优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 形式化可解释性虽具数学基础，但溯因解释常涉及过多特征而超出人类认知极限，且概率松弛方法此前多局限于分类任务，缺乏对回归的统一处理。

Method: 将实例映射到布尔超立方体，用稀疏锚定线性模型给出解释，严格推广基于子集的方法并施加稀疏预算k；证明神经网络下最小化相关误差为NP^PP-hard，并将其关联至可处理的保真误差代理；采用MIP求最优解（多项式样本复杂度）与多项式时间IHT算法（具近似保证）两种互补方法。

Result: 对参数化局部分布族，任意k-稀疏解释的相关误差被其保真误差以局部较小的乘性因子界定；实验表明相比LIME、MAPLE，本方法构造上同时满足锚定与稀疏约束，且相关误差更低。

Conclusion: 该框架统一了分类与回归的概率可解释性，理论上刻画了相关误差与保真误差的关系并给出可处理求解途径，实证上优于现有基线。

Abstract: Formal explainability provides mathematically grounded justifications for individual predictions. However, abductive explanations often exceed human cognitive limits by involving too many features, while probabilistic relaxations have remained largely limited to categorical classification. We present a unified framework for probabilistic explainability based on sparse, anchored linear models, applicable to both binary classification and continuous regression. By mapping instances to the Boolean hypercube, our linear explanations strictly generalize subset-based approaches: they capture both the magnitude and direction of feature contributions while enforcing a prescribed sparsity budget $k$. We show that minimizing the relevance error for such explanations is \ClassNPPP-hard when the underlying model is a neural network, and we relate this intractable objective to a tractable surrogate---the fidelity error. For a parameterized family of local distributions, the relevance error of any $k$-sparse explanation is bounded by its fidelity error up to a multiplicative factor that remains small locally. We address the resulting empirical problem using two complementary approaches: a Mixed Integer Programming (MIP) formulation that yields provably optimal empirical solutions while maintaining polynomial sample complexity, and a polynomial-time Iterative Hard Thresholding (IHT) algorithm with provable approximation guarantees. Empirical evaluations show that, unlike state-of-the-art baselines such as LIME and MAPLE, our explanations satisfy both the anchoring and sparsity constraints by construction, while consistently achieving lower relevance error.

</details>


### [334] [Evidence-Grounded Agentic Formulation Development in an Autonomous Laboratory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19099)
*Michael M. Craig,Riley J. Hickman,Yingshan Ma,Rémi Piché-Taillefer,Christine Allen,Pauric Bannigan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出智能体系统 Andromeda 2，通过结构化内部实验证据推理并调用计算与实验工具，迭代设计自乳化给药系统（SEDDS）配方，在紫杉醇任务上显著优于概率优化模型 Andromeda 1 与传统湿实验 DoE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SEDDS 可提升难溶性药物的口服生物利用度，但筛选高性能配方依赖大量实验，成本高、周期长，亟需减少实验负担的高效设计方法。

Method: Andromeda 2 为智能体（agentic）系统，基于结构化内部实验证据进行推理，并调用计算与实验工具，批次化设计并执行配方；在匹配预算下使用小型化自动化实验室，与 Andromeda 1（已部署于数十个在研项目的概率优化模型）及湿实验 DoE 方案进行基准对比，并开展消融实验。

Result: 紫杉醇任务中：高性能命中率 50%（Andromeda 2）vs 17%（Andromeda 1）vs 2%（DoE）；满足全部四项 TPP 目标的配方数分别为 12、6、0；中位 AUC10-240 分别为 70.1、12.0、3.5 mg·min/mL，最大 AUC 上 Andromeda 2 与 Andromeda 1 相当；入选的全 TPP 配方首次 FaSSIF 测定表观有效载药量 19±5% w/w，约为文献 S-SEDDS 5.7% w/w 的 3.3 倍；消融显示接入结构化内部实验证据使平均 AUC 提升 34%。

Conclusion: Andromeda 2 能在同等预算下以更高效率与命中率设计 SEDDS 配方，验证了智能体推理与结构化内部实验证据对配方优化的关键价值，为自动化制剂开发提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Self-emulsifying drug delivery systems (SEDDS) can improve the oral bioavailability of poorly soluble drugs, but identifying high-performing formulations remains experimentally intensive. We present Andromeda 2, an agentic system that reasons over structured in-house experimental evidence and invokes computational and experimental tools to design and execute successive formulation batches. Using a miniaturized automated laboratory at a matched budget, we benchmark it against Andromeda 1, a probabilistic optimization model deployed across dozens of live development projects, and a wet-lab design-of-experiments (DoE) campaign. For paclitaxel, Andromeda 2 achieved a 50% high-performance hit rate versus 17% for Andromeda 1 and 2% for DoE, and identified 12 formulations meeting all four target product profile (TPP) objectives versus 6 and 0, respectively. Median $AUC_{10-240}$ was 70.1, 12.0, and 3.5 mg$\cdot$min/mL, while maximum AUC was comparable between Andromeda 2 and Andromeda 1. A selected full-TPP formulation achieved an apparent effective paclitaxel loading of $19 \pm 5\%$ w/w at the first FaSSIF measurement, approximately 3.3-fold higher than the 5.7% w/w loading reported for a published paclitaxel S-SEDDS. A controlled ablation showed that access to structured in-house experimental evidence increased mean AUC by 34%.

</details>


### [335] [How Model Growth, Recursion, and Boundary Operators Influence Scaling Exponents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19107)
*Zixi Chen,Akshay Vegesna,Samip Dahal,Andrew Gordon Wilson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出并验证：架构干预（尤其是循环Transformer/递归深度与模型增长）能够改变预训练缩放指数，实现随计算量呈指数级提升的性能，从而突破传统缩放律的认知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统缩放律认为损失随计算量按固定指数下降，架构干预一般不被视为能改变缩放指数。作者希望探究架构设计（如循环深度、模型增长）是否能改变缩放行为，从而在给定算力下获得更高的计算效率。

Method: 以looped transformer为锚点，将循环（递归深度）作为训练中增加循环次数以实现模型增长（model growth）的机制，分别考察带权共享与不带权共享的增长方式；同时在vanilla transformer中引入boundary operator（归一化并注入早期block）。在数据受限、多epoch设定下分析循环的regularization作用及compute-optimal的循环数随规模的变化。

Result: 模型增长（无论是否共享权重）对缩放指数改变最大：7.4B的model growth架构在CORE上以约20倍更少的算力匹配GPT-3 13B，且计算效率收益随规模增大而增加；boundary operator也能带来随规模增加的计算效率收益，但幅度较小；在数据受限多epoch下，标准循环具有regularizing效果，compute-optimal的循环数随规模增大而增加。

Conclusion: 结果可从“计算深度”视角统一解释：在给定算力预算下，应提升Transformer的可用深度，由此获得的效率增益会随规模增大。

Abstract: Scaling laws predict how loss decreases with increases in computation. We show, contrary to conventional wisdom, that architectural interventions can modify scaling exponents in pre-training, leading to exponential improvements in performance with increases in computation. As an anchoring point, we consider the architectural formulation of looped transformers. Although not typically used in this way, looping, also known as recursive depth, provides a mechanism for model growth, by increasing the number of loops during training. Model growth, with and without shared weights, provides the biggest changes to the scaling exponents. In particular, a 7.4B model growth architecture matches GPT-3 13B on CORE with roughly $20\times$ less compute, and has compute efficiency gains that increase with scale. Moreover, simply using a boundary operator in a vanilla transformer, which normalizes and injects an earlier block, also provides increasing compute-efficiency gains, although to a lesser extent. In the data-constrained, multi-epoch setting, standard looping has a useful regularizing effect, where we find it is compute-optimal to increase the number of loops with scale. These results can be understood through the lens of computational depth: for a given computational budget, we wish to increase the usable depth of the transformer, which can lead to efficiency gains that increase with scale.

</details>


### [336] [Exponential Hardness of Off-Policy Evaluation under History-Dependent Logging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19135)
*Pranaya Jajoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文证明：当数据记录器依赖于历史时，即使日志数据频繁覆盖所有隐藏状态、动作与信念，且满足两类行为边际结果揭示条件，对已知确定性目标策略的价值评估仍可能需指数级样本，从而在历史依赖记录、基于模型的情形下给出不可处理性结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Zhang与Jiang（2025）提出历史依赖记录、基于模型的价值评估问题，并给出行为边际意义下的结果揭示定义。本文旨在检验：在满足覆盖性与揭示性条件下，日志数据是否仍可能对目标策略价值指数级无信息，从而判定该设定是否本质上不可处理。

Method: 对每个视界H≥3，构造两个POMDP，每阶段至多两个隐状态、三个动作，共用一个含三个记忆状态的记录器。验证动作覆盖、信念覆盖以及两种行为边际结果揭示条件均具有与H无关的常数。核心机制是"重置"抹除决定目标价值的未知转移，使得两候选模型虽已知却难以区分。精确刻画由此产生的统计实验，并构造匹配的最优估计器；另用有向双车道网格世界实现该构造并做轨迹仿真。

Result: 在置信度1-δ（0<δ≤1/4）下，即使两候选模型均已知，将已知确定性目标策略评估到精度1/8仍需Θ((3/2)^H log(1/δ))条日志回合。覆盖性与揭示性条件的常数均独立于H。网格世界实现的轨迹仿真与有限样本预测一致。

Conclusion: 在历史依赖记录、基于模型的设定下，覆盖性与行为边际结果揭示条件不足以保证样本有效学习；该问题存在指数级样本下界，即在Zhang与Jiang提出的问题设定下为不可处理。

Abstract: Can a logged dataset visit every hidden state frequently and still be exponentially uninformative about a target policy's value? We show that it can when the logger depends on history. For every horizon $H \ge 3$, we construct two POMDPs with at most two latent states per stage, three actions, and a common logger with three memory states. Action coverage, belief coverage, and two behavior-marginal outcome-revealing conditions all have constants independent of $H$. Nevertheless, evaluating a known deterministic target policy to accuracy $1/8$ requires $Θ((3/2)^H \log(1/δ))$ logged episodes at confidence $1-δ$, for $0 < δ\le 1/4$, even when both candidate models are known. The mechanism is simple: a reset erases the unknown transition that determines the target value. We characterize the resulting statistical experiment exactly and obtain a matching optimal estimator. A directed two-lane gridworld realizes the construction, and trajectory simulations agree with its finite-sample prediction. The result establishes intractability for the history-dependent-logging, model-based case posed by Zhang and Jiang (2025, arXiv:2503.01134), under their behavior-marginal definition of revealing.

</details>


<div id='cs.AR'></div>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [337] [REQAP: Resilient Weight Packing and Quantization for Edge DNN Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17555)
*Mahdi Taheri,Samira Nazari,Mubassher Ansari,Ali Azarpeyvand,Mohsen Afsharchi,Maksim Jenihhin,Christian Herglotz*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出一种面向脉动阵列DNN加速器的可靠性感知量化权重打包方法，结合灵敏度驱动的混合精度量化、寄存器级确定性打包与选择性MSB复制保护，在降低存储与MAC开销的同时增强容错能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘加速器上部署DNN需在易发生硬件故障的环境中兼顾激进模型压缩与可靠性。既有量化与容错方法往往分别优化，未充分利用混合精度下的寄存器空闲空间，导致压缩收益与故障韧性难以协同。

Method: 1）灵敏度驱动的混合精度量化：按层对精度的影响分配位宽，并强制权重与激活采用对称精度；2）确定性寄存器级打包：将多组异构操作数对合并进固定宽度寄存器字，实现SWAR式并行执行，减少存储占用与执行周期；3）选择性位级保护：将关键层的最高有效位（MSB）复制到未使用寄存器空间，以低开销获得TMR式保护；4）搭建脉动阵列仿真框架，在真实执行条件下评估打包与容错机制。

Result: 在AlexNet、VGG-11、ResNet-18上仿真，内存最多减少62%，MAC操作最多减少56%；在故障注入下，相比基线模型与全保护模型，精度韧性显著提升。

Conclusion: 将混合精度量化与寄存器级打包、选择性MSB复制相结合，可在脉动阵列加速器上同时获得存储/计算压缩与容错增益，为边缘DNN部署提供兼顾效率与可靠性的方案。

Abstract: Efficient deployment of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) on edge accelerators requires aggressive model compression while maintaining reliability in fault-prone hardware environments. This paper presents a reliability-aware quantized weight packing methodology for systolic-array-based DNN accelerators. A sensitivity-driven mixed-precision quantization framework assigns layer-wise bit-widths according to accuracy impact while enforcing symmetric precision between weights and activations. A deterministic register-level packing strategy consolidates multiple heterogeneous operand pairs into fixed-width register words, enabling SIMD-within-a-register (SWAR) style parallel execution that reduces both memory footprint and execution cycles. To improve resilience against hardware faults, selective bit-level protection replicates the most significant bits (MSBs) of critical layers into unused register space, achieving TMR-style protection with minimal overhead. A systolic-array simulation framework is developed to evaluate the proposed packing and fault-tolerance mechanisms under realistic execution conditions. Simulations in AlexNet, VGG-11, and ResNet-18 demonstrate up to 62% memory reduction and up to 56% reduction in Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) operations, while significantly improving accuracy resilience under fault injection compared to baseline and fully protected models.

</details>


### [338] [WARD: Runtime Workload-Adaptive Vision TRansformer Framework for Dependable Edge AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17556)
*Mahdi Taheri,Pramit Kumar Bhaduri,Mohammad Masoumi,Ali Mahani*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出 WARD，一种面向边缘部署的运行时自适应 Vision Transformer 框架，结合通道级子网划分、可靠性感知持续学习与动态运行模式调度，在 FPGA 加速器上验证了其低故障率、低面积开销与快速模式切换能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘部署 AI 面临动态变化的功耗预算、可靠性需求与输入分布，需要持续自适应；但现有容错方法假设静态运行条件，持续学习技术忽略在线自适应期间的并发硬件故障，且运行时自适应可靠性框架在可编程 AI 加速器上的实际部署尚缺乏探索。

Method: WARD 采用通道级子网划分，将网络划分为两个物理隔离的子网络；结合可靠性感知持续学习与动态运行模式调度，支持四种运行模式（全精度模式、低功耗模式、高可靠性模式、自适应模式），动态调整计算成本与可靠性并保证实时推理不中断。框架在轻量级 FPGA 加速器上实现，并扩展运行时硬件支持以进行模式调度与资源管理。

Result: 实验表明，所提出的拆分架构在高误码率下网络级故障率仅为 1.79%；硬件实现面积开销低于 5%，并可在数个时钟周期内完成运行时模式切换。

Conclusion: WARD 证明自适应可靠性管理能够以可忽略的实现开销集成到可编程边缘 AI 加速器中，为动态边缘场景下性能、容错与自适应的联合优化提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Edge-deployed AI operate under dynamically changing power budgets, reliability requirements, and input distributions, requiring continuous adaptation. Such conditions arise in long-running edge AI applications, including autonomous systems, industrial monitoring, and satellite onboard intelligence. Existing fault-tolerant methods assume static operating conditions, whereas continual learning techniques neglect concurrent hardware faults during online adaptation. Moreover, the practical deployment of runtime-adaptive reliability frameworks on programmable AI accelerators remains largely unexplored.
  This paper presents WARD, a runtime-adaptive Vision Transformer framework that combines channel-wise subnetwork partitioning, reliability-aware continual learning, and dynamic operating-mode scheduling to jointly optimize performance, fault tolerance, and adaptation according to runtime conditions. Two physically isolated subnetworks execute under four operating modes (i.e. Full-Precision Mode, Low-Power Mode, High-Reliability Mode, and Adaptive Mode) that dynamically adjust computational cost and reliability while ensuring uninterrupted inference for real-time requirements. To validate the practical deployability of the proposed framework, WARD is implemented on a lightweight FPGA-based accelerator extended with runtime hardware support for mode scheduling and resource management. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed split architecture achieves a network-level failure rate of only 1.79% under high Bit Error Rates. The hardware implementation incurs less than 5% area overhead and supports runtime mode transitions within few clock cycles, demonstrating that adaptive reliability management can be integrated into programmable edge AI accelerators with negligible implementation overhead.

</details>


### [339] [Lyapunov-based analysis of functional stability for edge computing systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17569)
*Oleksii S. Bychkov*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出将边缘计算的\"功能稳定性\"概念与Lyapunov直接法相连接，给出强/弱两种形式的构造性验证方法，并处理服务迁移与节点故障切换的切换动态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘计算中\"功能稳定性\"被提出作为一种以单个服务为分析单元、以连续质量函数和逐功能阈值替代二元成败判断的可靠性概念。然而，要针对具体的边缘编排器、迁移策略或分布式推理服务验证这些性质，缺乏一种构造性方法。

Method: 将功能稳定性与Lyapunov直接法建立联系：用可行域的正不变性刻画强形式；将弱形式与一致最终有界性及输入到状态稳定性相联系，并给出解析的恢复时间界；针对服务迁移和节点故障切换导致的切换动态，采用公共Lyapunov函数处理；同时提出有限时域变体以适配任务有界的边缘工作负载。

Result: 建立了功能稳定性的Lyapunov理论表征框架：强形式↔可行域正不变性，弱形式↔一致最终有界性/输入到状态稳定性并具解析恢复时间界，切换动态可由公共Lyapunov函数分析，并给出有限时域扩展。

Conclusion: 该工作为边缘计算的功能稳定性提供了构造性验证工具，使可靠性分析可落到具体的编排、迁移与推理服务实现上，并覆盖切换动态与任务有界场景。

Abstract: Functional stability has been proposed as a per-function reliability concept for edge computing, in which the unit of analysis is the individual service rather than the whole system and the binary working/failed evaluation is replaced by a continuous quality function with per-function thresholds. Verifying these properties for a concrete edge orchestrator, migration policy, or distributed inference service requires a constructive method. This article connects functional stability to the direct Lyapunov method. The strong form is characterized through positive invariance of the admissible region; the weak form is connected to uniform ultimate boundedness and input-to-state stability with analytical recovery-time bounds. Switched dynamics from service migration and node failover are treated via common Lyapunov functions. Finite-horizon variants address mission-bounded edge workloads.

</details>


### [340] [FAME: An FPGA-Based Platform for Approximate Multipliers Evaluation with Pattern-Guided DNN Retraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17730)
*Rappy Saha,Nima Amirafshar,Jude Haris,Nima Taherinejad,José Cano*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出基于FPGA的近似乘法器评估平台FAME，直接用硬件实现近似乘法器，避免CPU/GPU查表仿真开销，并引入模式引导的DNN重训练以缓解精度下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近似乘法器可降低DNN推理的硬件面积与能耗，但会引入计算误差。在多种近似乘法器设计、多样DNN模型和大规模数据集上评估精度十分困难：CPU/GPU上基于查找表（LUT）的仿真速度慢，评估开销大；且精度退化需量化并在必要时通过重训练缓解，进一步增加评估成本。

Method: 提出FPGA平台FAME，利用FPGA可重构逻辑将近似乘法器直接以硬件实现，取代CPU/GPU上的LUT仿真，从而高效执行DNN推理并大幅缩短大数据集评估时间；同时提出模式引导的DNN重训练技术，以乘法器特有的模式指导重训练，恢复近似乘法器导致的精度损失。

Result: 在ImageNet数据集上，用ResNet-18和MobileNetV2两个DNN模型评估27种近似乘法器。推理阶段相比已有LUT仿真方法最高实现3.47倍加速；所提重训练技术相比现有重训练方法，在所评估乘法器上最高提升精度65.5%。

Conclusion: FAME通过FPGA硬件实现近似乘法器并结合模式引导重训练，显著降低近似乘法器的评估时间并有效恢复精度损失，为近似乘法器在大规模DNN推理中的评估提供了高效方案。

Abstract: Approximate multipliers can reduce hardware area and energy consumption in Deep Neural Network (DNN) inference; however, they introduce computational errors. Assessing the accuracy of numerous approximate multiplier designs across diverse DNN models and large-scale datasets remains challenging due to prohibitive evaluation times. This overhead primarily stems from the slow emulation of approximate multiplier behavior using look-up tables (LUTs) on CPU and GPU platforms. Moreover, the resulting accuracy degradation must be carefully quantified and, if necessary, mitigated (e.g., through retraining), further increasing the overall evaluation cost. To address these challenges, we propose FAME, an FPGA-based platform for evaluating approximate multipliers. The platform exploits the reconfigurable logic of Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) to implement approximate multipliers directly in hardware, eliminating the need for LUT-based emulation on CPU/GPU platforms and thereby enabling efficient DNN inference while significantly reducing evaluation time on large datasets. Furthermore, we introduce a pattern-guided DNN retraining technique to mitigate accuracy degradation induced by approximate multipliers. Specifically, retraining is guided by multiplier-specific patterns to effectively recover potential accuracy losses. We evaluate FAME using two DNN models, ResNet-18 and MobileNetV2, on the ImageNet dataset across 27 approximate multipliers. During inference, our approach achieves up to a 3.47x speedup in approximate multiplier evaluation compared to prior LUT-based emulation methods. Furthermore, the proposed retraining technique improves accuracy by up to 65.5% over existing retraining approaches for the evaluated multipliers. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/gicLAB/FAME

</details>


### [341] [Demystifying Gate-Level Localization of RTL Trojans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17922)
*Navid Nader Tehrani,Azadeh Davoodi,Rasit Onur Topaloglu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出LoRD，一种基于启发式的轻量级硬件木马检测与定位方法，利用RTL木马综合后稳定的结构与信号流子图特征，在ICCAD 2025竞赛测例上实现近乎完美的检测与定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RTL级插入的硬件木马经综合后常被门级网表优化所掩盖，威胁严重；现有工作（如ICCAD 2025竞赛）多依赖机器学习在带标签网表上做无黄金芯片检测，但存在数据与调参开销大的问题。

Method: 观察并利用RTL木马在综合后仍保持稳定的结构模式与信号流模式，提出轻量级启发式方法LoRD，通过识别这些独特的子图签名进行针对性检测与定位，而非通用的ML特征学习。

Result: 在竞赛测例上实现近乎完美的检测与定位；相较基于Transformer的ML基线和前五名参赛队伍，LoRD在植入木马设计上平均得分2.957（满分3），且无需数据与调参开销。

Conclusion: 针对RTL木马综合后的子图签名，启发式方法可超越通用ML方案，实现高精度、低开销的木马检测与定位。

Abstract: Hardware Trojans are malicious modifications that compromise functionality or leak sensitive data. They pose a severe threat, particularly when inserted at the Register Transfer Level (RTL). After synthesis, these Trojans are often concealed by optimizations in gate-level netlists. Recent efforts, including the ICCAD 2025 contest, emphasize golden-chip-free detection using machine learning (ML) on labeled netlists. In this work, we show that RTL Trojans exhibit stable structural and signal-flow patterns post-synthesis, enabling effective detection through targeted heuristics rather than generic ML feature learning. We propose LoRD, a lightweight heuristic-based approach that exploits these distinctive subgraph signatures, achieving near-perfect detection and localization on the contest testcases. Com- pared to a transformer-based ML baseline and top five teams, LoRD achieves on-average a score of 2.957 (out of 3) for Trojan- implanted designs without the data and tuning overhead.

</details>


### [342] [VeriBugBench: An Empirically Grounded Framework for Constructing Verilog RTL Debugging Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18022)
*Xiankai Meng,Kejian Feng,Xinlin Zhao,Zhuo Zhang,Yan Lei,Xiaoguang Mao,Jiang Wu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出 VeriBugBench 框架，用于构建 Verilog RTL 调试基准，并发布了包含 2,608 个可执行单故障实例的 VeriBugBench-v1.0。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RTL 源码级调试研究需要同时提供故障设计、精确变更位置、可执行测试激励和可复现配置的基准工件，但现有 Verilog 资源通常只能提供其中部分要素，缺乏完整、可执行的调试基准。

Method: 该框架通过三条路径构建基准：基于 RTL 缺陷修复历史中反复出现的多粒度修复模式，构建变异库，映射为 19 个可执行逆算子；利用 LLM 从干净 DUT 和原始 testbench 生成针对特定设计的激励阶段，并与原始 testbench 组合用于候选执行；再通过执行筛选保留有效实例。

Result: 在 45 个开源项目上应用该框架得到 VeriBugBench-v1.0，包含 2,608 个可执行单故障实例，其故障效应可在设计输出端观测；组装后的 testbench 将项目级平均故障可观测率从 36.01% 提升至 39.54%，并平均改善了行覆盖率和执行轨迹多样性。

Conclusion: VeriBugBench 提供了带版本的 RTL 变体、源码级 ground truth、testbench 及执行工件，可支撑 RTL 调试方法的评估。

Abstract: RTL source-level debugging research requires benchmark artifacts that provide faulty designs together with precise change locations, executable test stimuli, and reproducible configurations. Available Verilog resources usually provide only a subset of these elements. We present VeriBugBench, a framework for constructing Verilog RTL debugging benchmarks through empirically grounded fault construction, LLM-based testbench enhancement, and execution-based retention. The mutation library maps recurring, multi-granularity repair patterns observed in RTL bug-fix histories to 19 executable inverse operators. For each project, an LLM generates a design-specific stimulus phase from the clean DUT and original testbench; the phase is composed with the original testbench for candidate execution. Applying the framework to 45 open-source projects yields VeriBugBench-v1.0, with 2,608 executable single-fault instances whose effects are observable at design outputs. Across the 45 projects, the assembled testbenches increase mean project-level fault observability from 36.01% to 39.54% and improve line coverage and execution-trace diversity on average. VeriBugBench provides versioned RTL variants, source-level ground truth, testbenches, and execution artifacts for evaluating RTL debugging methods.

</details>


### [343] [Automated Instruction Encoding Synthesis for Modern GPU ISA Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18662)
*Mingyuan Ma,Hu He*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出自动化指令编码合成框架，将指令布局建模为约束槽位分配问题，并在NVIDIA SASS上实例化，可变长度编码减少33%指令占用，固定长度编码减少16%解码器面积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPU内核日益加剧指令供给路径压力，而固定指令容器存在大量占用余量（footprint slack），需要更紧凑的指令编码与解码实现。

Method: 将指令布局视为已验证指令格式字段规范上的约束槽位分配问题；分离语义字段标识与物理比特位置；支持tied、pinned、free放置约束。针对NVIDIA SASS：将公开编码文本规范化为机器可读规范，用3.78M条指令对反汇编器与nvdisasm校验并发布开放基准，采用CP-SAT进行定长与变长编码合成。

Result: 在142个Blackwell内核输入上，变长合成减少33%指令占用，在Ampere与Hopper上重合成亦有相当降幅；相同规范下定长合成使解码器面积较基于NVIDIA观测128位布局生成的解码器减少16%。生成取指/解码RTL在TSMC 22nm达1.5GHz，复制面积增量仅为GA100级裸片面积的0.12%；同节点SRAM对比显示占用减少对应的指令SRAM位单元面积约为该新增逻辑的9倍。

Conclusion: 指令编码布局可自动化综合并带来显著占用与解码面积收益，且新增逻辑开销远小于SRAM面积节省，具备实用价值。

Abstract: Modern GPU kernels increasingly stress the instruction supply path, while fixed instruction containers can leave substantial footprint slack. This paper presents an automated encoding-synthesis framework that treats instruction layout as a constrained slot-assignment problem over a validated instruction-form field specification. The formulation separates semantic field identity from physical bit positions and supports tied, pinned, and free placement constraints, making it applicable when recurring decoded fields are not frozen by a public format contract. We instantiate the framework for NVIDIA SASS: raw public encoding text is normalized into a machine-readable specification, a SASS disassembler is validated against nvdisasm on 3.78M instructions, released as an open benchmark, and CP-SAT synthesis is used for fixed-length and variable-length encodings. On 142 Blackwell kernel inputs, variable-length synthesis reduces instruction footprint by 33%, with comparable reductions after re-synthesis on Ampere and Hopper; fixed-length synthesis on the same specification reduces decoder area by 16% against a decoder generated from the NVIDIA-observed 128-bit layout by the same generator and flow. Generated fetch/decode RTL meets 1.5 GHz in TSMC 22 nm with a replicated area delta of 0.12% of a GA100-class die; a same-node SRAM comparison shows the footprint reduction corresponds to about 9x this added logic in instruction-SRAM bit-cell area.

</details>


### [344] [HBFlex: A Flexible Memory System for Bridging Fine-Grained LLM States and Coarse-Grained HBF Parallel Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18675)
*Shuzhang Zhong,Weikai Xu,Yifan Zhou,Tongbin Zhao,Tenghao Zhao,Yifei Kang,Cunyin Chang,Shu Li,Guangyu Sun,Meng Li*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出HBFlex，一个全HBF内存系统，通过对KV读取、写入和回收的协同优化，解决全HBF部署LLM时的三大挑战，相比FlashAccel和H3最高取得1.58倍和3.30倍的吞吐加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM需要不断增长的显存容量来存放模型权重和KV缓存。高带宽闪存（HBF）凭借高存储密度和通过大规模平面级并行获得的高聚合读带宽，成为LLM服务的理想选择。但完全用HBF服务LLM存在三个挑战：细粒度KV读导致放置与访问不均衡、增量写干扰前台读、混合KV生命周期加剧垃圾回收。混合HBM/HBF方案虽保留HBM支持动态KV管理，但在固定封装预算下减少了可用HBF资源，限制了HBF聚合带宽。

Method: HBFlex是全HBF内存系统，针对KV读、写、回收进行协同优化：均衡KV放置与注意力访问以提高平面利用率；聚合增量更新并在足够长的计算窗口内调度回写，以减少写-读干扰；结合生命周期引导的块打包与延迟回收，减少有效页迁移。

Result: 通过跨不同配置的trace驱动仿真评估，HBFlex相比FlashAccel平均吞吐加速最高达1.58倍，相比H3最高达3.30倍，得益于更高的HBF带宽以及对动态KV缓存读、写、擦除更高效的管理。

Conclusion: 全HBF架构结合对KV读、写、回收的协同优化，可在无需HBM的情况下有效支撑LLM服务，显著提升吞吐，是混合HBM/HBF方案的有力替代。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) require increasing memory capacity to accommodate growing model weights and KV caches. High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) offers high memory density and aggregate read bandwidth through massive plane-level parallelism, making it an attractive option for LLM serving. However, serving LLMs entirely from HBF introduces three challenges: fine-grained KV reads create placement and access imbalance, incremental writes interfere with foreground reads, and mixed KV lifetimes amplify garbage collection. Hybrid HBM/HBF designs retain HBM to support dynamic KV management, but this allocation reduces the HBF resources available under a fixed packaging budget, limiting aggregate HBF bandwidth.
  We present HBFlex, a full-HBF memory system with coordinated optimizations for KV reads, writes, and reclamation. HBFlex balances KV placement and attention accesses to improve plane utilization. It aggregates incremental updates and schedules writeback within sufficiently long compute windows to reduce write--read interference. It also combines lifetime-guided block packing with deferred reclamation to reduce valid-page migration. We evaluate HBFlex through trace-driven simulation across different configurations. HBFlex achieves average throughput speedups of up to 1.58$\times$ over FlashAccel and 3.30$\times$ over H3, benefiting from higher HBF bandwidth and more efficient management of dynamic KV-cache reads, writes, and erases.

</details>


### [345] [Quantifying the Effect of HCLs on a Fixed-Microarchitecture MXFP4 Accelerator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18792)
*Daniele Passaretti,Sajjad Tamimi,Nicola Dall'Ora*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文以相同的固定设计（OCP MXFP4 块点积，12 级、II=1 流水线）在相同 Artix-7、100 MHz、RISC-V 软核驱动条件下，对比 SystemVerilog 基准与 Chisel、SpinalHDL、Amaranth、Clash、Bluespec 及 HLS 用 C++ 的实现。结果表明：在微架构固定时，各 HCL 均满足时序，面积可持平甚至优于手写 RTL；剩余差异主要源于后端算术降低方式及一个会隐性触发 DSP 推断的位宽选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 HCL 之间的比较多为定性分析，或跨不同设计评估 QoR，难以将语言效应与设计效应分离。作者希望通过固定同一微架构与同一设计，获得更干净的对比，从而判断 HCL 相对手写 RTL 与 HLS 的真实差异来源。

Method: 选取同一固定设计——面向边缘 Physical-AI 推理量化的 OCP MXFP4 块点积，实现为单一 12 级、II=1 的流水线。先给出 SystemVerilog 基准，再分别用 Chisel、SpinalHDL、Amaranth、Clash、Bluespec 以及面向高层次综合（HLS）的 C++ 实现。所有变体在同一 Artix-7 器件组、100 MHz 下走相同流程，并由 RISC-V 软核驱动，保持微架构不变。

Result: 所有变体均满足时序；HCL 在面积上可匹配甚至低于手写 RTL。差异不在于算法，而在于各后端如何降低算术运算，以及一个会隐性切换 DSP 推断的位宽选择。与 HLS 将设计决策局限于 pragma 不同，HCL 能达到可比的面积与时序。

Conclusion: 在微架构固定的公平比较下，HCL 与手写 RTL 在面积和时序上已具可比性，且优于受 pragma 限制的 HLS。因此，HCL 的选择依据更多在于生态适配与接口需求，而非 QoR。

Abstract: Hardware Construction Languages (HCLs) aim to improve hardware design productivity while generating register-transfer-level (RTL) circuits without changing the designer's microarchitecture. However, most comparisons between HCLs are either qualitative or evaluate quality of results (QoR) across different designs, making it difficult to separate language effects from design effects. This paper compares the most widely used HCLs using the same fixed design, the OCP MXFP4 block dot product, a quantization primitive at the heart of edge Physical-AI inference, implemented as a single 12-stage, II=1 pipeline. A SystemVerilog baseline is followed by implementations in Chisel, SpinalHDL, Amaranth, Clash, Bluespec, and C++ for high-level synthesis (HLS). Every variant goes through the same flow on the same Artix-7 device set at 100 MhZ, driven by a RISC-V soft core. With the micro-architecture held constant, the comparison is clean: every variant meets timing, and the HCLs match or even undercut hand-written RTL in area. The remaining differences stem not from the algorithm but from how each back end lowers arithmetic, and from a single width choice that silently toggles DSP inference. Unlike HLS, where design decisions are limited to pragmas, the HCLs achieve comparable area and timing. Therefore, the choice comes down to ecosystem fit and interface needs rather than QoR.

</details>


### [346] [Locus: A Framework for Exploring and Optimizing Point Addition Hardware for Zero-Knowledge Proofs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18846)
*Gaurav Kuwar,Alhad Daftardar,Jianqiao Mo,Siddharth Garg,Brandon Reagen*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: Locus 是一个面向零知识证明中点加法（PADD）硬件实现的自动化生成与设计空间探索框架，支持任意给定椭圆曲线参数，自动产生 ASIC/FPGA 实现，并完成超 1000 个设计点的系统研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零知识证明依赖的密码学原语（如椭圆曲线点加法）计算开销高。已有硬件工作仅覆盖少数特定曲线和设计点，设计空间未被充分探索，也缺乏系统的硬件设计权衡指导。

Method: 提出 Locus 框架：给定支持方程形式的任意椭圆曲线参数，自动生成 PADD 的 ASIC 与 FPGA 实现，从而系统地探索 PADD 设计空间，覆盖超过 1000 个设计点。

Result: 在 12nm 工艺下，相比已有 ASIC 获得 2.71× 几何平均加速与 3.11× 几何平均面积缩减；相比 CPU 获得 34.67× 几何平均加速；在等面积条件下集成到已有 ZKP 加速器时，端到端证明生成获得 3.15× 几何平均加速。

Conclusion: Locus 填补了 PADD 硬件设计自动化与系统性探索的空白，能够生成高性能、低面积的点加法硬件，并显著提升 ZKP 端到端证明生成的效率。框架已开源。

Abstract: Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs) are critical for privacy-preserving and verifiable computation, but their cryptographic primitives impose high computational overheads. One such primitive is point addition (PADD) on elliptic curves. Several prior works have implemented PADDs in hardware, but only for a few specific elliptic curves and design points, leaving a large design space unexplored, and lacking systematic guidance on hardware design trade-offs. To address this gap, we present Locus, a framework dedicated to optimizing and exploring point addition hardware. Given the parameters of any elliptic curve in a supported equation form, Locus automatically generates ASIC and FPGA implementations of PADD, enabling systematic exploration of the PADD design space. Using Locus, we conduct the first comprehensive hardware-focused study of PADD designs, exploring trade-offs over 1,000 design points. On a 12nm technology node, our framework produces PADD designs that yield a $2.71\times$ geomean speedup and $3.11\times$ geomean area reduction compared to prior ASICs, $34.67\times$ geomean speedup over CPU, and $3.15\times$ geomean speedup on end-to-end proof generation when integrated into a prior ZKP accelerator at iso-area. Locus is available at https://github.com/cryptolets/cryptolets/tree/locus.

</details>


### [347] [Rect3D: A Unified Analytical Framework for 3D-IC Rectilinear Floorplanning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18946)
*Shuo Ren,Rongliang Fu,Libo Shen,Zhen Zhuang,Leilei Jin,Chen Wu,Lei He,Bei Yu,Tsung-Yi Ho*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出Rect3D，一种将概率性跨die块分配融入统一连续优化模型的解析式3D直角floorplanning框架，在GSRC基准上显著降低线长与运行时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统3D floorplanning方法将问题分解为跨die划分与die内floorplanning两个独立阶段，限制了设计优化空间，难以获得3D-IC的全部性能收益；而直接在3D空间建模优化虽可缓解该问题，却面临计算复杂度高、算法效率低下的困难。

Method: 提出统一连续优化模型，将概率性跨die块分配与die内几何优化联合建模。框架包含三部分：基于图拉普拉斯的初始化以实现拓扑感知的种子生成；可扩展的梯度全局优化流程，联合进行die分配与几何精化；以及基于3D网格的合法化方法，用于生成连通的直角布局。

Result: 在GSRC基准测试上，与代表性最先进3D floorplanning基线相比，线长最多降低83.6%，运行时间最多缩短15.98倍；在六个额外的partition-first直角布局基线中一致取得最低线长。

Conclusion: 将die分配与die内几何置于统一的3D优化流程中共同优化，可有效保留优化空间，优于先划分后布局的传统范式，验证了统一连续建模在3D直角floorplanning中的优势。

Abstract: 3D-ICs offer significant performance improvements for modern VLSI designs by reducing global interconnect cost. However, conventional 3D floorplanning methods decompose the problem into separate inter-die partitioning and intra-die floorplanning stages, which can restrict the design optimization space and limit the potential gains. Although directly modeling and optimizing in 3D space can mitigate this limitation, the high computational complexity hinders algorithmic efficiency. To address these challenges, we propose \textsc{Rect3D}, an analytical 3D rectilinear floorplanning framework that integrates probabilistic inter-die block assignment into a unified continuous optimization model. The framework combines graph Laplacian initialization for topology-aware seeding, a scalable gradient-based global optimization procedure for joint die assignment and geometric refinement, and a 3D grid-based legalization method for generating connected rectilinear layouts. On GSRC benchmarks, \textsc{Rect3D} reduces wirelength by up to 83.6\% and runtime by up to 15.98$\times$ compared with representative state-of-the-art 3D floorplanning baselines. It also consistently achieves the lowest wirelength among six additional partition-first rectilinear baselines, showing the advantage of preserving die assignment and in-die geometry in a unified 3D optimization flow.

</details>


<div id='q-bio.GN'></div>

# q-bio.GN [[Back]](#toc)

### [348] [Structure is not mechanism: high-gain gated-FFN rows across text and genomic foundation models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17599)
*Alexandros Tzanakakis,Aris Karatzikos,Ilias Georgakopoulos-Soares*

Main category: q-bio.GN

TL;DR: 对文本与基因组基础模型中门控前馈网络的高增益行进行了22模型因果普查，发现高增益行是跨模型反复出现的架构表型：其结构显著性（谱集中度、算子幅度）只能作为功能富集信号，不能定量预测因果重要性或说明因果组织方式，机制呈模型特异性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在Transformer语言模型中，极少数异常高增益参数可能产生不成比例的影响，但基因组基础模型中是否存在类似结构、以及结构几何是否决定功能重要性尚不清楚。作者希望检验"结构极端性"是否为可迁移的通用机制。

Method: 分析文本与基因组基础模型门控FFN中的高增益行，开展含冻结模型的22模型因果普查；精确计算相关联的双线性权重算子（不使用对角近似）；以随机对照与同层top-norm对照评估激活导出候选的功能富集性；在单个基因组解码器与单个文本解码器中对36行进行层内扫描；并结合DNABERT-2与GENERator的个案研究。

Result: 激活导出候选相对随机与同层top-norm对照具有功能富集性；但谱集中度与算子幅度均不能预测因果效应大小，且在端点同质的文本解码器子集中这些关联消失。36行层内扫描揭示两种机制：低于检测器接受阈值时，该比值对因果损伤无正向信息；高于阈值时能强排序但不符合剂量-反应式严重度分级。扫描还发现一个单候选普查遗漏的个体灾难性行，以及共位关键行之间的非加性损伤。个案研究显示因果组织各异：DNABERT-2中为稳健的超加性成对交互，GENERator中为位置局部化依赖，恢复该行的序列起始贡献可挽回几乎全部原始损失损伤。

Conclusion: 高增益门控FFN行是一种反复出现的架构表型，其结构显著性充其量是富集信号，而非功能criticality的标定度量，也不规定因果组织方式。富集是普遍的，但机制是模型特异的。

Abstract: A small number of unusually high-gain parameters can exert disproportionate effects in transformer language models, but whether analogous structures recur in genomic foundation models and whether structural geometry determines functional importance remains unknown. We analyzed high-gain rows in gated feed-forward networks across text and genomic foundation models, including a frozen 22-model causal census. Computing an associated bilinear weight operator exactly, without a diagonal approximation, we tested whether structural extremeness is a transferable mechanism. Activation-derived candidates were functionally enriched relative to random and top-norm same-layer controls, yet neither spectral concentration nor operator magnitude predicted causal effect size, and these associations vanished within the endpoint-homogeneous text-decoder subset. A within-layer sweep of 36 rows in one genomic and one text decoder resolved this into two regimes: below the detector's acceptance threshold the ratio carried no positive information about causal damage, whereas above it the ratio ordered rows strongly but did not grade severity as a dose-response. The same sweep revealed a second individually catastrophic row invisible to a one-candidate-per-model census, and non-additive damage among co-located critical rows. Case studies showed divergent causal organizations: a robust super-additive pair interaction in DNABERT-2, and in GENERator a sharply position-localized dependence in which preserving or restoring the row's beginning-of-sequence contribution rescued essentially all native-loss damage. High-gain gated-FFN rows are therefore a recurrent architectural phenotype whose structural prominence acts as an enrichment signal, not a calibrated measure of functional criticality or a specification of causal organization. Enrichment is general, but the mechanism is model-specific.

</details>


### [349] [Democratizing Clinical Tumor Whole Genome Sequencing: 18-hour End-to-end Analysis via Trillion-parameter Large Language Models Locally Deployed on Consumer-grade Hardware](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17620)
*Rui Xiao,Yili Xu*

Main category: q-bio.GN

TL;DR: 该工作提出全本地化低资源框架，可在单张消费级RTX 4060笔记本（32GB内存、8GB显存）上部署万亿参数生物医学大模型，完成从FASTQ到临床级全变异谱报告的肿瘤配对WGS全流程，18小时完成分析，体细胞变异检测F1达99.62%，与A100集群流程一致性超99.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全基因组测序（WGS）是精准肿瘤学的关键，但计算成本高昂、周转时间长达数天，限制了其在临床尤其是基层医疗机构的落地。已有万亿参数级基因组大模型通常依赖数十万美元的GPU集群，缺乏面向消费级硬件的可行部署路径。

Method: 构建全本地化低资源部署框架：在单张RTX 4060（8GB显存）与32GB系统内存的消费级笔记本及常规临床工作站上稳定部署万亿参数生物医学大模型；采用自适应异构内存调度策略与模型优化，覆盖从原始FASTQ输入到临床级全变异谱报告输出的完整肿瘤配对WGS流程；在标准30X深度配置下进行评估，并与工业级A100集群流程进行一致性对比。

Result: 30X深度下单例肿瘤配对WGS分析可在18小时内完成；体细胞变异检测F1分数达99.62%，与工业级A100集群流程一致率超过99.9%，满足临床肿瘤学准确性要求。量化分析显示，自适应异构内存调度占总执行时间的71%，模型优化带来的检测误差占比不足9%。

Conclusion: 该工作是首个在消费级硬件上实现万亿参数生物医学大模型驱动的临床级基因组分析的工程实践，打破了万亿级基因组大模型必须依赖昂贵GPU集群和数天周转的行业范式，为全球基层医疗机构以零额外成本开展全基因组精准肿瘤学提供了低资源路径。

Abstract: Whole genome sequencing (WGS) is essential for precision oncology, yet its clinical adoption remains limited by prohibitive computational costs and multi-day turnaround times. This work presents a fully localized low-resource framework enabling stable deployment of a trillion-parameter biomedical LLM on a single consumer-grade RTX 4060 laptop with 32GB system memory and 8GB VRAM, as well as on routine clinical workstations in general hospitals, completing the entire tumor-paired WGS workflow from raw FASTQ input to clinical-grade full-variation-spectrum report output. Under standard 30X depth configurations, our implementation finishes a single tumor-paired WGS analysis within 18 hours, achieving 99.62% F1 score for somatic variant detection with over 99.9% concordance to the industrial-standard A100 cluster pipeline, fully meeting clinical oncology accuracy requirements. Quantitative profiling shows adaptive heterogeneous memory scheduling accounts for 71% of total execution time, while model optimization introduces less than 9% of total detection error. This work is the first engineering implementation of trillion-parameter biomedical LLM-driven clinical-grade genomic analysis on consumer-grade hardware, breaking the industry paradigm that trillion-scale genomic LLMs require hundred-thousand-dollar GPU clusters and multi-day turnaround, establishing a low-resource pathway for global primary medical institutions to adopt whole-genome precision oncology at zero additional cost.

</details>


### [350] [PlainMap: a lightweight, restartable mapping pipeline for ancient and modern DNA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18372)
*Michael V. Westbury*

Main category: q-bio.GN

TL;DR: PlainMap：轻量级、可断点续跑的比对流程，适配现代与降解DNA，支持混合平台、确定性分块与试点抽样比较策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将测序读段比对到参考基因组时，预处理与比对策略需随文库类型、片段长度、测序平台和参考基因组变化；对于古DNA与历史DNA，短且受损的片段使最优比对策略难以先验确定。因此需要灵活、可比较策略且能应对大规模分析中断的比对流程。

Method: PlainMap接受FASTQ清单文件，依据read header自动识别单端/双端数据，支持混合测序平台，并提供面向现代DNA与降解DNA的三种替代比对模式；采用确定性分块与检查点执行支持中断后续跑，可选试点子抽样在相同原始片段子集上进行策略经验比较；输出去重BAM及片段感知的比对与覆盖统计。

Result: 在异构测序数据上的评估验证了三种比对模式的预期行为；自适应分块将峰值内存降低约25%，并可使被中断的分析从已完成比对块处恢复。

Conclusion: PlainMap以单个Bash脚本实现，轻量、可重启、支持混合平台与降解DNA，便于在实际项目中经验性地选择比对策略并提升资源效率；已在GitHub公开。

Abstract: Mapping sequencing reads to a reference genome requires preprocessing and alignment choices that can vary with library type, fragment length, sequencing platform, and reference genome. These considerations are particularly important for ancient and historical DNA, where short and damaged fragments can make the most appropriate mapping strategy difficult to determine a priori. We present PlainMap, a lightweight and restartable mapping pipeline for modern and degraded DNA sequencing data. PlainMap accepts a simple manifest of FASTQ files, automatically identifies single-end and paired-end data from read headers, supports mixed sequencing platforms, and provides alternative mapping strategies for modern and degraded DNA. Deterministic chunking and checkpoint-based execution allow large analyses to resume after interruption, while optional pilot subsampling enables empirical comparison of mapping strategies using identical subsets of raw fragments. PlainMap produces duplicate-filtered BAM files together with fragment-aware mapping and coverage statistics. Evaluation using heterogeneous sequencing data confirmed the expected behaviour of the three mapping modes, while adaptive chunking reduced peak memory use by approximately 25% and allowed an interrupted analysis to resume from completed mapping chunks. PlainMap is implemented as a single Bash script and is freely available at https://github.com/BiodiversityExtinction/PlainMap.

</details>


### [351] [STUART: Sequence Triage and qUAntification of Read Transcripts for Rapid Ionizing Radiation Exposure Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19139)
*Tomasz Strzoda,Lourdes Cruz-Garcia,Mustafa Najim,Christophe Badie,Joanna Polanska*

Main category: q-bio.GN

TL;DR: STUART：一种免比对、基于NLP思想将测序读段转为k-mer数值特征的机器学习框架，用于移动式生物剂量估算，仅需约1000条读段即可稳定判别辐射暴露。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电离辐射暴露后的快速医学分诊对应急管理至关重要，但传统基于比对的生物信息学方法计算量过大，难以适用于大规模伤亡场景。

Method: 受自然语言处理启发，将原始测序读段转化为k-mer数值特征，完全绕过序列比对；以FDXR基因模型为对象，比较Logistic Regression、Random Forest与XGBoost，并采用高级特征选择策略进行降维，结合学习曲线与外部数据集验证。

Result: 特征选择将初始1024维特征空间缩减98%以上，仅保留低至17个转录组特征即可获得近乎完美的平衡准确率与95%–100%的F1分数；学习曲线显示仅需聚合约1000条相关读段即可使信号完全稳定；独立数据集外部验证特异性超过99%，证实所提取特征具有组织无关性。

Conclusion: STUART的低数据阈值支持"边测序边分析"的实时诊断范式，可兼容便携式测序仪，缩短决策时间，为分散式现场生物监测、快速流行病学响应及常规职业辐射监测提供可扩展基础。

Abstract: Rapid medical triage following ionizing radiation exposure is critical for emergency management, yet traditional alignment-based bioinformatics are too computationally intensive for mass-casualty scenarios. To address this, we developed STUART (Sequence Triage and qUAntification of Read Transcripts), a mapping-free machine learning framework optimized for mobile biological dosimetry. Inspired by Natural Language Processing (NLP), the system converts raw sequencing reads into k-mer-based numerical profiles, completely bypassing standard alignment. While the architecture is universally applicable to any transcriptomic biomarker, this study focused on radiation exposure using the FDXR gene model. Evaluating Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost, advanced signature selection strategies drastically reduced the initial 1024-dimensional feature space by over 98%. Highly robust performance - characterized by near-perfect balanced accuracy and F1-scores within the 95-100% range - was consistently achieved while retaining as few as 17 transcriptomic signatures. Crucially, learning curve analysis demonstrated that complete signal stabilization requires aggregating merely 1000 potentially related reads. Furthermore, external validation on an independent dataset yielded over 99% specificity, confirming the tissue-agnostic nature of the extracted signatures despite different cellular origins. The framework's exceptionally low data threshold enables a real-time, analyze-as-you-sequence diagnostic paradigm compatible with portable sequencers. By minimizing time-to-decision, this decentralized tool bridges the gap between advanced biomarkers and practical on-site biomonitoring, offering a scalable foundation for rapid epidemiological response and routine occupational radiation monitoring.

</details>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [352] [Human-Centric Grasp State Assessment: Toward Transferring Subjective Evaluation to Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17540)
*Ryohei Kobayashi,Kosei Isomoto,Yuga Yano,Yuichiro Tanaka,Hakaru Tamukoh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出VLM半自动监督生成器与轻量抓取状态预测器结合的框架，将人类隐性主观标准迁移至机器人，用于可变形物体的恰当抓取，仅需少量人工标注样本即可实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类对可变形物体抓取"是否恰当"的评价是定性的主观标准，而机器人依赖定量测量，二者之间存在语义鸿沟；传统深度学习方法弥合该鸿沟需要针对每个新物体进行大量人工标注，成本过高。

Method: 框架由两部分组成：(1) 基于视觉-语言模型(VLM)的半自动监督生成器，以极少量人工标注试验作为上下文锚点，将主观标准传播至未标注数据；(2) 轻量级抓取状态预测器，基于时序触觉与抓取力测量在线序贯估计抓取状态，实现快速在线自适应。

Result: 在三种代表性可变形物体上的实验以及25名参与者的人类评估研究表明，该框架能够依据人类感知的抓取恰当性调整抓取力，验证了其可行性。

Conclusion: 所提框架可在评测任务场景中，以少量人工标注为代价实现人类主观抓取标准的机器人迁移，并支持抓取力的在线自适应调整，具备可行性。

Abstract: We propose a framework that transfers tacit human subjective criteria to robotic systems for the appropriate grasping of deformable objects. Achieving such behavior is challenging because a semantic gap exists between qualitative human expectations and quantitative robotic measurements. Conventional deep learning approaches for bridging this gap also require prohibitive amounts of manually annotated data for each newly encountered object. To address these challenges, our framework integrates a Vision-Language Model (VLM)-based semi-automated supervisor generator with a lightweight grasp state predictor, using a minimal set of human-annotated trials as contextual anchors to propagate subjective criteria to unannotated data. The prediction model then enables rapid online adaptation by sequentially estimating the grasp state from time-series tactile and grasping force measurements. Through experiments on three representative deformable objects and a human evaluation study with 25 participants, we demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed framework for adjusting grasping force according to human-perceived grasp appropriateness in the evaluated task setting.

</details>


### [353] [Real-Time Service Robot Replanning via Simple Button Interaction for Improved Task Success and User Experience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17541)
*Ryo Terashima,Yuga Yano,Koshun Arimura,Hakaru Tamukoh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种实时反馈功能，允许用户通过平板单按钮向服务机器人发送反馈，使其重新规划动作；实验表明该功能可同时提升任务成功率与用户体验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 服务机器人在真实环境中会遇到意外指令，且无法自行检测任务中的所有失败与异常，因此需要借助人类反馈来修正行为。

Method: 构建实时反馈系统，用户在机器人动作错误时通过平板上的单个按钮直观发送反馈；机器人据此识别失败并重新规划适当动作。通过有无反馈功能的对照实验，并用五点李克特量表问卷进行评估。

Result: 加入反馈功能后，"是否觉得机器人行为出乎意料"得分提升0.5分，"是否有时对机器人行为感到焦虑"得分提升0.9分。

Conclusion: 结果支持"简单交互不会带来负面用户体验"的假设，表明该实时反馈功能可同时提升任务成功率与用户体验。

Abstract: Service robots must respond to unexpected instructions in real-world environments. However, robots cannot detect all failures and exceptions during a task. To address these issues, we propose a real-time feedback function that enables robots to modify their behavior based on human feedback. In this system, users can intuitively send feedback to the robot by pressing a single button on a tablet when the robot fails to act correctly. Robots use this feedback to consider their failures and replan appropriate actions to complete the task. We conducted experiments with and without the feedback function to verify the following hypothesis: "Simple interactions do not cause a negative user experience." All questionnaire responses are evaluated on a five-point Likert scale. After adding the feedback function, the response score for the question "Did you feel that the robot's behavior was unexpected?" improved by 0.5 points, and that for "Did you feel anxious about the robot's behavior at times?" improved by 0.9 points. These results support the study's hypothesis and indicate that incorporating this real-time feedback function can simultaneously improve task success and the user experience.

</details>


### [354] [Predictive Varanus: Combining CSP Conformance Monitoring with Predictive LTL Runtime Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17625)
*Angelo Ferrando,Matt Luckcuck,Pedro Ribeiro*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 PREDICTIVE VARANUS，一个两阶段验证流水线，将基于 CSP 的运行时验证器 VARANUS 与面向 LTL 的预测性运行时验证相结合，实现对系统行为的提前判定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统运行时验证是反应式的，只有在系统已执行坏事件后才检测到违规，在代价高昂或不安全的领域可能为时已晚。因此需要能够提前给出判定的验证方法。

Method: 将 CSP 模型首先作为观测事件轨迹的一致性门控；随后把同一模型翻译为 Buchi 自动机，用以约束预测性 LTL 监视器所探索的未来。据此形式化组合监视器并说明其实现。

Result: 组合监视器可立即拒绝不符合模型的行为，并将与模型一致的前缀分类为：已保证满足、已强制违反，或对监控的时序性质仍不确定。核储存检查机器人漫游车案例表明，该组合可比标准运行时监控更早给出判定，并复用已有的设计期 CSP 模型。

Conclusion: CSP 验证与预测性 LTL 的结合可在复用设计期 CSP 模型的同时提供更早的验证判定，适用于自主与机器人系统。

Abstract: Runtime Verification is well suited to autonomous and robotic systems because it checks the behaviour that is actually observed during execution. Its main limitation, however, is that it is usually reactive: the monitor detects a violation only after the system has already performed a bad event. This can be too late in domains where failures are costly or unsafe. In this paper we present PREDICTIVE VARANUS, a two-stage verification pipeline that combines VARANUS, a runtime verifier that uses models written in the process algebra Communicating Sequential Processes (CSP), with predictive runtime verification for LTL. A CSP model is first used as a conformance gate over the observed event trace; the same model is then translated into a Buchi automaton that constrains the futures explored by a predictive LTL monitor. In this way, out-of-model behaviour is rejected immediately, while model-consistent prefixes can be classified as already guaranteeing satisfaction, already forcing violation, or still being inconclusive for the monitored temporal property. We formalise the combined monitor, explain its implementation, and illustrate the approach on a robotic rover for nuclear-store inspection. The case study shows how the combination of CSP validation and predictive LTL can provide earlier verdicts than standard runtime monitoring while reusing an existing design-time CSP model.

</details>


### [355] [Flexible-body Modeling, Kinematic Identification, and Assembly Accuracy of Overconstrained Spatial Linkages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17627)
*Daniel Huczala,Michael Pieber,Johannes Gerstmayr,Andreas Mair,Frederik Schulte,Silvia Glas,Tomas Postulka,Ales Vysocky,Martin Pfurner*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该文提出基于浮动参考系公式的柔性多体建模框架，对过约束单环连杆机构进行精度分析，并用3D打印PLA的Bennett四杆机构（含关节轴错位变体）验证，发现结构柔顺性带来"自装配"倾向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过约束单环连杆机构高效、紧凑、低成本，但工业应用受限：仿真中刚体公式因冗余约束而失效，且这类机构装配困难。作者希望建立能处理冗余约束的柔性建模方法并评估装配原型的整体精度。

Method: 基于浮动参考系公式（floating frame of reference formulation）的柔性多体建模框架；对Bennett四杆机构3D打印PLA原型（含故意关节轴错位、刚体视角下无法装配的变体）进行实验验证；并补充提出适用于此类Jacobian病态机构运动学参数辨识方法；另用纸板管与竹签作连杆构建块做定性演示。

Result: 实验与仿真对比表明，过约束机构具有自装配倾向：结构柔顺性驱动装配趋向理想几何构型，并将约束应力分布到整个结构中；纸板管与竹签等低成本、非常规材料、有限制造精度下也能实现功能机构。

Conclusion: 所提建模流程完全算法化，可为未来设计优化提供支持；柔性多体建模结合参数辨识可有效处理过约束机构的冗余约束与病态问题，拓展其低成本制造与工业应用潜力。

Abstract: Overconstrained rational single-loop linkages are efficient, compact, and low-cost custom mechanisms, yet their deployment in industrial settings is limited. In simulations, rigid body formulations fail due to redundant constraints. This study presents a flexible multibody modeling framework based on the floating frame of reference formulation, and delivers an overall accuracy analysis of assembled linkages prototypes. The approach is validated against 3D-printed PLA prototypes of a Bennett four-bar mechanism, including variants with intentional joint-axis misalignment, which theoretically, from the rigid body point of view, cannot be assembled. A supplementary contribution is delivered in the form of a kinematic parameter identification methodology suited for this type of mechanism with ill-conditioned Jacobian. The experimental and simulation results are compared and reveal that these overconstrained mechanisms exhibit a self-assembling tendency -- structural compliance drives the assembly toward the ideal geometric configuration, distributing constraint stress throughout the structure. Additional qualitative demonstrations using cardboard tubes and bamboo sticks as link building blocks confirm that functional mechanisms can be realized from low-cost, unconventional materials with limited manufacturing accuracy. The proposed modeling pipeline is fully algorithmic and enables design optimization in the future.

</details>


### [356] [LEAP: Learning Emergent Active Perception for Quadruped Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17628)
*Ü. Bora Gökbakan,Stéphane Caron,Philippe Souères*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出LEAP方法，无需手设代理目标即可在任务压力下自发涌现主动感知（注视控制），用于危险地形上的目视目标导航。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习系统通常依赖人工设计的代理目标（如覆盖率、好奇心奖励）来激励主动感知，但这些目标可能与任务本身冲突，并非最优。

Method: 将问题定义为危险地形上需视觉发现目标的导航任务；提出具备主动感知的导航策略架构，并在地形课程中训练，仅依靠任务压力涌现注视控制；核心是采用注视不变的表示，将深度图像整合为以自我为中心的信念地图。

Result: 在留出评估场景中成功率达92.7%，优于脚本式（74.2%）与被动感知（34.5%），距特权预言机（oracle）仅差4.6个百分点；未经改动的LEAP导航策略可直接迁移用于物理仿真中四足机器人运动策略的转向控制。

Conclusion: 任务压力本身即可驱动主动感知的涌现，无需额外代理奖励；所学的注视不变表示与导航策略具备良好性能与向运动控制的迁移能力。

Abstract: Active perception allows autonomous agents to select their viewpoints rather than passively process the viewpoints given to them, enabling them to target where to reduce uncertainty about their environment. Learned systems typically encourage this behavior with hand-designed proxy objectives, such as coverage or curiosity bonuses, that may conflict with the task. In this work, we propose a method to learn emergent active perception (LEAP) without augmentation of the task objective. We formulate the problem of goal-oriented navigation over hazardous terrains with goals that must be discovered visually. We then propose an architecture for navigation policies with active perception, and train them on a terrain curriculum where task pressure alone leads to the emergence of gaze control. Key to this emergence, LEAP works on a gaze-invariant representation that integrates depth images into egocentric belief maps. We validate its performance in held-out evaluation scenarios, where it achieves a 92.7% success rate, compared to 74.2% for scripted or 34.5% for passive perception, and comes within 4.6 points of a privileged oracle. We validate that LEAP navigation policies, unchanged, can be directly applied to steering quadrupedal locomotion policies in physics simulation.

</details>


### [357] [Vision-Language Grounded Task-Context-Aware Imitation Learning for Robotic Disassembly](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17714)
*Jeon Ho Kang,Igal Tamarkin,Ethan Niu,Ian Novales,Satyandra K. Gupta*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种结合语言任务上下文与分层任务选择的模仿学习框架，用于真实场景下的机器人长时序拆解任务，在多样连接件几何与装配配置下无需显式物体标注即可泛化，端到端任务成功率较基线显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实机器人拆解需要长时序、多零件的有序操作。由于存在多种有效任务目标和多样的装配配置，仅凭原始观测，模仿策略难以推断出预期技能；而训练数据又无法覆盖真实世界配置与零件几何的组合多样性。因此需要引入额外结构来辅助技能选择与目标定位。

Method: 将语言作为任务上下文引入：一方面提供技能选择的显式结构，另一方面把语言指定任务与其在视觉场景中的操作目标关联起来。框架由分层任务选择与任务上下文感知的模仿学习组成，将语言指令落地到空间视觉表征上，用于机器人拆解；该方法无需显式物体标注即可工作。

Result: 端到端任务成功率比扩散策略基线（diffusion policy）提高35个百分点，比先前的任务上下文感知基线提高75个百分点；并可泛化到多样的连接件几何与装配配置。

Conclusion: 以语言形式注入任务上下文，能有效缓解长时序拆解中技能选择歧义与视觉目标关联困难的问题，实现跨几何与配置的泛化，显著提升机器人拆解任务的端到端成功率。

Abstract: Real-world robotic disassembly requires long-horizon execution, where robots must perform ordered sequences of manipulation tasks across multiple parts within a single scene. Multiple valid task goals and diverse assembly configurations make it difficult for imitation policies to infer the intended skill from raw observations alone, particularly when training data cannot cover the combinatorial diversity of real-world configurations and part geometries. We show that incorporating task context through language alleviates these challenges by providing explicit structure for skill selection and associating language-specified tasks with their corresponding manipulation targets in the visual scene. The proposed framework combines hierarchical task selection with task-context-aware imitation learning to ground language instructions in spatial visual representations for robotic disassembly. The resulting framework generalizes across diverse connector geometries and assembly configurations without requiring explicit object annotations. Our method improves end-to-end task success by 35 percentage points over the baseline diffusion policy and by 75 percentage points over the previous task-context-aware baseline.

</details>


### [358] [RAF-VLA: Representation Alignment with the Future for End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17728)
*Dogun Kim,Yongjae Lee,Joonhee Lim,Yeina Lee,Junhyeok Park,Moogeun Park,Dongsuk Kum*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 RAF-VLA 框架，用未来帧表征对齐替代显式未来生成，在 NAVSIM 上以极少开销取得竞争性规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶 VLA 通过显式预测未来驾驶场景（世界建模）来提供密集监督，从而学习有利于规划的丰富内部表征；但这带来两个关键问题：额外的训练负担和推理延迟。

Method: 提出 RAF-VLA，通过未来帧表征的直接引导来塑造与规划相关的内部表征。其核心为"未来对齐监督微调"：在学习驾驶动作的同时，用简单正则项将策略的隐藏状态与预训练世界编码器得到的未来帧表征对齐。

Result: 在 NAVSIM 基准上的大量实验表明，RAF-VLA 以显著更少的训练样本量达到与 SOTA VLA 规划器相当的规划性能；仅增加 3.8% 训练开销与可忽略的 1 ms 推理开销。

Conclusion: 通过对齐未来帧表征而非生成未来帧，RAF-VLA 在保留世界建模监督收益的同时规避了其训练负担与推理延迟，为高效 VLA 自动驾驶规划提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving have incorporated world modeling by predicting future driving scenes alongside driving actions, demonstrating strong planning performance. Future driving scenes are utilized as dense supervision, encouraging the policy to learn rich internal representations useful for planning. However, these World-Modeling VLAs rely on explicit future generation to learn such representations, thereby introducing two key limitations: additional training burden and inference latency. To address these limitations, we propose RAF-VLA (Representation Alignment with the Future), a VLA-based autonomous driving framework that shapes planning-relevant internal representations through direct guidance from future-frame representations. RAF-VLA employs Future-Aligned Supervised Fine-Tuning, in which a straightforward regularization aligns the policy's hidden states with future-frame representations obtained from a pretrained world encoder while learning driving actions. This simple alignment allows RAF-VLA to avoid the training burden and inference latency associated with future generation. Extensive experiments on the NAVSIM benchmark show that RAF-VLA achieves competitive planning performance against state-of-the-art VLA planners with substantially fewer training samples seen. Moreover, RAF-VLA incurs only 3.8% training overhead and a negligible 1 ms inference overhead.

</details>


### [359] [CALOS: Control-Affine Lyapunov On-manifold Safety Layer for Safe Deep Reinforcement Learning for Quadrotors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17758)
*Fabrizio Cesareo,Sebastiano Mengozzi,Nicola Mimmo,Andrea Acquaviva*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CALOS是一种运行时安全层，将四旋翼姿态约束与Lyapunov下降条件统一为单个二次规划，通过主动集枚举在三维力矩空间精确求解最小范数修正，实现实时安全约束且不改变原学习算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度强化学习在四旋翼控制中表现优异，但所学策略在训练和部署阶段均无法保证满足安全约束，存在姿态越界等风险。

Method: CALOS将四个倾角不等式与一个Lyapunov下降条件建模为单个二次规划，其解为策略标称力矩输出的最小范数修正；该二次规划在三维力矩空间上通过主动集枚举精确求解，计算开销低，可支撑数千个并行仿真环境中的实时约束执行。

Result: 在NVIDIA Isaac Lab的轨迹跟踪任务上，CALOS相对无约束PPO基线将横向跟踪误差降低55-60%，并在训练轨迹上实现零姿态约束违反；同时训练收敛更快、数据效率更高，且未产生次优策略。

Conclusion: CALOS提供了一种不修改底层学习算法的运行时安全层，通过将探索限制在安全状态空间区域，既保证姿态约束的满足，又提升训练收敛速度与数据效率，适用于大规模并行深度强化学习训练。

Abstract: Deep Reinforcement Learning has demonstrated remarkable capability in quadrotor control, yet learned policies offer no guarantee of respecting safety constraints during training or deployment. We present CALOS (Control-Affine Lyapunov On-manifold Safety), a runtime safety layer that enforces attitude constraints on a quadrotor without modifying the underlying learning algorithm. CALOS formulates four tilt-angle inequalities and a Lyapunov descent condition as a single quadratic program whose solution is the minimum-norm correction to the nominal torque output of the policy. The quadratic program is solved exactly via active-set enumeration over the three-dimensional torque space, with a computational cost low enough to enforce constraints in real time across thousands of parallel simulation environments, as required by modern massively parallel Deep Reinforcement Learning training. Evaluated on trajectory-tracking tasks in NVIDIA Isaac Lab, CALOS reduces lateral tracking error by 55-60% relative to an unconstrained Proximal Policy Optimization baseline while achieving zero attitude-constraint violations on the training trajectory. By restricting exploration to safe regions of the state space, the safety layer also accelerates training convergence and improves data efficiency without producing suboptimal policies.

</details>


### [360] [DRT&R: Direct Radar Teach & Repeat](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17766)
*Alexander Krawciw,Daniil Lisus,Cedric Le Gentil,Timothy D. Barfoot*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出DRT&R——一种结合直接雷达处理与局部建图的旋转雷达导航栈，在公路与越野环境下实现厘米级定位并完成闭环实时自主导航。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 雷达导航对雨雪、尘埃、雾霾等恶劣条件具有鲁棒性，可弥补激光雷达失效的缺陷。已有的"直接法"（保留并使用完整雷达扫描而非稀疏点）虽提升了公路全局定位性能，但尚未应用于越野环境或闭环系统。此外，直接全局地图会平滑掉依赖视角的雷达伪影，而这些伪影在"示教-重演"轨迹相似时能提供位姿信息，因此全局地图可能损失关键信息。

Method: 提出Direct Radar Teach &amp; Repeat（DRT&amp;R）：将直接雷达处理与局部建图相结合，构建直接旋转雷达导航栈，通过局部建图最大化保留雷达信息量。

Result: 在344 km公路数据和20 km越野数据上，多数公路与越野场景定位误差在4 cm以内，几何退化与稀疏环境下为12 cm；使用Clearpath Warthog越野车配合MPC控制器完成超过10 km的闭环自主导航，验证了实时性与SOTA跟踪性能。

Conclusion: DRT&amp;R在公路与越野环境下均达到SOTA定位性能，并首次在闭环系统中验证了直接雷达导航的实时性与有效性。

Abstract: Radar-based navigation is appealing for its robustness to adverse conditions involving airborne particles, such as precipitation, dust, fog, and smoke, that can cause lidar-based systems to fail. Recently, direct methods that retain and use the entire radar scan rather than sparse points have improved on-road global localization performance. However, they have yet to be deployed in off-road environments or in closed-loop systems. Additionally, even direct global maps may lose information: their global nature leads to a smoothing out of viewpoint-dependent radar artifacts, which can provide pose information when mapping and localization occur along similar trajectories. This paper introduces Direct Radar Teach & Repeat (DRT&R): a direct spinning radar-based navigation stack that maximizes the amount of retained information by combining direct radar processing with local mapping. DRT&R yields state-of-the-art (SOTA) localization performance in both on-road and off-road environments. Using 344 km of on-road data and 20 km of off-road data, DRT&R is able to localize to within 4 cm in most on-road and off-road conditions, and 12 cm in geometrically degenerate and sparse environments. DRT&R is also evaluated autonomously in closed loop with an MPC controller for more than 10 km using a Clearpath Warthog off-road vehicle, demonstrating that it runs in real time and achieves SOTA tracking performance for off-road radar navigation.

</details>


### [361] [HINT-Plan: Human Intention-Aware Robot Task Planning in Context-Rich Environments using Vision Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17771)
*Yuchen Liu,Luigi Palmieri,Lujun Li,Radu State,Ilche Georgievski,Marco Aiello*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HINT-Plan将VLM预测的高层人类意图整合进机器人任务规划：以分层场景图表示环境并转为形式化规划语言，联合求解人-机器人任务规划，在仿真中成功率达69.71%，领先基线最高35.29%并减少功能冲突。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有将人类意识纳入移动机器人决策的方法主要集中于底层运动规划中的避障，忽视了人类存在带来的挑战及高层行为问题，缺乏将人类意图预测融入任务规划的手段。

Method: 提出HINT-Plan：用视觉语言模型（VLM）从第三人称图像观测中预测高层人类意图，并将其转换为目标状态；采用分层场景图（SG）作为环境高层表示以支持富含上下文环境中的场景感知；将环境拓扑与可操作知识翻译为形式化规划语言，构建并求解人-机器人联合任务规划问题，保证计划可执行。

Result: 在逼真度较高的仿真环境中，HINT-Plan在人-机器人联合任务规划中总体成功率达69.71%，较基线最高提升35.29%，同时减少了功能冲突。

Conclusion: 结果验证了将推断出的人类意图显式纳入形式化多智能体任务规划，对实现主动式人类感知机器人决策的有效性。

Abstract: Approaches to incorporating human awareness into mobile robot decision-making mainly focus on collision avoidance in low-level motion planning, often overlooking the challenges posed by human presence and high-level behavior. To address this vacancy, we present HINT-Plan, a novel approach to integrate human intention prediction into robot task planning. HINT-Plan employs Vision Language Models (VLMs) to anticipate high-level human intentions from third-person image observations, convert them into goal states, and solve joint task-planning problems. To effectively enable scene awareness in context-rich environments, we use hierarchical Scene Graphs (SGs) as high-level representations of the environment, and translate environmental topology and actionable knowledge into formal planning language to ensure executable plans. Evaluated in a photorealistic simulation, HINT-Plan achieves an overall success rate of 69.71% in joint human-robot task planning, substantially outperforming the baselines by up to 35.29%, while also reducing functional conflicts. The results show the effectiveness of explicitly incorporating inferred human intentions into formal multi-agent task planning for proactive human-aware robot decision-making.

</details>


### [362] [SPROUT: The Open-Source Soft Growing Robot for Search and Rescue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17781)
*Antonio Alvarez Valdivia,Ciera McFarland,Robert Reeve,Ankush Dhawan,Chad Council,Megan Richardson,Margaret McGuinness,Nathaniel Hanson*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文介绍了模块化软体机器人系统SPROUT（Soft Pathfinding Robotic Observation Unit），旨在解决软体机器人从实验室走向野外搜救现场的可复制性和可靠性问题，并公开全套代码、清单、CAD与装配说明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软体机器人长期被认为适合搜救作业，但难以从实验室过渡到实际现场，缺乏可复制、可靠的系统方案。

Method: 经多年与专业城市搜救团队互动迭代设计，采用模块化硬件与基于ROS 2的软件栈，支持任务专用载荷与控制功能，并附带代码、零件清单、CAD装配与组装指南等补充材料。

Result: SPROUT在急救人员使用的坍塌结构训练场地中完成了多种具挑战性的检测与通行任务，并扩展应用于基础设施检测与考古等场景。

Conclusion: SPROUT为软体机器人走向真实搜救现场提供了可复制、可定制的系统方案，并通过开放资源促进研究社区共建与跨领域应用。

Abstract: Soft robotic systems have long been theorized as ideal candidates for use in search and rescue operations; however, there have been significant barriers to entry in graduating soft robotic systems from the laboratory to the field. To address this gap in replicable, reliable soft robot systems, we present the designs for SPROUT, the Soft Pathfinding Robotic Observation Unit. The system has matured over years of interaction with professional urban search and rescue communities, with the goal of operating in dusty, wet, and isolated conditions. This manuscript contains supplementary material, including code, parts manifests, CAD assemblies, and build instructions to allow the broader robotics research community to build their own SPROUT systems. The modular hardware and ROS 2-based software stack support task-specific payloads and control functions, allowing SPROUT to be adapted for applications beyond search and rescue, including infrastructure inspection and archaeology. Here, we demonstrate SPROUT performing a variety of challenging inspection and traversal tasks in collapsed structure training sites used by first responders. The main project page is available online at https://sprout-mitll.github.io/sprout/.

</details>


### [363] [Learning Multi-Humanoid Pickup and Transport via Decentralized Object-Centric Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17824)
*Bikram Pandit,Mohitvishnu S. Gadde,Aayam Kumar Shrestha,Alan Fern*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出以物体为中心的分散控制方法与"附着区域"接口，使不同规模人形机器人团队无需按任务重新设计，即可完成抓取、协同搬运与机器人间交接，并实现仿真到真机的迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多机器人协同搬运不同尺寸、重量与几何形状的物体时，团队规模需要随之变化，传统方法往往需针对每个任务单独设计控制策略，缺乏统一的控制抽象，泛化性与可扩展性受限。

Method: 采用分散式、以物体为中心的控制：为每个机器人分配共享物体上的局部附着区域，通过无夹爪的双臂捏取实现抓取与搬运；该基于附着的接口构成统一控制抽象，覆盖单机抓取、多机协同搬运与机器人间交接。训练与验证在仿真中进行，覆盖不同团队规模与物体几何，并开展真机sim-to-real迁移实验。

Result: 仅在单机抓取任务上训练的策略即可非平凡地迁移到协同场景；显式多机训练可进一步提升性能，表明共享物体耦合带来值得直接学习的协同动力学。仿真中在不同团队规模与物体几何下验证有效，并在硬件上成功实现真人人形机器人的协同操作。

Conclusion: 以物体为中心的附着接口是一种可扩展、任务无关的协同操作控制抽象；单机训练提供有效的初始化与迁移基础，而多机耦合动力学值得直接学习。方法兼具仿真可扩展性与真机可行性，为不同规模人形机器人团队的协同搬运提供了统一框架。

Abstract: We study cooperative multi-humanoid pickup and transport of objects with varying size, weight, and geometry, requiring robot teams of different sizes. Our approach uses decentralized object-centric control, where each humanoid is assigned a local attachment region on the shared object and learns to realize pickup and transport through gripperless bimanual pinching. This attachment-based interface provides a common control abstraction spanning single-robot pickup, cooperative multi-robot transport, and robot-to-robot handover, without per-task redesign. We find that policies trained only on single-robot pickup already transfer nontrivially to cooperative settings, suggesting that this abstraction captures much of the structure needed for coordination. At the same time, explicit multi-robot training further improves performance, showing that shared-object coupling introduces coordination dynamics that are beneficial to learn directly. We validate the approach in simulation across varying team sizes and object geometries, and demonstrate sim-to-real transfer on hardware, where the learned controllers enable real humanoids to perform cooperative manipulation tasks.

</details>


### [364] [Adaptive-MHE : A Sampling-Based Adaptive MPC for Legged Loco-Manipulation via Moving Horizon Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17832)
*Hossein Keshavarz,Alejandro Ramirez-Serrano,Majid Khadiv*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了自适应移动视界估计框架Adaptive-MHE，将在线采样式系统辨识与采样式模型预测控制耦合，实现未知环境下腿足机器人的自适应移动-操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 腿足机器人移动-操作中，物体与地形参数（如质量、摩擦）通常未知，仿真与真实参数失配导致sim-to-real gap，损害控制性能。经典系统辨识依赖可微动力学假设，而接触丰富的腿足系统不满足该假设；采样式系统辨识虽规避此限制，但现有方法多为离线应用，无法随环境变化在线自适应。

Method: 提出Adaptive-MHE，一种基于移动视界估计(MHE)的在线采样式系统辨识框架。通过大规模并行rollout匹配仿真与记录的状态轨迹，在线估计物体与地形物理参数（质量、摩擦等），并将该估计与采样式模型预测控制器耦合，形成闭环自适应控制。

Result: 在仿真与硬件实验中，该框架性能持续优于基线方法，并达到使用真值参数控制器的性能水平。

Conclusion: 在线采样式MHE系统辨识可有效缓解接触丰富腿足系统的sim-to-real gap，使机器人在变化与不确定环境中实现自适应移动-操作，是替代依赖可微动力学经典方法的有力方案。

Abstract: Legged robots have demonstrated a remarkable ability to traverse various terrains, yet generating effective loco-manipulation behaviors remains challenging. A key difficulty is that object and terrain parameters are typically unknown to the robot, and mismatches between these parameters and their simulated counterparts introduce a sim-to-real gap that degrades control performance. Classical system identification (Sys-ID) methods often assume differentiable dynamics, an assumption that does not hold for contact-rich legged systems. Sampling-based Sys-ID avoids this restriction by directly matching simulated and recorded state trajectories through massively parallel rollouts, but existing approaches are typically applied offline and do not adapt as environmental conditions change. We present Adaptive-MHE an online sampling-based Sys-ID framework, based on moving horizon estimation (MHE), that estimates the physical parameters of objects and terrain in the environment (e.g., mass, friction) and couples this estimate with a sampling-based model predictive controller, enabling adaptive loco-manipulation in changing and uncertain environments. In simulation and hardware experiments, our framework consistently outperforms baselines and matches the performance of a controller with access to ground-truth parameters.

</details>


### [365] [VCTP: Vehicle-Conditioned Terrain Planning for Off-Road Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17834)
*Akshay Naik,Ramavarapu S. Sreenivas,Dustin Nottage,Ahmet Soylemezoglu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Vehicle-Conditioned Terrain Planning (VCTP)，在八个车头朝向下评估共享高程与地表ID图层，结合车体几何、承载轮接触代价及俯仰/侧倾预测，用D* Lite与车辆状态搜索规划前进/倒车路径，并支持观测变化后的选择性重计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车辆朝向会同时改变轮胎下方的地表以及车辆的俯仰与侧倾，因此地形规划应将朝向、车体几何与轮-地接触关系纳入统一的代价与可行性评估中，而非仅按距离或中心点采样进行规划。

Method: VCTP在八个朝向下评估共享的高程与地表ID图层；由车体几何约束可通行性，由承载轮接触确定建模地表代价并预测俯仰与侧倾；采用D* Lite与车辆状态搜索规划含前进与倒车的路线；观测变化时重算所有受影响的机体或接触查询，并采用选择性更新。

Result: 在完全观测的双轨仿真中，轮接触采样相比车辆中心采样使建模地表代价降低39.3%且路线更短；在RGator记录的离线规划中，相较距离导向规划，VCTP降低已识别地表上的建模代价与观测支撑代价，但覆盖不完整导致全程路线排序未定；在474组对比中，选择性更新与完全重计算结果一致。

Conclusion: 结果明确了轮接触采样位置与车辆朝向在何时影响路线选择，表明将车辆朝向与轮-地接触纳入地形规划可降低建模代价并保持更新一致性，同时指出离线全程排序仍受观测覆盖不完整的限制。

Abstract: A vehicle's heading affects both the surfaces beneath its tires and its pitch and roll. We present Vehicle-Conditioned Terrain Planning (VCTP), which retains these relationships by evaluating shared elevation and surface-ID layers at eight headings. Body geometry constrains admissibility, while loaded wheel contacts determine modeled surface cost and predicted pitch and roll. Established D* Lite and vehicle-state search use these evaluations to plan routes with forward and reverse motion. When observations change, VCTP recomputes every affected body or contact query. In fully observed two-track simulations, sampling at wheel contacts rather than at the vehicle center lowers modeled surface cost by 39.3% while shortening the route. In offline planning on RGator recordings, VCTP also reduces modeled costs over identified surfaces and observed support relative to distance-focused planning, although incomplete coverage leaves full-route rankings unresolved. Selective updates match full recomputation in all 474 comparisons using recorded map changes. These results identify when wheel-contact placement and vehicle heading affect route choice.

</details>


### [366] [Timely Activation of Safety Filters via One-Step Reachability Expansion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17904)
*Javier Borquez*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文针对离散采样导致最小限制安全滤波器失效的问题，提出基于单步扩展BRT的安全滤波器方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于Hamilton-Jacobi可达性的最小限制安全滤波器依赖连续时间假设，通过系统到达不安全状态集（BRT）边界时才覆盖名义控制器来提供安全保证。但实际机器人系统按离散采样间隔施加控制，导致更新间系统可能跳入不安全BRT，产生理论上可避免的失败。因此需解决连续时间理论与离散执行之间的不匹配问题。

Method: 引入基于单步扩展BRT的原则性方案，该集合预测在一个时间步内能够到达真实BRT的所有状态。将该扩展边界作为安全滤波器的激活条件，使安全干预提前发生。把扩展集构造为修改后的可达性问题，并使用标准连续时间求解器进行计算。

Result: 通过将扩展边界用作激活条件，安全干预足够提前，从而在离散时间执行下确保正确性；扩展集可借助标准连续时间求解器求解。

Conclusion: 该方法弥补了连续时间安全滤波与离散执行之间的差距，保证离散时间执行下的安全性，同时保持最小限制性。

Abstract: Least-restrictive safety filters based on Hamilton-Jacobi reachability provide strong safety guarantees by overriding a nominal controller only when the system reaches the boundary of the set of unsafe states defined as a Backward Reachable Tube (BRT). These guarantees, however, rely on the continuous-time nature of the underlying formulation. In practice, robotic systems apply control at discrete sampling intervals, which creates a mismatch where the system may jump into the unsafe BRT between updates, allowing failures that are theoretically avoidable. This work introduces a principled solution based on a one-step expanded BRT that predicts all states capable of reaching the true BRT within a single timestep. By using this expanded boundary as the activation condition for the safety filter, safety interventions occur early enough to ensure correctness under discrete-time execution. We formulate this expanded set as a modified reachability problem and compute it using standard continuous-time solvers.

</details>


### [367] [Map2Route: Benchmarking Compositional Language-Grounded Route Planning over Semantic Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17910)
*Muyi Bao,Hang Xu,Jingfan Tang,Zihan Liu,Yuxin Cai,Chen Lv,Wenshan Wang,Ji Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Map2Route 基准与 Grounding2Route 方法，用于语义地图上的组合式语言路线规划，性能领先但远未达到人类水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作对语义地图上的语言路线规划任务覆盖有限，仅部分涉及关系/比较/嵌套描述、多类软偏好、避让约束及空间与路线阶段作用域等复杂设定，缺乏统一且具有挑战性的评测基准。

Method: 构建人工标注基准 Map2Route（40 个场景、1000 条情节），指令包含关系、比较与嵌套描述，并涉及必经过区域的有序约束、必避让要求、五类软偏好以及空间与路线阶段作用域；提出 Grounding2Route，将可执行代码作为 grounding，结合验证引导修复与作用域感知规划。

Result: 在七种代表性适配基线上，Grounding2Route 在所有指标上显著优于现有方法；但与人类示范之间仍存在明显差距。

Conclusion: Map2Route 具有较高难度，Grounding2Route 有效但仍有较大提升空间，为后续研究留有充分余地。

Abstract: We introduce Map2Route, a human-curated benchmark for compositional language-grounded route planning over pre-built semantic maps.
