To overcome these limitations, this work introduces a dense direct registration approach that aligns full acoustic intensity scans to a recursively updated local map. Real-time execution is achieved via an Inverse Compositional Gauss-Newton optimization strategy that minimizes computational overhead.
  Experimental evaluations show that this dense method yields significant improvements on translation error compared to sparse keypoint baselines, maintaining stable sub-meter tracking precision over wide displacement gaps. Moreover, this approach delivers odometry performance comparable to multi-sensor fusion pipelines (FLS, DVL, and IMU), bypassing expensive payload dependencies in feature-rich environments. We validate real-world applicability through AUV field trials, running the full local SLAM approach onboard an embedded, resource-constrained computer.

</details>


### [437] [Examining the Difference in Human Behavior Between Virtual and Real-World Human-Robot Teaming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18900)
*Sean Dallas,Absalat Getachew,Motaz AbuHijleh,Andrea Macklem-Zabel,Douglas Zytko,Mark Brudnak,Wing-Yue Geoffrey Louie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文通过用户实验比较了人在虚拟与真实环境中进行人-机器人团队协作（HRT）时的行为差异，发现两种模态在工作负荷上存在显著差异，并在策略、机器人心理模型与信任类型上呈现质性差别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界中开展人-机器人团队协作（HRT）场景的原型设计与评估成本高昂，虚拟仿真被用作替代方案来研究用户感知、行为与绩效；但虚拟实验的有效性取决于人类行为在真实与虚拟世界间是否一致，因此需要检验两种模态下行为的差异。

Method: 开展用户研究，将同一HRT场景分别置于虚拟环境和真实环境中进行对照；采用混合方法（定量与质性相结合）测量并分析团队绩效与人的因素。

Result: 定量结果显示两种模态之间在工作负荷上存在显著差异；质性分析进一步补充了定量结果，发现参与者在策略、对机器人的心理模型以及对机器人所持信任类型方面均存在模态间差异。

Conclusion: 虚拟与真实环境下的人-机器人团队协作行为并不完全一致，主要体现在工作负荷、策略、机器人心理模型和信任类型上；这提示以虚拟仿真替代真实用户研究时需谨慎对待其有效性与结论外推。

Abstract: Prototyping and evaluating human-robot teaming (HRT) scenarios in the real-world is costly. Virtual simulation of HRT scenarios has been adopted as an alternative to conducting user studies in the real-world to investigate user perceptions, behaviors, and performance during human-robot interactions. The consistency of human behavior between the real and virtual-worlds is integral to the validity of utilizing such virtual experimentation. This paper presents a user study examining the difference in human behavior between an HRT scenario conducted in a virtual vs real environment. We employed mixed-methods to examine team performance and human factors during the HRT. Our quantitative results showed a significant difference in workload between the two modalities. Our qualitative analysis expanded on the quantitative results and found differences in participants' strategy, their mental model of robots, and the type of trust they had for robots between modalities.

</details>


### [438] [CaSCo: Cascade-Aware Soft-Collision Motion Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18910)
*Shivaram Kumar,Gaoyuan Liu,Yoonchang Sung*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出CaSCo——一个级联感知的软碰撞运动规划框架，利用语言/视觉语言模型为物体分配语义风险，借助物理仿真预测候选动作后果，并搜索使被直接或级联碰撞位移物体的总语义风险最小的路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统运动规划将碰撞视为二元约束，但接触不同物体的后果差异巨大（如纸箱可安全擦碰，而玻璃、笔记本电脑或不稳定物体即使轻微接触也不可接受）。此外，机器人直接碰撞会移动物体并触发次级物体间碰撞，使运动风险取决于场景的物理演化，而非仅由机器人几何路径决定。

Method: (1) 用视觉语言模型或语言模型为物体赋予语义风险；(2) 用物理仿真器预测候选机器人运动的后果；(3) 搜索使"被直接或级联碰撞位移的唯一物体"的总语义风险最小的路径；(4) 由于碰撞会改变环境，将路图状态扩展为"预测的物体布局 + 已产生风险的物体集合"；(5) 提出带可采纳且一致级联松弛启发式的最优图搜索算法，并设计缓存与剪枝机制以提升搜索效率。

Result: 在杂乱操作环境中的实验评估了语义风险、级联推理、规划效率以及真机运行表现。

Conclusion: CaSCo将碰撞从二元约束推广为语义与级联感知的风险优化问题，并通过最优图搜索与高效剪枝在杂乱环境中实现兼顾语义风险、级联推理与规划效率的运动规划，并验证了真机可行性。

Abstract: Conventional motion planning treats collision as a binary constraint, although contact with different objects can have drastically different consequences. A robot may safely brush against a cardboard box while even minor contact with a glass, laptop, or unstable object may be undesirable. Moreover, a direct robot--object collision can move the contacted object and trigger secondary object--object collisions, making the risk of a motion depend on the physical evolution of the scene rather than only on the robot's geometric path. We present CaSCo, a cascade-aware soft-collision motion planning framework in which a vision-language or language model assigns semantic risk to objects and a physics simulator predicts the consequences of candidate robot motions. CaSCo searches for a path that minimizes the total semantic risk of the unique objects displaced either directly by the robot or indirectly through cascaded collisions. Because collisions change the environment, we augment roadmap states with the predicted object arrangement and the set of objects whose risk has already been incurred. We develop an optimal graph-search algorithm with an admissible and consistent cascade-relaxed heuristic and caching and pruning mechanisms for efficient search. Experiments in cluttered manipulation environments evaluate semantic risk, cascade reasoning, planning efficiency, and real-robot operation.

</details>


### [439] [Learning Holistic Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation with a Bipedal Mobile Manipulator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18930)
*Zhongyu Chen,Yuxuan Nai,Qian Chen,Yidong Zhu,Chen Jing,Qihan Wang,Xudong Li,Zhizhan Li,Leixin Chang,Liangjing Yang,Hua Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种用强化学习训练的统一全身控制器，直接将6自由度末端执行器目标映射为双臂与双足底座的协调动作，自动完成伸手、姿态调整与迈步，无需显式底座速度或脚步指令。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双臂操作的工作空间受臂长限制，需通过行走与操作的协调（loco-manipulation）扩展可达范围。这要求底层全身控制器在保持平衡的同时，把任务级操作目标转化为手臂与腿部的协同运动。

Method: 基于强化学习训练统一全身控制器：输入仅为6-DoF末端目标，输出双足底座与机械臂的协调动作；采用奖励门控（reward-gating）策略调节末端跟踪、行走与平衡之间的权衡；设计时序上下文估计器，融合窗口化Transformer编码、GRU循环记忆与辅助动力学预测，从观测历史中提取动力学相关信息。

Result: 真机实验表明，同一控制器可在VR遥操作、学习得到的扩散策略以及脚本化轨迹等不同指令来源下，支持伸手、姿态调整与迈步，为多种操作任务提供统一的末端接口。

Conclusion: 以末端目标为唯一任务接口的全身控制策略可自主协调平衡、行走与操作，验证了统一策略在多源指令与多任务下的通用性与实用性。

Abstract: Bipedal loco-manipulation enables robots to interact with objects beyond the nominal workspace of their arms by coordinating locomotion and manipulation. Realizing this capability requires a low-level whole-body controller that translates task-level manipulation goals into coordinated arm and leg motions while maintaining balance. We present a unified whole-body controller trained with reinforcement learning that directly maps 6-DoF end-effector targets to coordinated actions for the bipedal base and robotic arm. Given only an end-effector target, the learned controller autonomously coordinates reaching, postural adaptation, and stepping without explicit base-velocity or footstep commands. A reward-gating strategy regulates the trade-offs among end-effector tracking, locomotion, and balance during training, while a temporal context estimator combines windowed Transformer encoding, recurrent GRU memory, and auxiliary dynamics prediction to extract dynamics-relevant information from observation history. Real-robot experiments demonstrate that the same controller supports reaching, postural adaptation, and stepping under commands from VR teleoperation, a learned diffusion policy, and scripted trajectories, providing a common end-effector interface for diverse manipulation tasks.

</details>


### [440] ["What's going to happen after I'm gone?": Parent Perspectives on Technology in Supporting Independent Living for Adults with Intellectual Disabilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18970)
*Alexander Tyshka,Andrea Macklem-Zabel,Absalat Getachew,Foong Ling Chen,Wing-Yue Geoffrey Louie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 通过访谈16位正处于“过渡期”的IDD成年人父母，提炼照护管理经验与辅助技术需求，并据此提出4条面向成长的辅助技术设计原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IDD成年人正从家庭居所转向半独立生活，父母卸任主要照护者角色时面临持续、优质支持的安排难题；同时，父母掌握大量关于子女需求的显性与隐性知识，但如何将这些经验转化为辅助技术设计依据尚不清晰。

Method: 对16位刚开始经历该过渡的IDD成年人父母进行访谈，围绕三方面展开：日常支持方式及其有效性、使用技术的经验与认知、对辅助技术融入新居或其他支持以促进独立的设想；随后采用主题分析归纳主题并推导设计原则。

Result: 主题分析得到四个主题：常见支持模式；支持成长所需的日常惯例内部机制；跨过渡期照护连续性的脆弱性；参与者对辅助技术的认知与体验。基于此提出四条面向成长的设计原则。

Conclusion: 面向成长的辅助技术设计应关注:过渡前的引导以捕捉照护者隐性知识；面向长期成长的结构化支架；对日常波动做出反应的自适应感知；兼顾个体化定制与照护网络一致性的平衡。

Abstract: Adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD) are increasingly transitioning from family homes towards semi-inde\-pendent living. As parents hand off the role of primary caregiver, they face numerous challenges in arranging consistent and quality support. Our research centers on understanding these caregiving routines. By focusing on the unique lived experience of parents, who possess extensive explicit and tacit knowledge of their adult child's requirements, we aim to map the management of care they provide. This foundational understanding is essential to identifying how assistive technologies can effectively serve a key role in supporting adults with IDD in this transition. In this work, we interviewed 16 parents of adults with IDD beginning this transition to understand: 1) how they currently provide support for daily living and what makes their support effective; 2) what their experiences and perceptions are regarding the use of technology; and 3) how they envision assistive technology successfully integrating with their adult child's new home or with other supports to promote independence. Our thematic analysis produced four themes: common modes of support, inside the routine to support growth, the fragility of continuity of care across transitions, and participants' perceptions and experiences of assistive technology. Building on these findings, we derive four design principles for growth-oriented assistive technology. These include pre-transition onboarding to capture caregiver tacit knowledge; structured scaffolding towards long-term growth; adaptive sensing that responds to day-to-day variability; and customization for the individual balanced with consistency for the care network.

</details>


### [441] [Information-Based Trajectory Planning for Spacecraft-to-Spacecraft Tracking and Navigation in Cislunar Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19012)
*Trevor N. Wolf,Brandon A. Jones,Jay W. McMahon*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种权衡信息采集与控制代价的轨迹规划方法，用于提升地月空间航天器间绝对跟踪性能，可将光学观测器的预期导航与跟踪误差改善近一个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地月空间活动扩大，需减少对地面支持的依赖；航天器间跟踪利用相对测量中的非线性动力学示踪信息推断观测器与目标绝对状态，而两者几何关系显著影响跟踪性能，因此需设计兼顾几何信息与燃料的观测器轨迹。

Method: 将信息论指标（信息增益）嵌入最优控制问题，设计观测器轨迹以联合平衡控制代价与预期跟踪性能；方法支持多低推力观测平台、多种传感模态及多目标规划。

Result: 针对运行于远距离逆行轨道（DRO）的光学观测器，预期导航与跟踪误差改善近一个数量级。

Conclusion: 验证了面向当前及未来地月任务的信息最优低推力轨迹设计的可行性与价值。

Abstract: We present a trajectory planning method that balances information collection and control effort to improve cislunar spacecraft-to-spacecraft absolute tracking. Expanding use of cislunar space requires alternative navigation and tracking procedures that minimize reliance on ground-based support. Among efforts to address this need, spacecraft-to-spacecraft tracking exploits nonlinear dynamical tracers encoded in a series of relative measurements to infer absolute states of both an observer and a target. The geometry between spacecraft operating under this mode can significantly influence tracking performance. This work considers this geometrical impact by designing observer trajectories that jointly balance control effort and an information-theoretic quantification of the expected spacecraft-to-spacecraft tracking performance. Our methods are designed for multiple low-thrust observation platforms of various sensing modalities and can incorporate multiple space object targets in planning. By leveraging information gain in the optimal control problem, we report almost an order of magnitude improvement in the expected navigation and tracking errors for an optical observer operating in a Distant Retrograde Orbit (DRO). This work demonstrates the feasibility and value of information-optimal low-thrust spacecraft trajectory design for current and upcoming cislunar missions.

</details>


### [442] [Learning to Stack: Cube-Stacking Imitation Learning from Virtual Reality Demonstrations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19040)
*Gryffin Reizian,Jordan Dowdy,Jean Chagas Vaz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于虚拟现实（VR）的立方体堆叠示教数据采集与复用流水线：在NVIDIA Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab中操控自定义5自由度机械臂，操作员通过HTC Vive Pro 2、Manus Quantum手套和OpenXR输入SE(3)末端执行器指令；框架将示教采集与数据集构建解耦，通过回放轨迹、任务空间到关节空间转换及重新渲染，实现示教数据在不同观测/动作空间下的复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作中的模仿学习受限于示教数据采集瓶颈，尤其对于需要反复重置场景的多阶段任务，采集成本高且数据难以复用。本文动机是降低示教采集与场景重置负担，并让已采集示教可复用于新的观测与动作空间，避免重复人工遥操作。

Method: 在NVIDIA Isaac Sim与Isaac Lab中搭建VR数据采集流水线，使用HTC Vive Pro 2、Manus Quantum手套与OpenXR由操作员给出SE(3)末端指令，控制自定义5-DoF机械臂完成红-蓝-红-绿立方体堆叠任务，立方体位置随机化。框架将示教采集与数据集构建分离：回放记录轨迹，把任务空间指令转换为关节空间动作，并以更新后的传感器或状态配置重新渲染示教。此外使用Isaac Mimic生成额外样本，并基于LeRobot风格双相机观测训练行为克隆策略。

Result: 30分钟内采集200条虚拟示教，对比45条真实世界示教；Isaac Mimic额外生成100个样本。使用虚拟示教训练行为克隆策略，采用LeRobot风格双相机观测，并在仿真中完成评估。

Conclusion: VR流水线可高效采集多阶段操作示教，并通过轨迹回放与任务空间-关节空间转换实现数据复用，减少重复遥操作；结合仿真数据增强与行为克隆策略，可支撑虚拟示教向策略学习的有效转化。

Abstract: Imitation learning is attractive for robot manipulation, but collecting demonstrations remains a bottleneck for multi-stage tasks requiring repeated scene resets. This work presents a virtual-reality data-collection pipeline for cube-stacking with a custom 5-DoF arm in NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab. Using an HTC Vive Pro 2, Manus Quantum gloves, and OpenXR, an operator provides SE(3) end-effector commands to generate task demonstrations. The proposed framework separates demonstration collection from dataset construction by replaying recorded trajectories, converting task-space commands into joint-space actions, and re-rendering demonstrations with updated sensor or state configurations. This allows previously collected demonstrations to be reused for new observation and action spaces without repeating human teleoperation. The task requires stacking the red cube on the blue cube and the green cube on the red cube, with randomized cube placement. In 30 minutes, 200 virtual demonstrations were collected, compared with 45 real-world demonstrations, and Isaac Mimic generated 100 additional samples. A behavior-cloning policy was trained from the virtual demonstrations using LeRobot-style dual-camera observations and evaluated in simulation.

</details>


### [443] [Loco-Loco-RL: Low-Cost Terrain Mapping for Humanoid Locomotion with Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19041)
*Jordan Dowdy,Gryffin Reizian,Jean Chagas Vaz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于低成本飞行时间（ToF）传感器的紧凑3D局部地形表征方法，并设计token压缩的时序Transformer策略，用于人形机器人地形行走，实现了稳健的仿真到现实迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人强化学习行走需要地形感知，但深度相机和LiDAR成本高、功耗大、处理开销高，且常输出冗余的高分辨率数据，因此需要一种低成本、紧凑的地形感知方案。

Method: 使用低成本ToF传感器提供紧凑的3D局部地形表征；提出token压缩的时序Transformer策略：将本体感知与地形观测token化，经自注意力多头Transformer捕捉单时间步内各观测项关系；通过基于MLP的隐空间token压缩模块压缩后存入15步滚动历史；再由交叉注意力多头Transformer从紧凑历史中提取时序运动特征用于策略学习。压缩先于时序聚合，既保留地形观测结构又抑制注意力维度随历史增长。

Result: 在基于地形的行走基准上，通过仿真到现实迁移在实体硬件上验证，实现了使用低成本局部地形感知的稳健人形地形行走。

Conclusion: 低成本ToF传感器结合token压缩时序Transformer策略，可在有限算力与感知输入下实现稳健的人形机器人地形行走，验证了紧凑外感知表征与高效时序建模的有效性。

Abstract: Informative terrain perception is important for robust reinforcement learning policies in humanoid locomotion. Still, common sensors such as depth cameras and LiDARs incur high cost, power, and processing overhead while often producing redundant, high-resolution data. This work uses a low-cost time-of-flight sensor to provide a compact 3D local terrain representation for humanoid locomotion. To efficiently use this sparse exteroceptive input, we introduce a token-compressed temporal transformer policy. Proprioceptive and terrain observations are tokenized and processed by a self-attention multi-head transformer to capture within-timestep relationships between observation terms. The attended tokens are then compressed through an MLP-based latent-space token compression module before being stored in a rolling 15-timestep history. A second cross-attention multi-head transformer extracts temporal locomotion features from this compact history for policy learning. By compressing tokens before temporal aggregation, the architecture preserves important terrain-observation structure while limiting the dimensional growth of attention over observation histories. We validate our method through sim-to-real transfer on physical hardware using a terrain-based locomotion benchmark, demonstrating robust humanoid terrain walking with low-cost local terrain sensing.

</details>


### [444] [ElastiQP: An Always-Feasible QP Solver for Constrained Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19080)
*Daniel Morton,Jon Arrizabalaga,Zachary Manchester,Marco Pavone*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ElastiQP是一种改进的对偶主动集QP求解器，通过对每个不等式约束施加精确的l1惩罚进行松弛、保持等式约束（动力学）为硬约束，将松弛变量解析地折叠进求解器以维持冷凝线性系统规模不变，从而在不可行问题上返回可用解，速度最高比最优替代求解器快40倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着机器人能力提升，基于二次规划（QP）的控制器需要处理越来越多的约束以保证安全可靠运行。但每增加一个约束，就增加了瞬时冲突的可能性；一旦QP求解器返回"不可行"状态，控制器将没有任何可执行的指令。

Method: 提出ElastiQP：一种改进的对偶主动集QP求解器。它对每个不等式约束施加精确的逐约束l1惩罚以进行松弛，同时保持等式约束（动力学）为硬约束。其关键之处在于将松弛变量解析地折叠进求解器，从而保持冷凝线性系统规模恒定。

Result: 在机器人控制基准测试套件上，ElastiQP达到微秒级性能，在可行问题上与主流现代求解器持平或更优；在不可行问题上能优雅处理，将违反限制严格局限于冲突的不等式项，返回可用解的速度比最优替代求解器快至多40倍。

Conclusion: ElastiQP以开源C++仅头文件库形式提供，并带有Python和JAX接口（https://github.com/StanfordASL/elastiqp），为机器人控制中的QP不可行问题提供了快速、可用的解决方案。

Abstract: As robot capabilities increase, quadratic programming (QP)-based controllers must account for a similarly increasing number of constraints to ensure safe, reliable operation. Yet, with each added constraint, this introduces more chances of momentary conflict: in which case, a QP solver that returns an "infeasible" status leaves the controller with nothing to execute. To address this, we introduce ElastiQP, a modified dual active-set QP solver that relaxes every inequality constraint with an exact, per-constraint l1 penalty while keeping equality constraints (dynamics) hard. Notably, ElastiQP does so by folding the slack variables into the solver analytically, maintaining a constant size of the condensed linear system. On a suite of robot control benchmarks, ElastiQP achieves microsecond-level performance, matching or outperforming leading modern solvers on feasible problems. On infeasible problems, ElastiQP handles these gracefully, confining violations to strictly the conflicting inequality terms, returning a usable solution up to 40x faster than the best alternative solvers. ElastiQP is available as an open-source C++ header-only library, with Python and JAX interfaces, at https://github.com/StanfordASL/elastiqp.

</details>


### [445] [rMuscle: Robotic Muscle Memory for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Model Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19104)
*Kaijun Zhou,Zhiyang Li,Le Chen,Jinyu Gu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 rMuscle，一个受人类肌肉记忆启发的实时 VLA 推理框架，利用跨执行相似性（观察、动作轨迹及内部模型状态）构建双阶段缓存，在保持成功率的同时实现 1.29-1.42X 加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工厂作业是具身 AI 的重要早期场景，VLA 模型已成为主流策略范式，其推理延迟直接影响机器人响应速度与运动平滑性。但现有 VLA 推理框架未充分利用具身工作负载特性，也未针对 VLA 推理不同阶段的瓶颈进行区分优化。

Method: 首先对具身工作负载进行表征，发现重复执行间存在显著任务相似性，且该相似性不仅限于观察和动作轨迹，还延伸至模型内部状态。据此提出 rMuscle 双阶段肌肉记忆缓存：Context Cache 复用视觉 token 输出以减少计算；Action Cache 复用神经元激活模式以减少权重访问。通过在线缓存重计算、滑动窗口缓存检索和跨连续去噪步骤的掩码共享，降低缓存内存占用与访问开销。

Result: 在 RTX 4090 与 Jetson Thor 上，于 LIBERO、RoboTwin 及物理操作任务中取得 1.29-1.42X 加速，并在真实机器人上保持原始成功率。

Conclusion: 利用跨执行相似性进行内部状态级缓存复用是提升 VLA 实时推理效率的有效途径，rMuscle 在多种平台与任务上兼顾了加速与成功率。

Abstract: Factory work is a promising early scenario for embodied AI: assigning repetitive manual jobs to robots has clear economic payoff, and a structured station keeps the jobs tractable for current policies. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models now dominate as the policy paradigm for these robots. The inference latency of VLA models directly affects robot responsiveness and motion smoothness. However, existing VLA inference frameworks do not fully exploit the characteristics of embodied workloads or account for the distinct bottlenecks across different stages of VLA inference.
  In this paper, we first characterize embodied workloads and identify substantial task similarity across repeated robot executions. We further find that such similarity extends beyond observations and action trajectories to internal model states. Drawing on these observations, we present rMuscle, a real-time VLA inference framework inspired by human muscle memory. It exploits cross-execution similarity through a dual-phase muscle-memory cache. The Context Cache reuses visual-token outputs to reduce computation, while the Action Cache reuses neuron activation patterns to reduce weight accesses. We keep both the cache memory footprint and access overhead low through online cache recomputation, sliding-window cache retrieval, and mask sharing across consecutive denoising steps. rMuscle achieves 1.29-1.42X speedup on RTX 4090 and Jetson Thor across LIBERO, RoboTwin, and physical manipulation tasks, while maintaining the original success rates on real-world robots.

</details>


### [446] [Dreaming the Sound of Contact: Leveraging Video and Audio Generation for Zero-Shot Force-Aware Manipulation and Data Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19137)
*Guanhua Ji,Tianyu Li,Dayoon Suh,Yuqian Zhang,Boyan Zhang,Nadia Figueroa*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该工作提出以生成视频附带的接触音效响度来构造有界、时变的期望力曲线，从而把纯运动学轨迹升级为力感知轨迹，并通过闭环力调节器在Franka Panda上完成接触丰富任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有从生成视频学习操作的方案只能给出纯运动学轨迹，缺失力信息，在需要恰当接触力的接触丰富任务中容易失败。

Method: 构建联合利用生成视频与音频的流水线：从结构化自然语言任务提示中同时导出运动轨迹与对应期望力曲线，用生成接触声音的响度塑造期望力曲线；执行时采用闭环力调节器跟踪该音频塑造的力曲线；并将该流水线作为数据生成引擎训练闭环策略。

Result: 在多个需要建立接触的任务上，该方法成功完成操作，而仅运动学基线失败；同时用其生成数据训练的策略能以闭环方式完成任务。

Conclusion: 生成视频中的音频可作为接触力的有效监督信号，audio-shaped 力曲线使生成式轨迹具备力感知能力，为接触丰富操作提供可执行轨迹与数据生成途径。

Abstract: Recent advances in video generation allow robots to learn manipulation trajectories from generated videos. However, these approaches produce purely kinematic trajectories that lack force information, causing failures in contact-rich tasks where appropriate contact forces are essential for success. In this work, we explore augmenting generated video with audio to shape a bounded, time-varying desired-force profile using the loudness of generated contact sounds. We present a pipeline that jointly leverages generated video and audio to derive motion trajectories and corresponding desired-force profiles from a structured natural-language task prompt. We execute these force-aware trajectories on a Franka Panda robot using a closed-loop force regulator that tracks the audio-shaped force profile during contact. We evaluate our pipeline on multiple tasks that require making contact and demonstrate successful manipulation where a kinematic-only baseline fails. We also use the pipeline as a data generation engine to train policies that achieve the tasks in a closed-loop manner. Project website, videos, and dataset: https://dreamingcontactsound.github.io/

</details>


<div id='q-bio.QM'></div>

# q-bio.QM [[Back]](#toc)

### [447] [Decoding Extrahepatic Targeting of Lipid Nanoparticles with Interpretable Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17721)
*Asal Mehradfar,Mohammad Shahab Sepehri,Owen Antholine,Varun Shankar,Glen S. Kwon,Salman Avestimehr,Morteza Rasoulianboroujeni*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 本文构建可解释机器学习框架，基于476个静脉给药LNP配方的文献数据集与808维特征，预测LNP肝内/肝外蓄积并提炼肝外递送的分子设计规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）虽革新了RNA药物，但系统给药后主要蓄积于肝脏，限制其临床应用；实现肝外靶向需理解脂质化学与配方组成如何共同决定体内生物分布，而现有认知不足且缺乏可预测、可解释的设计依据。

Method: 从81项研究中整理476个静脉注射LNP配方的文献数据集，整合配方组成、脂质化学结构与IVIS生物分布数据；将可电离脂质、辅助脂质、固醇、PEG化/聚合物偶联脂质、附加脂质及聚合物重复单元的标准化SMILES经RDKit Expert描述符转换，并结合配方级变量构成808维特征；采用逻辑回归、随机森林与XGBoost建模，通过SHAP解释与共识特征排序提炼关键特征。

Result: 逻辑回归、随机森林和XGBoost的ROC-AUC分别为0.839、0.866和0.874；可电离脂质描述符主导分布预测，配方组成（尤其可电离脂质、固醇、PEG化/聚合物偶联脂质比例）贡献显著；前20个共识特征在树模型中保留近乎全部预测信息；最具信息量的特征涉及电拓扑表面性质、电荷与疏水性加权表面积、分子拓扑以及酰胺/烷基结构基序。

Conclusion: 本研究建立了可解释、数据驱动的LNP生物分布解码策略，并提供了面向肝外递送的LNP理性设计原则。

Abstract: Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) have transformed RNA medicine, yet their clinical utility remains constrained by predominant hepatic accumulation after systemic administration. Redirecting LNPs to extrahepatic tissues requires understanding of how lipid chemistry and formulation composition jointly govern in vivo biodistribution. Here, we develop an interpretable machine learning framework to predict hepatic versus extrahepatic LNP accumulation and identify molecular design rules for extrahepatic RNA delivery. A literature-derived dataset of 476 intravenous LNP formulations was curated from 81 studies, integrating formulation composition, lipid chemical structures, and IVIS-based biodistribution profiles. Standardized SMILES representations of ionizable lipids, helper lipids, sterols, PEGylated or polymer-conjugated lipids, additional lipids, and polymer repeat units were converted into RDKit Expert descriptors and combined with formulation-level variables to generate an 808-dimensional feature representation. Logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost achieved ROC-AUC values of 0.839, 0.866, and 0.874, respectively. SHAP-based interpretation and consensus feature ranking revealed that ionizable-lipid descriptors dominate biodistribution prediction, while formulation composition, particularly ionizable lipid, sterol, and PEGylated/polymer-conjugated lipid fractions, contributes substantially. The top 20 consensus features retained nearly all predictive information in tree-based models. The most informative features implicated electrotopological surface properties, charge- and hydrophobicity-weighted surface areas, molecular topology, and amide/alkyl structural motifs as drivers of extrahepatic accumulation. This study establishes an interpretable, data-driven strategy for decoding LNP biodistribution and provides actionable design principles for engineering LNPs beyond the liver.

</details>


### [448] [GIA: Germline-Informed Aging with AlphaGenome Finds Genetically Regulated CpGs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17801)
*Sean Lim*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 开发GIA框架，将13个已发表表观遗传时钟的CpG位点映射到血液meQTL，并提示时钟位点高度受生殖细胞遗传变异影响，FHL2位点rs10190186为一典型实例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表观遗传时钟基于选定CpG位点的DNA甲基化估计年龄与衰老表型，但许多CpG甲基化受遗传调控，因此时钟估计中的人群间差异可能部分源于遗传差异而非衰老相关变化；这种遗传贡献的程度此前尚不清楚。

Method: 构建GIA（Germline-Informed Aging）框架：将13个已发表表观遗传时钟所选CpG映射至血液甲基化数量性状位点（meQTL），并用AlphaGenome对相关遗传变异进行评分；以匹配的未使用Illumina 450k探针作为对照评估富集；按预测染色质效应排序以识别关键变异。

Result: 时钟CpG相对匹配的未使用Illumina 450k探针显著富集血液meQTL（62.7% vs 39.6%；OR 2.57），且该现象见于多个时钟家族；按预测染色质效应排序识别出rs10190186，为FHL2的顺式作用变异，预测提高血液染色质可及性（ATAC +1.00；DNase +1.64）及FHL2 RNA（+0.30）。

Conclusion: 年龄信息性甲基化位点强烈受生殖细胞遗传变异影响；FHL2位点说明遗传变异可能塑造被表观遗传时钟反复使用的甲基化特征，需直接检验此类变异是否改变时钟基线估计或纵向衰老轨迹。

Abstract: Epigenetic clocks estimate age and aging-related phenotypes from DNA methylation at selected CpG sites, but the extent to which these inputs are influenced by germline genetic variation is unclear. Because methylation at many CpGs is genetically regulated, some between-person variation in clock estimates may reflect inherited genetic differences rather than aging-related change alone. Here we developed GIA (Germline-Informed Aging), a framework that maps CpGs selected from 13 published epigenetic clocks to blood methylation quantitative trait loci (meQTLs) and scores associated genetic variants with AlphaGenome. We show that clock CpGs were enriched for blood meQTLs relative to matched unused Illumina 450k probes (62.7% versus 39.6%; OR 2.57), across multiple clock families, suggesting that age-informative methylation sites are heavily influenced by germline genetic variation. Ranking by predicted chromatin effect isolated rs10190186, a cis-acting variant at FHL2 predicted to increase blood chromatin accessibility (ATAC +1.00; DNase +1.64) and FHL2 RNA (+0.30). This locus illustrates how inherited variation may shape methylation features repeatedly used by epigenetic clocks, motivating direct tests of whether such variants shift baseline clock estimates or longitudinal aging trajectories.

</details>


### [449] [FlowLOT: Linearized Optimal Transport for Flow Cytometry Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17906)
*Naqib Sad Pathan,Mohammad Shifat-E-Rabbi,Kristofor E. Pas,Ivan Medri,Bartek Rajwa,Gustavo K. Rohde*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: FlowLOT：基于最优传输的流式细胞术分析框架，将样本建模为经验细胞分布并映射为定长特征向量，在少量样本下实现高维分类、可解释可视化与定量推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多参数流式细胞术产生高维、无序的单细胞数据，但分析依赖人工设门，扩展性与可重复性差；现有机器学习方法虽减轻标注负担，却需大训练队列且可解释性有限。

Method: 提出 FlowLOT，基于最优传输（optimal transport）将患者样本的单细胞测量数据视为经验细胞分布，直接映射为定长特征向量，在单一透明架构中统一高维分类、可解释可视化与连续定量推断。

Result: 少样本条件下（FlowCAP-II 每类16例、BLAST110 每类8例）区分健康与AML，平衡准确率分别达94.3%与98.0%；嵌入揭示驱动疾病相关群体偏移的标记层面变异；MRD估计在留出样本上Pearson相关0.82、跨数据集迁移0.79；在临床相关0.1% LAIP阈值下，以100%特异性获得72%敏感性。

Conclusion: FlowLOT 以分布感知框架替代主观人工设门与黑箱深度学习，为现实临床与实验约束下的高维细胞术提供样本高效、可扩展且可解释的解决方案。

Abstract: Multiparameter flow cytometry generates high-dimensional, unordered single-cell mea- surement data for disease diagnosis and monitoring, yet analysis often remains dependent on manual gating, limiting scalability and reproducibility. Existing machine-learning ap- proaches can reduce annotation burden but frequently require large training cohorts and offer limited interpretability. To address these challenges, we introduce FlowLOT , an optimal-transport-based framework that models the single-cell measurement data of a pa- tient sample as an empirical cellular distribution and maps it directly into a fixed-length feature vector. Within a single transparent architecture, FlowLOT unifies high-dimensional classification, interpretable visualization, and continuous quantitative inference. In few-shot regimes, using as few as 16 patients per class on FlowCAP-II and 8 patients per class on BLAST110, it accurately distinguishes healthy from acute myeloid leukemia (AML) sam- ples, reaching 94.3% and 98.0% balanced accuracy, respectively. The underlying embedding exposes marker-level variation driving disease-associated population shifts and enables quantitative measurable residual disease (MRD) estimation, achieving a Pearson correlation of 0.82 on held-out samples and 0.79 under cross-dataset transfer. Furthermore, at the clinically relevant 0.1% threshold for leukemia-associated immunophenotype (LAIP) residual disease, FlowLOT detects positivity with 72% sensitivity at 100% specificity. By replacing subjective manual gating and black-box deep learning with a distribution-aware framework, FlowLOT offers a sample-efficient, scalable, and interpretable solution for high- dimensional cytometry under realistic clinical and experimental constraints.

</details>


### [450] [Automatic denoising and differentiation based on Savitzky-Golay filtering and Homogeneous Differentiators for attractor reconstruction via differential embedding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18631)
*Uros Sutulovic,Daniele Proverbio,Rami Katz,Giulia Giordano*

Main category: q-bio.QM

TL;DR: 提出SHADED方法，结合齐次微分器与Savitzky-Golay滤波，自动参数化地实现含噪时间序列的降噪与任意阶导数估计，从而完成微分嵌入与吸引子重构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微分嵌入方法需从含噪测量时间序列重构动力系统吸引子，但依赖精确的导数估计；噪声会严重破坏导数估计，且现有方法通常需要人工调参，易导致重构不准确。

Method: SHADED由两部分构成：齐次微分器（HD）在噪声下保证有限时间导数估计，随后用Savitzky-Golay（SG）滤波抑制抖振；关键是从数据中自动提取HD与SG所需的全部参数，无需人工调参，并可融合先验知识。

Result: 在计算神经科学模型、LTspice仿真的混沌电子电路、光电容积脉搏波与动脉血压实验记录上验证：有真值时导数估计与吸引子重构准确，无真值时重构几何一致且可重复，符合预期动力学。

Conclusion: SHADED是一种灵活的数据驱动含噪信号数值微分工具，无需人工调参即可实现准确的微分嵌入，可用于系统辨识、模式识别及动态状态判别（如区分生理与病理状态）。

Abstract: Differential embedding methods aim to reconstruct attractors of dynamical systems from noisy measured time series, but require accurate estimates of signal derivatives. We introduce SHADED (Savitzky-Golay and Homogeneous-differentiator based Automatic DEnoising and Differentiation), a novel methodology for denoising and estimation of derivatives up to an arbitrary order, which enables attractor reconstruction via differential embedding from noisy time series data. Homogeneous Differentiators (HD) guarantee finite-time derivative estimates in the presence of noise, while subsequent Savitzky-Golay (SG) filtering attenuates chattering. Crucially, SHADED extracts all parameters required for application of both HD and SG automatically from the data, without requiring manual tuning that may lead to inaccurate reconstruction, and can also incorporate prior knowledge, if available, thereby yielding a flexible tool for data-driven numerical differentiation of noisy signals. The obtained differential embeddings can reveal features of the underlying dynamics that are useful, e.g., for system identification, pattern recognition and discrimination between dynamic regimes; the latter application is particularly important in biomedical settings, to help distinguish between different physiological and pathological states. We demonstrate the efficacy of SHADED by testing it on computational neuroscience models, LTspice-simulated chaotic electronic circuits, and photoplethysmography and arterial blood pressure experimental recordings: across all these case studies, SHADED produces accurate derivative estimates and accurate attractor reconstructions via differential embedding (whenever a ground truth is available) or geometrically coherent and reproducible reconstructions consistent with the expected dynamics (in the absence of a ground truth), without the need for manual parameter tuning.

</details>

# cs.DC [[Back]](#toc)

### [451] [SpecReuse: Spectral Graph Reuse for Efficient Vision GNN Inference on FPGAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17718)
*Isabella Bernhardt Eiliya,Anvitha Ramachandran,Dhruv Parikh,Viktor Prasanna*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出SpecReuse算法与FPGA加速器，通过谱描述子漂移阈值实现ViG中动态图像图构建（DIGC）的图复用，降低重复构图开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DIGC是ViG FPGA加速的主要性能瓶颈，需逐层以不规则、访存密集的计算重建图连接；现有FPGA加速器虽对DIGC进行优化，但仍无条件执行，导致重复图重建成为延迟与能耗的持续来源。

Method: SpecReuse算法：计算中间特征的紧凑谱描述子，当描述子漂移低于校准阈值时复用此前构建的图。SpecReuse加速器：FPGA架构，采用轻量级硬件实现谱描述子提取与复用控制，并与现有图构建加速器保持兼容。

Result: 端到端推理最高2.69倍加速，单次推理能耗降低约58%–65%，FPGA资源开销可忽略，分类精度损失极小。

Conclusion: 通过谱描述子驱动的条件图复用，可有效缓解DIGC的重复构图瓶颈，在几乎不增加硬件成本与精度损失的前提下显著提升ViG FPGA推理的能效与速度。

Abstract: Dynamic Image Graph Construction (DIGC) is the primary performance bottleneck in FPGA acceleration of Vision Graph Neural Networks (ViGs), reconstructing graph connectivity at every layer through irregular, memory-intensive computation. Existing FPGA accelerators optimize DIGC but still execute it unconditionally, making repeated graph reconstruction a persistent source of latency and energy consumption. We propose the SpecReuse algorithm, which computes compact spectral descriptors of intermediate features and reuses previously constructed graphs when descriptor drift remains below a calibrated threshold. We further present the SpecReuse accelerator, an FPGA architecture that realizes graph reuse through lightweight hardware for spectral descriptor extraction and reuse control while remaining compatible with existing graph-construction accelerators. Experimental results demonstrate up to a $2.69\times$ speedup in end-to-end inference and approximately 58--65\% lower energy per inference with negligible FPGA resource overhead and minimal loss in classification accuracy.

</details>


### [452] [Large Language Model based air quality monitoring and localized alert generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17954)
*Ricardo Vieira,Luis Tavares,Kaylane Lima,Lucas De Souza,Arthur Poggy,João Lima,Vitor Pinheiro,Markus Endler*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: EnQyMo 是一个面向室内空气质量的通用物联网中间件平台，通过传感器数据、BLE 信标与手机端 IoT 中间件实现用户级暴露识别与定位告警，并借助 LLM 智能体自动解析法规与文献以确定健康暴露阈值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 室内空气质量对健康的直接危害可达室外的五倍，可引发头痛、疲劳、眼喉刺激，长期暴露还与呼吸系统、心脏疾病及部分癌症相关。然而现有监测设备与系统（多面向办公室与工作场所）大多是"被动"的，缺乏对具体暴露人群的主动识别与针对性告警，因此需要一个能关联传感器数据与个体健康暴露风险的主动式平台。

Method: 提出 EnQyMo 通用 IoT 中间件平台：(1) 处理多类室内空气质量相关传感器数据，并将其与用户/员工的健康暴露风险相关联；(2) 采用蓝牙低功耗（BLE）信标结合移动 IoT 中间件，识别暴露于污染空气或高 CO2 环境中的（智能手机）用户；(3) 仅向处于不健康空气条件位置处的用户发送位置相关（location-specific）告警；(4) 核心为一个 LLM 智能体（agency of LLMs），可解读监管标准与科学文献，自动识别关键健康暴露水平。

Result: 摘要中未给出实验数据或定量评估结果；所报告的是平台的设计与功能：能够基于 BLE 与移动中间件定位并识别暴露用户，实现位置特定的定向告警，并通过 LLM 自动从法规与文献中推导关键暴露阈值。

Conclusion: EnQyMo 将 IoT 传感器监测、BLE 定位与 LLM 驱动的标准解读相结合，把被动的室内空气质量监测转变为面向个体、位置感知的主动健康暴露告警系统，为办公及工作场所的室内健康与福祉监测提供了可推广的中间件方案。

Abstract: Poor indoor air quality can cause up to five times more direct health problems to occupants than outdoor air. In particular, it may cause headaches, fatigue, eye/throat irritation, and long-time exposure is linked to respiratory and heart as well as some forms of cancer. Despite the importance of indoor health and well-being, most current monitoring devices and systems (usually for offices and workspaces) are passive. The Environmental Quality Monitor (EnQyMo) platform is a generic Internet of Things (IoT) middleware designed to process several sensor data related to air quality in indoor spaces and correlate this data with health exposure risks of users/workplace employees. Using Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) beacons and a mobile IoT middleware it is able to identify the (smartphone) users exposed to these polluted air or high CO2 (carbon dioxide) levels, and generate location-specific alarms only to the users at the places with the unhealthy air conditions. At the core of EnQyMo is an agency of Large Language Models (LLMs) capable of interpreting regulatory standards and scientific literature to automatically identify critical health exposure levels.

</details>


### [453] [Towards Training Private LLMs: Exploring Fine-Tuning Language Models on Apple Silicon with RDMA over Thunderbolt](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18066)
*En-Ming Huang,Yao-Ting Hsieh,Hsiang-Yu Tsou,Mu-Chi Chen,Shih-Hao Hung,H. T. Kung*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究Apple Silicon（Mac Studio集群）能否作为私有LLM微调的实用平台，通过剖析RDMA-over-Thunderbolt通信瓶颈并优化多链路通信、常驻工作线程与CPU侧梯度重叠，在四节点集群微调Qwen3-9B时实现最高1.6倍弱扩展吞吐提升，并对比H100量化显存容量、吞吐与成本的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机构在私有LLM微调中需使用敏感数据，但常超出通用数据中心加速器的显存容量。Apple Silicon凭借大容量统一内存与更低整机成本提供了不同思路，且近期软件支持可在Thunderbolt上通过RDMA进行分布式执行，因此有必要验证其作为私有微调平台的实用性与性能边界。

Method: 1）在Mac Studio节点上刻画RDMA-over-Thunderbolt通信，实测带宽远低于标称TB规格；2）在Apple实现基础上扩展多主干（multi-trunk）通信、常驻工作线程（persistent worker threads）与CPU侧梯度重叠；3）在多TB直连链路上优化LLM微调工作负载；4）在四节点Mac Studio集群上微调Qwen3-9B进行弱扩展测试；5）与NVIDIA H100平台对比。

Result: 优化后弱扩展吞吐较单主干、无重叠基线最高提升1.6倍；序列长度17408时达到936 tokens/s；与H100平台对比量化了显存容量、吞吐与购置成本之间的权衡。

Conclusion: Apple Silicon（Mac Studio集群）可作为私有LLM微调的高性价比方案，在显存容量与成本方面具有优势，但需通过多链路通信与计算通信重叠等优化来克服RDMA-over-Thunderbolt的实际带宽瓶颈。

Abstract: Private large language model (LLM) fine-tuning is increasingly important for organizations that need to adapt models using sensitive data, but it often exceeds the memory capacity of commodity datacenter accelerators. Apple Silicon offers a different design point through large unified memory and lower complete-system cost, while recent Apple software support enables distributed execution over RDMA-over-Thunderbolt (TB). This paper studies whether Apple Silicon can serve as a practical platform for private LLM fine-tuning. We characterize RDMA-over-TB communication on Mac Studio nodes, showing that the measured bandwidth is far below nominal TB specifications. Next, we extend Apple's implementation with multi-trunk communication, persistent worker threads, and CPU-side gradient overlap to better exploit multiple direct TB links for LLM fine-tuning workloads. Finally, on a four-node Mac Studio cluster that fine-tunes a Qwen3-9B, our optimizations improve weak-scaling throughput by up to 1.6X over the single-trunk, non-overlapped baseline and reach 936 tokens/s for sequence length 17408. We further compare Apple Silicon with an NVIDIA H100 platform to quantify the trade-off between memory capacity, throughput, and acquisition cost, showing that Apple Silicon can provide a cost-effective solution for private LLM fine-tuning.

</details>


### [454] [SSD-LLaMA: SSD-Native Inference for Trillion-Parameter MoE at 1+ Token/s on a Consumer PC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18110)
*Fangzhou Liang,Yibin Shen,Jianmin Hu,Jiayang Xu,Hanchi Gao,Minxian Xu,Zili Meng*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 该论文提出 SSD-LLaMA，一种面向 SSD 的本地 MoE 推理系统，通过 SSD I/O 流水线、三层存储层级管理及 CPU-GPU 混合执行，在消费级硬件上高效运行超大规模 MoE 模型，prefill 提速 1.52-4.19 倍，decode 提速 2.10-15.58 倍，单卡 RTX 5090 + 32GB RAM 即可运行万亿参数模型且超过 1 token/s。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿开源权重语言模型日益采用 MoE 架构以扩大容量，同时每 token 仅激活少量专家，但本地推理仍需保留完整专家池，即便量化后也远超消费级 RAM 和 VRAM 容量。SSD 虽能提供该规模下的实用容量，但要将容量转化为可执行的模型内存，需要高效的专家传输、SSD-RAM-VRAM 的协同管理以及在受限带宽下的 CPU-GPU 混合执行。现有方案难以满足这些要求。

Method: SSD-LLaMA 采用三项核心技术：(1) 面向专家传输优化的 SSD I/O 流水线；(2) 原生三层存储层级，动态投递并保留专家；(3) 均衡的 CPU-GPU 混合执行。系统执行每一个被选中的专家，不做剪枝或替换。

Result: 在三个前沿 MoE 模型族上，SSD-LLaMA 相比评估基线将 prefill token 速率提升 1.52-4.19 倍，decode token 速率提升 2.10-15.58 倍。使用单张 RTX 5090 和不超过 32GB RAM 运行万亿参数模型时，达到超过 1 token/s 的吞吐。

Conclusion: SSD-LLaMA 验证了以 SSD 为原生存储介质、通过三层存储层级与 CPU-GPU 混合执行在消费级硬件上运行大规模 MoE 模型的可行性，在显著提升 token 速率的同时保证专家执行的完整性，无需剪枝或替换。

Abstract: Frontier open-weight language models increasingly use Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures to expand model capacity while activating only a small subset of experts per token. Local inference must nevertheless keep the complete expert pool available, which remains far beyond consumer-grade RAM and VRAM capacity even after quantization. SSDs provide practical capacity at this scale, but turning that capacity into executable model memory requires efficient expert delivery, coordinated management of SSD, RAM, and VRAM, and CPU--GPU hybrid execution under bounded bandwidth. We present \textit{SSD-LLaMA}, an SSD-native local MoE inference system that addresses these challenges with an SSD I/O pipeline optimized for expert delivery, a native three-tier storage hierarchy that delivers and retains experts dynamically, and balanced CPU--GPU hybrid execution. \textit{SSD-LLaMA} executes every selected expert without pruning or substitution. Across three frontier MoE model families, \textit{SSD-LLaMA} improves prefill token rate by 1.52$\times$--4.19$\times$ and decode token rate by 2.10$\times$--15.58$\times$ over the evaluated baselines. We also achieve higher than 1 token/s for running trillion-parameter model with a single RTX 5090 and no more than 32GB RAM.

</details>


### [455] [Token Latency Fairness: Performance Isolation for Multi-Tenant LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18112)
*Dev Bali,Soujanya Ponnapalli,Yichuan Wang,Natacha Crooks,Scott Shenker,Matei Zaharia*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出 FairInference，为多租户 LLM 服务提供 δ-token 公平性延迟隔离保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 服务通常为共享多租户场景，高需求客户端会造成其他客户端延迟 SLO 违规；现有隔离方案仅通过排队与批处理公平性实现长期吞吐均衡，无法保证延迟隔离，行为良好的客户端仍可能遭遇严重的 token 级延迟退化。

Method: 提出 δ-token 公平性保证：若某 token 在隔离环境下于 d 时间内生成，则在多租户执行中将在 d+δ 时间内生成。为此，FairInference 需解决在缺乏细粒度调度或资源分配支持下共享 GPU 资源带来的延迟界定问题。其调度器为每个 token 强制截止时间，界定 GPU 计算共享引入的延迟，并考虑 GPU 内存中共享 KV 缓存带来的额外延迟。

Result: FairInference 能有效界定行为良好客户端的 token 级延迟尖峰，同时相比当前最先进的 LLM 服务系统提升整体吞吐。

Conclusion: FairInference 通过 δ-token 公平性与逐 token 截止时间调度，实现了多租户 LLM 服务的强延迟隔离，并在延迟保证与吞吐之间取得更优权衡。

Abstract: LLM serving is typically offered as a shared, multi-tenant service, where high-demand workloads from one client can cause latency SLO violations for others. Existing solutions for performance isolation equalize client throughput in the long run, for example through queueing and batching fairness. However, these approaches do not provide latency isolation guarantees; as a result, well-behaved clients can still experience significant degradation to their token-level latencies.
  In this paper, we present FairInference, which provides the novel δ-token fairness guarantee: for a well-behaved client, if a token is generated in d time units in isolation, it will be generated within d + δ time units in multi-tenant execution, providing strong latency isolation guarantees for LLM serving. To achieve this, FairInference addresses a key challenge of LLM serving: bounding delays from sharing GPU resources without support for fine-grained scheduling or resource allocation. In FairInference, the scheduler enforces per-token deadlines, while bounding the delays from GPU compute sharing and accounting for the additional delays introduced by the shared KV caching in GPU memory. We show that FairInference effectively bounds token-level latency spikes for well-behaved clients and improves overall throughput compared to state-of-the-art LLM serving systems.

</details>


### [456] [Zero-I/O Fault Recovery for Sharded Deep Learning via Dynamic Framework Dependency Rebinding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18178)
*Genlang Chen,Junyi Zhu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: AccelPact 是一种并行运行时，通过非侵入式引用重绑定与 Gloo 共识协议，实现分片分布式训练的零 I/O 内存内故障恢复，消除检查点回滚开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模分布式模型训练常受瞬时网络故障中断，常规做法是中止所有进程并回滚到最近检查点。周期性检查点虽提供持久性，但频繁快照带来严重存储压力：在 1.216B 参数解码器上，每次更新的异步检查点造成最高 +656.7% 延迟开销、32.5 GiB 主机内存占用及 3.39 TB/小时存储流量。因此需要消除此类检查点开销。

Method: 提出 AccelPact 并行运行时，实现分片分布式训练的零 I/O 内存内故障恢复。当通信在已提交优化器步失败时，设备内存仍静止未损坏，但 PyTorch FSDP 等框架跨模块包装器与参数层级缓存内部通信句柄，导致无法继续。AccelPact 通过非侵入式的引用重绑定机制解决该依赖失效问题，并由带外 Gloo 共识协议协调。该方案直接作用于原生通信器实例。

Result: 在 16 张 NVIDIA RTX 5880 GPU 上训练全参数 Mistral-7B：AccelPact 消除检查点重放，整体运行有效吞吐相比冷重启提升 1.197x，相比 NVRx 检查点恢复在检查点年龄 5 时提升 1.194x，年龄 18 时提升至 1.698x。十次连续故障注入中，全部 16 个 rank 保持位级一致的参数状态，零数值漂移。在 4 至 16 GPU 集群拓扑下，引用重绑定以常数时间执行（0.493-0.518 ms）。

Conclusion: AccelPact 需要零应用代码修改，并在 torch.compile 下避免编译器图中断，为弹性深度学习提供了高效基础。

Abstract: Distributed model training at scale is frequently interrupted by transient network failures, conventionally forcing cluster managers to abort all processes and roll back to the latest checkpoint. While periodic checkpointing provides durability, frequent snapshotting introduces severe storage backpressure: our measurements on a 1.216B-parameter decoder reveal that per-update asynchronous checkpointing incurs up to a +656.7% latency overhead, consumes 32.5 GiB of host memory, and generates 3.39 TB/hour of storage traffic. To eliminate this overhead, we present AccelPact, a parallel runtime enabling zero-I/O in-memory fault recovery for sharded distributed training. When communication fails at a committed optimizer step, device memory remains quiescent and uncorrupted, yet continuation fails because frameworks like PyTorch FSDP cache internal communication handles across module wrappers and parameter hierarchies. AccelPact resolves this dependency invalidation via a non-invasive reference-rebinding mechanism coordinated by an out-of-band Gloo consensus protocol. On 16 NVIDIA RTX 5880 GPUs training full-parameter Mistral-7B, AccelPact eliminates checkpoint replay, yielding a 1.197x whole-run goodput improvement over cold restart and 1.194x over NVRx checkpoint restoration at checkpoint age 5, rising to 1.698x at age 18. Across ten successive fault injections, all 16 ranks maintain bit-identical parameter state with zero numerical drift. Across 4-to-16 GPU cluster topologies, reference rebinding executes in constant time (0.493-0.518 ms). Operating directly on native communicator instances, AccelPact requires zero application-code modifications and avoids compiler graph breaks under torch.compile, providing an efficient foundation for resilient deep learning.

</details>


### [457] [GeoMesh: Workload-Balanced and Sign-Compressed Geo-Distributed LLM Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18388)
*Changyong Shin,Jaerim Park,Minchul Kang,Younghun Go,Zhixiong Niu,Yongqiang Xiong,Gyeongsik Yang,Chuck Yoo*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: GeoMesh是一个面向异构GPU的同步地理分布式训练框架，通过自适应负载均衡与压缩伪梯度通信，在保持精度的同时大幅降低训练时间和GPU空闲。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨区域地理分布式训练面临实际挑战：集群中GPU速度与显存容量参差不齐，且通过慢速广域网通信。现有同步方法虽更新稳定，但快速GPU需等待慢速GPU（最多占运行时20.9%），所有worker平均65.8%的时间耗费在同步上；近期异步方法虽减少等待，却因陈旧更新导致模型精度下降。

Method: GeoMesh是一个针对异构GPU的同步地理分布式训练框架：（1）负载均衡：为每个GPU分配合适的批大小与内部步数，使快速GPU承担更多有效工作而非空等；（2）通信压缩：交换基于符号的压缩伪梯度（附带轻量级幅值与token计数），将通信量减少近32倍。

Result: 在异构GPU与基于Azure的广域网环境下，GeoMesh相比代表性基线将达到目标困惑度的时间最多缩短70.2%；分别将掉队者导致的GPU空闲降低最多8.0倍、广域网导致的GPU空闲降低最多5.6倍，同时保持可比的零样本精度。

Conclusion: GeoMesh证明同步地理分布式训练可在异构GPU与慢速广域网条件下，同时实现高吞吐、低空闲与稳定精度，为跨区域大模型训练提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly trained on GPUs distributed across multiple regions, but geo-distributed training is challenging in practice. Real clusters often contain GPUs with different speeds and memory capacities, and they communicate over slow wide-area networks. Our analysis shows that this creates serious problems: existing synchronous methods preserve stable updates, but fast GPUs wait up to 20.9% of their runtime for slower ones, and all workers spend, on average, 65.8% of their runtime on synchronization. Recent asynchronous methods reduce waiting time but worsen the model accuracy due to stale updates. To address the problems, we present GeoMesh, a synchronous geo-distributed training framework for heterogeneous GPUs. GeoMesh balances per-worker workloads by assigning each GPU a suitable batch size and number of inner steps, so faster GPUs do more useful work instead of waiting. It also reduces communication volume by nearly 32x by exchanging compressed sign-based pseudo-gradients with lightweight magnitude and token count. Across heterogeneous GPUs and Azure-derived WAN, GeoMesh reduces time-to-target perplexity by up to 70.2% over representative baselines and lowers straggler- and WAN-induced GPU idle by up to 8.0x and 5.6x, respectively, while preserving comparable zero-shot accuracy.

</details>


### [458] [From Pixels to Semantics: Edge AI for UAV-Based Critical Infrastructure Inspection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18448)
*Reza Farahani,Naser Hossein Motlagh,Zoha Azimi,Christian Timmerer,Lorenzo Carnevale,Sasu Tarkoma,Schahram Dustdar*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文探讨从云端离线处理、边缘轻量目标检测（YOLO）向“边缘原生语义巡检”的演进，即利用轻量级视觉语言模型（VLM）使无人机从目标检测上升到上下文结构理解层面，并在NVIDIA Jetson级硬件上以COCO-Bridge数据集验证其可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 桥梁、隧道、大坝、输电线网等关键基础设施需要及时且可扩展的巡检；传统人工巡检成本高、风险大，UAV巡检成为难达结构监测的高效替代方案。现有UAV巡检流程仍以云端离线处理为主，或仅依赖轻量目标检测器进行实时缺陷定位，缺乏对结构的语义与上下文理解能力，因此需要向边缘原生语义巡检转型。

Method: 文章首先对现有UAV巡检架构进行分类，梳理关键系统挑战与架构需求；随后在NVIDIA Jetson UAV级硬件上开展实验，评估语义边缘智能的可行性。评估方案集成微调后的YOLO-26M用于目标定位，以及轻量级SmolVLM-256用于语义推理，数据集采用COCO-Bridge。

Result: 在Jetson级UAV硬件上，通过YOLO-26M定位与SmolVLM-256语义推理的组合，实验验证了语义边缘智能在UAV巡检场景中的可行性（摘要未给出具体精度、时延等量化指标）。

Conclusion: 文章展望了面向边缘-云连续体的未来方向，即构建具备智能体化（agentic）、自主化、可信赖且协同的语义UAV巡检体系。

Abstract: Critical infrastructure assets such as bridges, tunnels, dams, and power line networks require timely and scalable inspection. While conventional manual inspection remains costly and hazardous, unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based inspection has emerged as an efficient alternative for monitoring difficult-to-access structures. Existing UAV inspection pipelines have evolved from cloud-centric offline processing toward edge-based perception using lightweight object detectors such as YOLO for real- time defect localization. This article explores the transition toward fully edge-native semantic inspection powered by lightweight vision language models (VLMs), where UAVs move beyond object detection toward contextual structural understanding. It categorizes existing UAV inspection architectures, identifies their key system challenges and architectural requirements, and experimentally assesses the feasibility of semantic edge intelligence on NVIDIA Jetson UAV-class hardware using the COCO-Bridge dataset. The evaluation integrates a fine-tuned YOLO-26M for object localization and a lightweight SmolVLM-256 for semantic reasoning. Finally, it outlines future directions toward agentic, autonomous, trustworthy, and collaborative semantic UAV inspection across the edge-cloud continuum.

</details>


### [459] [DiverseFT: Diversifying Fault-Tolerant Systems using LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18512)
*Arne Vogel,Christian Berger,Rüdiger Kapitza*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: DiverseFT利用大语言模型，在给定参考实现的基础上自动化、可扩展地生成语义/二进制层面存在差异的代码，从而以更低成本实现容错协议副本的多样化。作者对PBFT、HotStuff和Raft三个复制协议进行多样化，实现高达65%的代码库被多样化替换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 容错一致性协议在多个副本共享同一实现时面临共因缺陷风险：若共同缺陷同时影响超过可容忍阈值的副本数量，协议将失效。理想情况下副本应独立失效，这可通过多样化实现。然而现实中所有副本通常共享同一协议实现，因为提供多个多样化实现困难且极为耗时费力。而共享协议实现因其复杂性极易成为共因缺陷的首要来源，构成重大风险。

Method: DiverseFT基于给定的参考实现，利用大语言模型自动化、可扩展地生成代码。所生成代码需满足：能够编译、通过测试，并且关键的是在语义或二进制层面存在差异，可替换参考实现中的对应代码，从而显著降低多样化成本。

Result: 作者通过多样化三个复制协议实现——PBFT、HotStuff与Raft——验证了使用大语言模型进行复制协议实现多样化的可行性，结果显示高达65%的代码库可被多样化替换。

Conclusion: DiverseFT表明，借助大语言模型对复制协议实现进行自动化多样化是可行的，能够大幅降低提供多样化实现的高昂成本，从而降低因共享实现导致共因缺陷的风险。

Abstract: Fault-tolerant agreement protocols fail if replicas share a common flaw that simultaneously affects more replicas than the tolerable threshold. Therefore replicas should ideally fail independently, which can be achieved through diversification. However, in practice, often the same protocol implementation is shared by all replicas which is not surprising given that the provision of multiple diverse implementations is difficult and highly laborious. This poses a major risk, as a shared protocol implementation is a prime candidate for common bugs due to its complexity. With DiverseFT, we demonstrate how, given a reference implementation, Large Language Models (LLMs) can be utilised for the automated and scalable generation of code that compiles, passes tests, and crucially differs semantically/binary-wise, that can re- place code in the reference implementation, thereby significantly reducing diversification costs. We demonstrate the feasibility of diversification of replication protocol implementations using LLMs by diversifying three implementations: PBFT, HotStuff, and Raft, showing how up to 65% of the codebase can be diversified.

</details>


### [460] [COMPASS-ABS: Reducing Fragmentation in Shared GPU Clusters for Deep Learning Training Workloads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18519)
*Yukai Zhou,Hongfan Wu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对共享GPU集群中资源碎片化导致利用率低、深度学习训练任务周转时间长的问题，提出与历史负载分布无关的碎片化度量SIF，并设计COMPASS-ABS调度方案，将集群状态约束在锚定空间内，理论上证明SIF上界为2/N，实验验证其提升利用率并缩短任务完成时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共享GPU集群中资源碎片化使集群利用率低下，并导致深度学习训练（DLT）任务周转时间过长。现有碎片化度量在缺乏负载分布信息时失效，且现有调度器无法持续将碎片化维持在低水平。

Method: 提出Scheduler-Induced Fragmentation（SIF）指标，基于partial-nodes概念构建，不依赖历史负载知识；进而提出COMPASS-ABS，采用COMPact-ASSured（COMPASS）算法将集群状态限制在紧致的Anchor-Based Space（ABS）内，其构建充分利用主导负载规模与节点容量之间的拓扑对齐。

Result: 理论证明SIF在符合理论与生产实际的负载组成条件下被限定在上界2/N；并在物理集群与模拟集群上的评估表明，COMPASS-ABS能有效提升资源利用率，并通过降低碎片化缩短DLT任务完成时间。

Conclusion: SIF提供了一种不依赖历史负载的碎片化度量，COMPASS-ABS通过锚定空间约束实现碎片化的持续低水平控制，兼顾理论保证与实证效果，可改善共享GPU集群的资源利用与DLT任务调度性能。

Abstract: With the rapid advancement of deep learning technology, shared GPU clusters receive an increasing number of deep learning training (DLT) jobs. Yet resource fragmentation make such clusters underutilized and forces the DLT jobs running on them to endure long turnaround times. Extensive research has been devoted to quantifying fragmentation and developing scheduling algorithms that alleviate its impact. However, existing fragmentation measures break down in the absence of workload distribution information, while current schedulers cannot continuously maintain resource fragmentation at a low level. To tackle these problems, we first introduce Scheduler-Induced Fragmentation (SIF), a metric built on the notion of partial-nodes that is independent of historical workload knowledge. We then propose COMPASS-ABS, which employs the COMPact-ASSured (COMPASS) algorithm to confine the cluster state within a tight Anchor-Based Space (ABS), whose construction fully leverages the topological alignment between dominant workload size and node capacity. Moreover. We also prove that it ensures SIF is bounded by $\frac{2}{N}$ under a workload composition condition that matches both theory and production. Evaluations implemented on a physical cluster and a simulated cluster demonstrate COMPASS-ABS effectiveness at improving resource utilization, reducing DLT job completion time by reducing fragmentation.

</details>


### [461] [AUPE: Collaborative byzantine fault-tolerant peer-sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18563)
*Augusta Mukam,Joachim Bruneau-Queyreix,Laurent Réveillère*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出AUPE——首个协作式拜占庭容错对等采样协议，借助可信节点（如Intel SGX设备）协同追踪标识符扩散并本地去偏，在1万节点模拟中于26%拜占庭节点下接近完美弹性，仅需10%可信节点即可将BRAHMS容忍度提升60%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对等采样是分布式系统（如无许可区块链）中的关键原语，用于维护成员视图。恶意节点（拜占庭节点）会通过提升自身在诚实节点视图中的占比来破坏上层协议。现有拜占庭容错对等采样协议虽能缓解该偏差，但随着恶意节点数量增加，其有效性显著下降，缺乏在较高恶意比例下仍保持弹性的方案。

Method: 提出AUPE协议，利用可信节点（例如配备Intel SGX的设备）进行协作，协同追踪标识符在系统中的传播情况，并对拜占庭节点的表示进行本地去偏处理，从而在诚实节点视图中抑制恶意节点的过度呈现。

Result: 在10,000节点的模拟中，即使对手控制26%的节点，AUPE仍实现接近完美的弹性，优于现有最先进方案；仅引入少至10%的可信节点，即可将BRAHMS的容忍度提升至多60%，并在对手持有高达40%节点时仍能限制攻击影响。

Conclusion: AUPE通过引入少量可信节点进行协作去偏，显著提升了对等采样的拜占庭容错上限与弹性，在恶意节点比例较高时仍保持良好性能，为大规模分布式系统提供了更稳健的成员视图维护机制。

Abstract: Peer sampling is a crucial primitive in distributed systems, used to manage overlays and disseminate information in large-scale scenarios such as permissionless blockchain systems. Its purpose is to maintain and regularly update a local and partial snapshot, or view, of the complete system's membership. These protocols are often targeted by malicious actors who aim to disrupt higher-level protocols. Typically, an adversary who controls a set of byzantine nodes attempts to manipulate how legitimate nodes perceive the presence of byzantine ones by increasing their representation in the view of honest nodes. While state-of-the-art byzantine-tolerant peer sampling protocols mitigate this bias, their effectiveness decreases significantly as the number of malicious nodes increases. This paper introduces AUPE, the first collaborative Byzantine-tolerant peer sampling protocol that leverages the presence of trusted nodes, such as Intel's SGX capable devices, to collaboratively track the spread of identifiers in the system and locally debias the representation of byzantine nodes. Simulations with 10,000 nodes demonstrate that AUPE outperforms state-of-the-art solutions, achieving nearperfect resilience even when faced with an adversary controlling 26% of the nodes. Overall, by including as few as 10% of trusted nodes, AUPE increases the tolerance of BRAHMS by up to 60% while limiting the impact of the adversary's attack, even when possessing up to 40% of the nodes.

</details>


### [462] [RayOrch: Programming and Executing Lineage-Controlled Multi-Grain Dataflows for Foundation-Model Data Preparation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18703)
*Xiaochen Ma,Zimo Meng,Junzhu Liang,Youhe Jiang,Yue Cheng,Hao Liang,Bohan Zeng,Dengchun Li,Lu Ma,Zhengyang Zhao,Zhen Hao Wong,Runming He,Meiyi Qiang,Jiangtao Guan,Binhang Yuan,Wentao Zhang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: RayOrch：面向异构文档与视频的父子关系感知编程模型与分布式执行引擎，支持有序可变基数扩展与匹配 gather，在 H20 GPU 上实现显著加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量基础模型训练数据需要可扩展流水线，将异构文档与视频转换为结构化记录。此类流水线将每个父项扩展为有序、输入依赖的子序列，子项数量可能呈长尾分布。GPU 需要跨父项批量处理子项，同时保留父子关系、子项顺序、完成状态与结果路由。现有系统要么将并行隐藏在粗粒度作业中，要么暴露扁平记录，迫使应用自行管理血缘与重新分组。

Method: 提出 RayOrch 编程模型与分布式执行引擎：程序声明有序可变基数扩展（expansion）与匹配的 gather；编译器校验扩展-gather 配对；运行时记录子项归属、直接父项、不可变序号与终止状态；采用 Per-Call FIFO Ready Queues 跨父项批量就绪子项；gather 依据声明的归属与序号而非批次边界或完成顺序重建结果；父项在所有必需子项终止后即可推进；支持带类型的父项作用域失败，抑制失败父项的未派发兄弟子项，同时允许无关父项继续执行。

Result: 在 NVIDIA H20 GPU 上，RayOrch 将 MinerU 从 4 GPU 扩展至 64 GPU 时取得 15.14 倍加速；将视频流水线从 8 GPU 扩展至 64 GPU 时取得 7.82 倍加速。端到端时间方面，MinerU 上相较 Ray Data 降低 13.1%、相较 Daft 降低 29.0%；Docling 上相较 Ray Data 降低 16.0%。

Conclusion: RayOrch 通过将父子关系作为一等执行语义贯穿整个流水线，解决了异构数据准备中子项可变基数、顺序与血缘管理难题，在扩展性与端到端效率上优于现有系统，代码已开源。

Abstract: Preparing high quality training data for foundation models requires scalable pipelines that transform heterogeneous documents and videos into structured records. Such pipelines expand each parent item into an ordered and input dependent sequence of children, whose counts may be long tailed. GPUs should batch children across parents while preserving parent relationships, child order, completion status, and result routing. Existing systems either hide parallelism behind coarse grained jobs or expose flat records that force applications to manage lineage and regrouping. We present RayOrch, a programming model and distributed execution engine that preserves parent child relations throughout execution. Programs declare ordered variable cardinality expansions and matching gathers. The compiler validates each pair, while the runtime records child membership, immediate parents, immutable ordinals, and terminal states. Per Call FIFO Ready Queues batch ready children across parents. Gathers reconstruct results from declared membership and ordinals rather than batch boundaries or completion order. Parents can advance as soon as all required children become terminal. Typed parent scoped failures suppress undispatched siblings of the failed parent while allowing unrelated parents to continue. On NVIDIA H20 GPUs, RayOrch achieves 15.14 times speedup when scaling MinerU from 4 to 64 GPUs and 7.82 times speedup when scaling a video pipeline from 8 to 64 GPUs. It reduces end to end time by 13.1 percent versus Ray Data and 29.0 percent versus Daft on MinerU, and by 16.0 percent versus Ray Data on Docling. Code available at https://github.com/OpenDCAI/RayOrch .

</details>


### [463] [Vigil: Accountable Liveness against Selective Silence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18778)
*Jiawei Cheng,Huiping Sun,Rui Zhou,Jinjue Zhou,Zhong Chen*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究BFT共识中对"选择性沉默"(recipient-selective silence)的问责问题：证明孤立攻击者可在阈值K_SI≥f+1下与诚实节点不可区分，且任何无反馈修复代价为Θ(n^3)；提出Vigil(Tendermint变体)，通过攻击自适应转发、位图交叉证明、core成员机制与挑战-应答审计达到该下界，正常路径每节点O(n)认证开销，并将识别扩展至x-部分同步。三地域广域网实验与精确仿真验证所有阈值与成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有BFT问责机制已能处理安全性违规与全局活性违规，但"选择性沉默"(recipient-selective silence)——攻击者仅对部分诚实节点隐瞒消息、对其他节点表现正常——仍未被解决。此类攻击者能拖垮共识却规避所有现有检测机制，因此需要系统性地研究针对选择性沉默的问责问题。

Method: 负面结果方面：论证对至多f个诚实节点沉默的单一攻击者与诚实节点不可区分，得到沉默识别阈值普适下界K_SI≥f+1；并证明沉默引发违规后任何无反馈修复代价为Θ(n^3)。正面结果方面：提出Vigil——一种Tendermint变体，采用攻击自适应转发(attack-adaptive forwarding)、位图交叉证明(bitmap cross-attestation)、基于core的成员机制(core-based membership)以及挑战-应答审计(challenge–response auditing)来实现匹配下界的识别。

Result: Vigil在无选择性沉默时每节点花费O(n)个认证器(外加每节点Θ(n^2)位图元数据比特)；中继开销与攻击宽度成正比(亚阈值沉默每视图可强制最多n^3/27次中继，并给出精确代价)；当节点对超过可调韧性τ_A比例的诚实对等节点沉默时，多数节点即可指控(K_SI=τ_A+1，τ_A=f时最优)。三地域广域网真实实验与精确仿真确认各阈值与代价：在2%丢包率下，f+1指控门限会误控91.2%诚实节点，而本文多数门限仅误控0.002%。

Conclusion: 选择性沉默的问责存在基本下界K_SI≥f+1，Vigil通过攻击自适应转发等技术实现对下界的最优匹配，兼顾低正常路径开销与与攻击宽度成比例的中继代价；同时精确量化了残余亚阈值骚扰面并将识别扩展至x-部分同步。实验证明基于多数门限的指控在实际网络环境下可大幅降低误判率，验证了理论阈值与成本的正确性。

Abstract: BFT accountability is well understood for safety violations, and recent work attributes global liveness violations; \emph{recipient-selective} silence remains unresolved. A selectively silent adversary withholds messages from some honest nodes while behaving correctly toward others. It can stall consensus yet evade every existing mechanism. We initiate a systematic study of accountability against selective silence. Negatively, a lone attacker silent toward at most $f$ honest nodes is indistinguishable from an honest node, yielding a universal lower bound $K_{\mathrm{SI}} \ge f{+}1$ on the \emph{silence identification threshold}; moreover, any feedback-free repair after a silence-induced violation costs $Θ(n^3)$. Positively, \textsc{Vigil}, a Tendermint variant, matches these bounds with attack-adaptive forwarding, via bitmap cross-attestation, core-based membership, and challenge--response auditing. It pays $O(n)$ authenticators per node when no selective silence occurs (plus $Θ(n^2)$ bitmap metadata bits per node), relays in proportion to the attack's width (sub-threshold silence can force up to $n^3/27$ relays per view, a cost we price exactly), and majority-accuses any node silent toward more than a tunable resilience $τ_A$ of honest peers ($K_{\mathrm{SI}} = τ_A{+}1$, optimal at $τ_A = f$). We also price the residual sub-threshold griefing surface exactly and extend identification to $x$-partial synchrony. Real-network experiments on a three-region WAN, together with a simulator held to exact equality with every closed form, confirm each threshold and cost: at $2\%$ loss, an $f{+}1$ accusation bar falsely accuses $91.2\%$ of honest nodes, while our majority bar accuses $0.002\%$.

</details>


### [464] [A Distributed Computing Framework for Satellite Swarms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18839)
*Ezra Fielding,Clement Demazure,Guthemberg Silvestre,Felipe Alves Suana,Philippe Quéinnec*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出面向卫星集群的分布式计算框架，并基于CRDT实现强最终一致分布式状态服务，验证其可扩展性与容错性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型卫星星座与分布式空间系统（DSS）的兴起需要泛化的容错、自主分布式空间应用框架；传统地基集中式指挥控制难以扩展到数十至数百颗卫星的系统，因此需引入分布式计算。

Method: 提出卫星集群的概念性分布式计算框架，涵盖分布式状态、指挥控制与科学任务；作为首个验证步骤，采用CRDT（具体为基于Last-Write-Wins Register的键值存储）设计并实现强最终一致分布式状态服务；在GoNetEm仿真的66星星座中，以空间态势感知（SSA）目录分发为场景进行评估。

Result: CRDT方法将星地通信从66条消息降至每次更新仅1条上行；树状遍历的总消息数与直接上行相当；并发更新下，由于节点丢弃过期版本，星间消息呈亚线性增长，进一步降低网络开销。

Conclusion: 基于CRDT的分布式状态可作为卫星集群应用的可扩展、容错基础，具备可行性。

Abstract: The rise of large satellite constellations and Distributed Space Systems (DSS) demands generalized frameworks that enable fault-tolerant, autonomous distributed space applications. Conventional ground-centric command and control does not scale to systems of tens or hundreds of satellites, motivating the adoption of distributed computing. This paper introduces a conceptual distributed computing framework for satellite swarms, covering distributed state, command and control, and scientific mission. As a first validation step, a strongly eventually consistent distributed state service is designed and implemented using Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDT), specifically a Last-Write-Wins Register-based key-value store. The service is evaluated in the context of Space Situational Awareness catalog dissemination across a simulated 66-satellite constellation emulated with GoNetEm. Results show that the CRDT-based approach reduces ground-to-satellite communication from 66 messages to a single uplink per update, with tree traversal matching the total message count of direct uplink. Under concurrent updates, sub-linear inter-satellite message growth is observed as nodes discard outdated versions, further reducing network overhead. These results demonstrate the viability of a CRDT-based distributed state as a scalable and fault-tolerant foundation for satellite swarm applications.

</details>


### [465] [Ask the Tool, Don't Guess: Agent Tool Calls Hold Their Progress, and the Serving System Should Read It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18849)
*Yipeng Liu,Yingqiang Zhang,Feifei Li,Huanchen Zhang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 论文指出现有服务系统对工具调用时长的预估不可靠，提出让工具在运行中显式上报进度，并据此做KV缓存决策，可显著改善推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic请求大量墙钟时间在等待工具执行，期间KV缓存持续占用GPU显存。现有系统只能在调用前根据工具名、历史、预声明时长或引擎占用率猜测工具时长，以此决定缓存留在显存、驱逐或回迁。作者论证：调用前固定做出的估计无法得知真实时长，甚至无法对调用进行排序；而正在运行的工具本身已掌握答案。

Method: 提出工具调用在运行过程中显式报告进度。对四个公开agent语料做普查，发现工具时间一旦被揭示，大部分可通过两种强度的可读信号表达：剩余工作比例，或“接近结束”的准确信号。构建harness在不改变agent可见内容的情况下恢复该信号，且对agent基准分数无可测代价。将该进度信息以少量hint接入生产引擎，用于KV缓存决策点。

Result: 在KV缓存决策点，上报的进度比最佳已发表预测器准确数倍至一个数量级，且在环境变化时保持准确。接入生产引擎后，工具调用后的p90首token时间（TTFT）相对LRU降低20.7%（仅HBM）和20.8%（HBM+DRAM），接近oracle水平。

Conclusion: 服务系统不应猜测工具自己能够告知的信息；让工具显式上报运行进度是可行且高收益的方案。

Abstract: An agentic request spends substantial wall-clock time waiting for tools, and its KV cache holds GPU memory the whole time. Serving systems decide whether that cache stays, leaves, or comes back by guessing how long the tool will run, from the tool's name, its history, a duration declared before the call, or the engine's own occupancy. We show that no estimate fixed before a call starts can know its duration, and such estimates may not even rank the calls. Meanwhile, the running tool already holds the answer, but the agent stack together with the tool silences it. We propose that tool calls report their progress explicitly while they run, and we measure what that takes. A census of four public agent corpora finds a readable signal in most tool time once it is revealed, in two strengths: a fraction of the work remaining, or an accurate signal that the end is near. A harness recovers it without changing what the agent sees, at no measurable cost to the agent's benchmark score. At the points where a KV cache decision is made, the reported progress is between several times and an order of magnitude more accurate than the best published predictors, and it stays accurate when the environment changes. Plugged into a production engine through a few small hints, it cuts the p90 time to first token (TTFT) after a tool call by 20.7% (HBM only) and 20.8% (HBM + DRAM) against LRU, close to an oracle. A serving system should not guess what its tools can tell it.

</details>


### [466] [Fluid Notarization: Verifiable Evolution of Concurrently Edited Structured Documents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18886)
*Amos Brocco,Giuliano Gremlich,Roberto Guidi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出"Fluid Notarization"(流式公证)范式：以文档演化过程本身(而非孤立快照)作为公证对象，基于JSON原生delta-CRDT(Melda)生成因果关联的演化工件图，链上仅记录工件标识符，同步/重构/冲突解决全部链下完成，兼顾CRDT的确定性收敛与区块链的可独立审计的存在性、来源与发布证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于区块链的文档公证采用快照导向模型，每次文档修订作为独立状态通过密码学引用锚定上链。该模型对不可变制品有效，但难以应对协作编辑场景：并发修改产生的分歧版本须在公证层之外调和；即便微小改动也需生成并分发新快照，成本与开销高。而CRDT等协作复制框架虽能确定性调和并发更新，却无法天然提供"贡献何时发布"的可独立验证证据。因此需要一种同时具备收敛性与可审计发布证明的公证范式。

Method: 提出Fluid Notarization范式，将文档演化本身作为公证对象，公证的是由JSON原生delta-CRDT生成的因果关联演化工件图，而非孤立状态。该模型建立在Melda之上——将文档变更表示为紧凑、内容寻址的delta，并通过因果依赖相互链接。区块链公证被简化为仅记录这些演化工件的标识符；同步、重构与冲突解决完全保留在链下。最终架构融合两类互补保证：由CRDT提供确定性收敛，由区块链提供可独立审计的存在性证明、来源证明与发布证据。

Result: 基于协作编辑的电子健康记录(EHR)构建了原型实现与验证场景，验证了该方法的可行性，并展示了公证文档演化而非连续文档快照的优势。

Conclusion: Fluid Notarization以演化工件图替代快照序列作为公证对象，在链上仅存储内容寻址delta的标识符，实现了链下高效协作与链上轻量可审计性的统一。原型验证表明该范式在协作编辑场景(如电子健康记录)中可行且具优势，为区块链公证从"状态锚定"走向"演化计量"提供了新思路。

Abstract: Traditional blockchain-based document notarization follows a snapshot-oriented model in which each document revision is represented as an independent state anchored on-chain through a cryptographic reference. While effective for immutable artifacts, this approach becomes inadequate when documents evolve through collaborative editing. Concurrent modifications create divergent document versions that must be reconciled outside the notarization layer, while even minor changes require generating and distributing new document snapshots. Conversely, collaborative replication frameworks such as CRDTs provide deterministic reconciliation of concurrent updates, but do not inherently provide independently verifiable evidence of when contributions were published. This paper introduces Fluid Notarization, a notarization paradigm in which document evolution itself becomes the object of notarization. Rather than certifying isolated states, Fluid Notarization certifies a graph of causally related evolution artifacts generated by a JSON-native delta-CRDT. The proposed model builds upon Melda, which represents document changes as compact, content-addressed deltas linked through causal dependencies. Blockchain notarization is reduced to recording identifiers of these evolution artifacts, while synchronization, reconstruction, and conflict resolution remain entirely off-chain. The resulting architecture combines two complementary guarantees: deterministic convergence provided by the CRDT and independently auditable proof-of-existence, provenance, and publication evidence provided by the blockchain. A prototype implementation and validation scenario based on collaboratively edited electronic health records demonstrate the feasibility of the approach and highlight the advantages of notarizing document evolution rather than successive document snapshots.

</details>


### [467] [Ermes: a Stateful Serverless Platform for the Edge-to-Cloud Continuum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18924)
*Matteo Cenzato,Dario d'Abate,Arianna Dragoni,Giacomo Orsenigo,Luca Tosetti,Matteo Briscini,Alessandro Margara*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出 Ermes，一个将状态管理原生集成到 FaaS 的分布式平台，通过集合（collections）与细粒度一致性级别实现计算与状态在边缘到云连续体上的联合分布，显著降低延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FaaS 的无状态特性迫使函数从通常以云为中心的外部数据存储获取状态，重新引入了边缘计算本意消除的延迟；此外，位置无关的调度器与僵化的、一刀切的一致性模型无法满足边缘应用多样化的需求。

Method: Ermes 将应用状态组织为逻辑单元（collections），采用分布式协调算法将集合与函数联合映射到可用节点以最小化客户端感知延迟；同时支持细粒度复制和逐集合的一致性级别，从顺序一致性到最终一致性，由开发者自行权衡一致性与性能。

Result: 实验评估表明，Ermes 能迅速将远程状态访问转为本地访问，并在工作负载增长及客户端在边缘移动时仍保持低延迟。

Conclusion: Ermes 通过将状态管理原生集成进 FaaS 并支持可调一致性，有效解决了边缘 FaaS 中状态访问的延迟问题。

Abstract: Function-as-a-Service (FaaS) is a widely adopted paradigm to simplify application deployment across the edge-to-cloud continuum. However, its stateless nature forces functions to retrieve their state from external, typically cloud-centric, data stores, reintroducing the very latency that edge computing aims to eliminate. This issue is further exacerbated by location-agnostic schedulers and rigid, one-size-fits-all consistency models that fail to capture the diverse requirements of edge applications. In this paper, we propose Ermes, a distributed platform that natively integrates state management into the FaaS paradigm, enabling the joint distribution of computational workloads and application state across the edge-to-cloud continuum. Ermes organizes application state into logical units, termed collections, and employs a distributed coordination algorithm that jointly maps collections and functions onto the available nodes seeking to minimize the latency perceived by the clients. In addition, it supports fine-grained replication and per-collection consistency levels, ranging from sequential to eventual consistency, leaving developers the choice of how to resolve the trade-off between consistency and performance. The experimental evaluation shows that Ermes quickly turns remote state accesses into local ones and sustains low latency as the workload grows, and as clients move across the edge.

</details>


### [468] [Replication-Aware Placement of Functions and Data in the Edge-Cloud Continuum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18932)
*Dario d'Abate,Matteo Cenzato,Matteo Briscini,Arianna Dragoni,Alessandro Margara*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 该论文研究FaaS边缘-云连续体中的函数调度与数据放置联合优化问题，提出BLP最优模型与拓扑感知贪心启发式算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FaaS已成为边缘-云连续体的主流编程模型，但其无状态函数与持久化状态解耦。如何在异构一致性要求下进行数据复制，并联合优化函数调度与数据放置以最小化客户端延迟，尚缺乏系统研究。

Method: 提出二进制线性规划（BLP）模型以计算最优放置方案，建立严格的理论基线；由于BLP随基础设施节点数呈三次方增长，进一步提出拓扑感知的贪心启发式算法以高效逼近最优解。

Result: 实验表明，该启发式算法以极低的计算开销实现了接近最优的放置质量。

Conclusion: 该启发式方法适合用于周期性系统重配置场景，在保证放置质量的同时显著降低计算成本。

Abstract: Function-as-a-Service (FaaS) has emerged as the prominent programming model for the edge-cloud continuum. FaaS inherently decouples stateless functions from their persistent state. We study how to jointly schedule functions and place data to minimize client latency, considering data replication under heterogeneous consistency requirements. We introduce a Binary Linear Programming (BLP) model to compute optimal placements, establishing a rigorous theoretical baseline. Since the BLP scales cubically with the infrastructure nodes, we propose a topology-aware greedy heuristic that efficiently approximates the optimal solution. Our evaluation shows that the heuristic achieves near-optimal placement quality at a fraction of the computational cost, making it suitable for periodic system reconfigurations.

</details>


### [469] [OAK: Restart- and Age-Aware Scheduling for Distributed Machine Learning on Shared GPU Clusters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19024)
*Khaled Aljbab,Amine Barrak*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: OAK：面向多租户GPU集群的每轮混合整数线性调度器，在goodput效用中显式加入“等待年龄键”和“分解式重启因子”两项一等信号，在无故障时接近最强goodput基线（4%内），在故障率λ=0.1下将平均JCT降低33.9-58.3%、最坏JCT降低58-76%，决策延迟仅7.65ms。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式机器学习在共享多租户GPU集群上运行，竞争与故障已成常态。现有goodput驱动调度器只优化瞬时吞吐，将累积等待时间与重启开销当作次要信号：长时间等待的作业被反复推迟，且每次中断后加载检查点所耗的分钟级开销未纳入分配决策，导致故障下平均与尾部JCT显著恶化。

Method: 提出OAK，一种按轮（per-round）求解的混合整数线性（MILP）调度器。其复合效用函数在goodput基础上增加两项：一是age key，用于提升累计等待时间高的作业优先级；二是分解式重启因子（decomposed restart factor），将有效训练时间与检查点开销作为分别度量的两个量，而非以往goodput调度器所用的单一聚合比率。评估采用trace驱动的模拟器（12-GPU集群、4种数据并行负载、可控泊松故障注入），并与4个代表性的goodput与公平性驱动基线对比，同时在4×V100真实集群上复现故障场景的改进。

Result: 无故障条件下，OAK与最强goodput驱动基线差距在4%以内。在故障率λ=0.1时，相对其goodput驱动基础，平均JCT降低33.9-58.3%，最坏情况JCT降低58-76%；其中分解式重启因子单独贡献了相对聚合式重启估计器（此前goodput调度器所用）40-57%的平均JCT改进和52-76%的尾部JCT改进。每轮决策延迟为7.65ms，比默认设置下的演化搜索类方法快三个数量级。

Conclusion: OAK表明，将累积等待时间与分解后的检查点重启开销作为一等调度信号，可在几乎不损失无故障goodput的前提下显著改善故障场景下的平均与尾部JCT；且MILP每轮求解的延迟极低，具备实用可行性。

Abstract: Distributed machine learning increasingly runs on shared multi-tenant GPU clusters where contention and failures are routine. Goodput-driven schedulers maximise instantaneous throughput but treat accumulated waiting time and restart cost as second-class signals: long-waiting jobs are repeatedly deferred, and the minutes of checkpoint loading paid after each interruption are not folded back into allocation decisions.
  We present OAK, a per-round mixed-integer linear scheduler whose composite utility adds two first-class terms to goodput: an age key that elevates jobs with high cumulative waiting time, and a decomposed restart factor that tracks productive training time and checkpoint overhead as separately measured quantities rather than a single aggregate ratio.
  We evaluate OAK against four representative goodput- and fairness-driven baselines in a trace-driven simulator on a 12-GPU cluster across four data-parallel workloads with controlled Poisson failure injection, and reproduce the failure-mode improvement on a 4-V100 real-hardware cluster.
  Under failure-free conditions OAK matches the strongest goodput-driven baseline within 4%. Under failures at rate $λ= 0.1$ it reduces mean job completion time (JCT) by 33.9-58.3% and worst-case JCT by 58-76% over its goodput-driven foundation; the decomposed restart factor alone accounts for a 40-57% mean and 52-76% tail JCT improvement against an aggregate restart estimator used in prior goodput-driven schedulers. Per-round decision latency is 7.65 ms, three orders of magnitude faster than evolutionary-search alternatives at default settings.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [470] [Making AI-Assisted Claims Independently Challengeable: Publication Authority and a Protocol for Falsifiable Publication Records](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17631)
*Torsten Olivi Tiltack,Yifei Dong,Kun Yu,Xu Wang,Wei Liu,Jianlong Zhou,Ren Ping Liu,Fang Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出"出版权威"（Publication Authority）概念，即一类精确状态、不可转移、单次使用的出版能力，并在PAC-2026（Publication-Accountability Calculus）中实例化，评估其第四次有界语义冻结（SF-4）规范。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI辅助的主张在证据、分析、人工授权、呈现形式与更正历史指向不同状态时，可能显得具有权威性。现有溯源、认证与透明度机制虽能揭示历史，但无法刻画此处所考察的"出版转换"本身。

Method: 将出版权威形式化为精确状态、不可转移、单次使用的出版能力，并实现为可机读的AIJIM协议候选PAC-2026。SF-4设定六项义务：证据、运行与制品、测量披露、授权、表面一致性、生命周期连续性。每项义务只能产出目标绑定的见证、局部反例或局部不可验证性，且互不补偿；仅当存在全新、完整、全通过记录时，才派生出一个被单次原子出版转换所消耗的许可。采用身份向量、对抗案例、有限模型与历史实现进行验证。

Result: 十个模型探索了110,764个安全可达状态；76个不安全配置均产生预期的违规或观察者反模型。读者表面即便通过一致性检查也不能授权出版，除非被接受的记录允许该表面。SF-4区分了证据视界与验证时间，并拒绝真实但因果无效的授权。历史前驱路径复现了17个冻结的授权-后继结果；后续的同源、实例盲测试在已知案例类上匹配全部183个评分预期，同主机包执行复现其240条归档观测。

Conclusion: 结果支持内部一致性、有界安全性、故障敏感性与有限可构造性，但不支持事实真值、通用精化、盲互操作性、现场有效性或标准地位。

Abstract: AI-assisted claims can appear authoritative when evidence, analysis, human authorization, presentation, and correction history refer to different states. Provenance, attestation, and transparency expose history but alone do not specify the publication transition examined here. We develop Publication Authority as an exact-state, non-transferable, single-use publication capability and instantiate it in PAC-2026 (Publication-Accountability Calculus), a machine-readable AIJIM Protocol candidate. We evaluate its fourth bounded semantic freeze (SF-4), a fixed-profile specification designed for replaceable bindings. Six obligations govern evidence, runs and artifacts, measurement disclosure, authorization, surface correspondence, and lifecycle continuity. Each yields a target-bound witness, localized counterexample, or localized unverifiability; none can compensate for another.
